metadata.source: Atharvaprāyaścittāni, Text mit Anmerkungen von Prof. Julius von Negelein, University of Koenigsberg, Germany. Published in JAOS 33 [1913], 71-144 (text); 217-253 (indices and corrigenda); 34 [1914], 229-277 (preface and introduction).

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:71/1) om namo 'tharvavedāya ||
body.translated_text: Om, salutation to the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:71/1-2) athāto yājñe karmaṇi prāyaścittāni vyākhyāsyāmo vidhy-aparādhe |
body.translated_text: Now we shall explain the <s>prāyaścittāni</s> (expiatory rites) for errors in sacrificial ritual.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:71/2-4) sarvatra punaḥ kāryaṃ kṛtvottarataḥ prāyaścittaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vā kṛtvottarataḥ samādhānaṃ |
body.translated_text: Everywhere, having performed the rite again afterwards, one performs the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation); or having performed the expiation, one then performs the <s>samādhāna</s> (completion) afterwards.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:71/4-5) yat pūrvaṃ prāyaścittaṃ karoti gṛhaiḥ paśubhir evainaṃ samardhayati |
body.translated_text: When one performs the <s>prāyaścitta</s> beforehand, it enriches him with houses and cattle.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:71/5-6) yad uttarataḥ svargeṇaivainaṃ tal lokena samardhayati |
body.translated_text: When [performed] afterwards, it enriches him with heaven, with that world.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:71-72/6-1) katham agnīn ādhāyānvāhārya śrapaṇam āharet |
body.translated_text: How should one, having established the fires, offer the <s>Anvāhārya</s> cooking?

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/1) katham iti |
body.translated_text: How so?

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/1-2) prāṇā vā ete yajamānasyādhyātmaṃ nidhīyante yad agnayas |
body.translated_text: For the fires are the <s>prāṇas</s> (vital breaths) of the sacrificer, deposited in the self (<s>adhyātma</s>).

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/2-3) teṣu huteṣu dakṣiṇāgnāv ājyāhutiṃ juhuyād <agnaye 'nnādāyānnapataye svāhā [cf. PS 20.43.9, ;SS 19.55.5]>_iti |
body.translated_text: When offerings are made in them, one should offer an <s>ājya</s> (ghee) oblation in the <s>Dakṣiṇāgni</s> (southern fire): 'To <s>Agni</s>, the eater of food, the lord of food, <s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/3-4) katham agnīn ādhāya pravasati |
body.translated_text: How does one, having established the fires, depart on a journey?

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/4-5) yathainān na virodhayed api ha śaśvad brāhmaṇanigamo bhavati |
body.translated_text: So that he does not offend them; indeed there is always a Brāhmaṇa tradition regarding this.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/5-6) prāṇān vā eṣo 'nucarān kṛtvā carati yo 'gnīn ādhāya pravasatīti |
body.translated_text: For he who departs on a journey having established the fires goes having made the <s>prāṇas</s> (vital breaths) his followers.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/6-7) katham agnīn ādhāya pravatsyan proṣya vopatiṣṭheta |
body.translated_text: How should one, about to depart or having returned after establishing the fires, approach them?

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/7-8) tūṣṇīm evety āhus | [ed. tūṣnīm]
body.translated_text: Silently, they say.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/8) tūṣṇīṃ vai śreyāṃsam ākāṅkṣanti |
body.translated_text: Silently indeed does one aspire to what is better.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/8-10) yadi manasi kurvītābhayam vo 'bhayaṃ me 'stv ity abhayaṃ haivāsya bhavaty evam upatiṣṭhamānasya ||
body.translated_text: If he resolves in his mind, 'Fearlessness to you, fearlessness to me'—fearlessness indeed becomes his when approaching thus.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/10-11) ekavacanam ekāgnau |
body.translated_text: The singular form is used when there is a single fire.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/11-12) purā chāyānāṃ saṃbhedād gārhapatyād āhavanīyam abhyuddharet | [ed. abyuddh-]
body.translated_text: Before the shadows merge, one should carry forth the <s>Āhavanīya</s> from the <s>Gārhapatya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/12-13) mṛtyuṃ vai pāpmānaṃ chāyāṃ tarati |
body.translated_text: One crosses over death, evil, which is the shadow.

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/13) saṃpraiṣaṃ kṛtvoddharāhavanīyam iti |
body.translated_text: Having given the command: 'Carry forth the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.1:72/13-14) saṃpraiṣavarjam ekāgnau || 1 ||
body.translated_text: Without the command, when there is a single fire. || 1 ||

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:72/14-17) vācā tvā hotrā prāṇenādhvaryuṇā cakṣuṣodgātrā manasā brahmaṇā śrotreṇāgnīdhreṇaitais tvā pañcabhir ṛtvigbhir daivyair abhyuddharāmy |
body.translated_text: 'With speech as the <s>Hotṛ</s>, with breath as the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, with sight as the <s>Udgātṛ</s>, with mind as the <s>Brahman</s> (priest), with hearing as the <s>Agnīdhra</s>—with these five divine <s>ṛtvij</s> (priests) I carry you forth.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:72/17-18) uddhriyamāṇa uddhara pāpmano mā yad avidvān yac ca vidvāṃś cakāra |
body.translated_text: 'Being carried forth, carry forth from sins—what I did unknowingly and what I did knowingly.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:72/18-19) ahnā yad enaḥ kṛtam asti pāpaṃ sarvasmād enasa uddhṛto muñca tasmād iti sāyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever sin and evil has been committed by day—from all that sin, being carried forth, release him'—thus in the evening.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:72/19-20) rātryā yad enaḥ kṛtam asti pāpam iti prātar |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever sin and evil has been committed by night'—thus in the morning.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:72/20-21) amṛtāhutim amṛtāyāṃ juhomy agniṃ pṛthivyā adityā upasthe |
body.translated_text: 'I offer an immortal oblation to the immortal, to <s>Agni</s> in the lap of the earth, of <s>Aditi</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:72/21-22) tayānantaṃ lokam ahaṃ jayāmi prajāpatir yaṃ prathamo jigāya |
body.translated_text: 'By her may I win the infinite world, which <s>Prajāpati</s> first conquered.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:72-73/22-1) agnir jyotir jyotir agnir iti sāyaṃ |
body.translated_text: '<s>Agni</s> is light, light is <s>Agni</s>'—thus in the evening.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/1) sūryo jyotiḥ jyotiḥ sūrya iti prātar |
body.translated_text: '<s>Sūrya</s> is light, light is <s>Sūrya</s>'—thus in the morning.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/2) hiraṇyam antar dhārayet |
body.translated_text: One should place gold inside.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/2-3) ārṣeyas tat paśyann āhavanīyam abhyuddharet |
body.translated_text: One of <s>ṛṣi</s>-lineage, looking at it, should carry forth the <s>Āhavanīya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/3-4) atha yasyāhavanīyam abhyuddhṛtam ādityo 'bhyastam iyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if for one whose <s>Āhavanīya</s> has been carried forth the sun should set—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that?

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/4-5) darbheṇa hiraṇyaṃ baddhvā paścād dhārayet |
body.translated_text: Having tied gold with <s>darbha</s> grass, he should place it behind.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/5-6) ārṣeyas tat paśyann agnim āhavanīyam abhyuddharet |
body.translated_text: One of <s>ṛṣi</s>-lineage, looking at it, should carry forth the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/6-7) atha yasyāhavanīyam abhyuddhṛtam ādityo 'bhyudiyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if for one whose <s>Āhavanīya</s> has been carried forth the sun should rise—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/7-8) darbheṇa rajataṃ baddhvā purastād dhārayet | [see corrigenda p. 251]
body.translated_text: Having tied silver with <s>darbha</s> grass, he should place it in front.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/8-9) ārṣeyas tat paśyann āhavanīyam abhyuddharet |
body.translated_text: One of <s>ṛṣi</s>-lineage, looking at it, should carry forth the <s>Āhavanīya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/9-10) atha yasya sāyam ahutam agnihotraṃ prātar ādityo 'bhyudiyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if for one whose <s>Agnihotra</s> was not offered in the evening the sun should rise in the morning—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/10-11) maitraḥ puroḍāśaś carur vā |
body.translated_text: A <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake) sacred to <s>Mitra</s>, or a <s>caru</s> (porridge).

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/11-13) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ saṃsthitahomeṣu <mitraḥ pṛthivyā adhyakṣa [PS 15.7.1]> iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations being performed; among the concluded oblations, after inserting '<s>Mitra</s>, the overseer of the earth' in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> (residual) portions.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/13-14) atha yasya prātar akṛtam agnihotraṃ sāyam ādityo 'bhyastamiyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if for one whose <s>Agnihotra</s> was not performed in the morning the sun should set in the evening—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/14-15) vāruṇaḥ puroḍāśo nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: A <s>puroḍāśa</s> sacred to <s>Varuṇa</s>; the regular preliminary oblations.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/15-16) saṃsthitahomeṣu <yat kiṃ cedaṃ varuṇa [PS 19.43.5, ;SS 6.51.3]> |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, [the verse] 'Whatever, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, [we have done].'

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/16) iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: After inserting it in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/17-18) atha yasya prātar ahutam agnihotram ādityo 'bhyudiyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if for one whose <s>Agnihotra</s> was not offered in the morning the sun should rise—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/18) maitraḥ puroḍāśo nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: A <s>puroḍāśa</s> sacred to <s>Mitra</s>; the regular preliminary oblations.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/19-20) saṃsthitahomeṣu <mitraḥ pṛthivyā adhyakṣa [PS 15.7.1]> iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, after inserting '<s>Mitra</s>, the overseer of the earth' in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_1.2:73/20-21) āhutī vaitābhyām ṛgbhyāṃ juhuyāt || 2 ||
body.translated_text: He should offer two oblations with these two <s>ṛc</s> verses. || 2 ||

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:73/22-23) atha yo 'gnihotreṇodeti svargaṃ vā eṣa lokaṃ yajamānam abhivahati |
body.translated_text: Now, he who rises with the <s>Agnihotra</s>—verily this [sun] carries the sacrificer to the heavenly world.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:73/23) nāhutvāvarteta |
body.translated_text: He should not turn back without having offered.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:73/23-24) sa yady āvarteta svargād evainaṃ tal lokād āvarteta |
body.translated_text: If he should turn back, he would turn back from that heavenly world itself.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:73-74/24-1) atha yasyāgnihotraṃ hūyamānaṃ skandet kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if the <s>Agnihotra</s> being offered should spill—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/1-2) apareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānv ācyopaviśati |
body.translated_text: He sits down to the south of the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, touching the ground with his right knee.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/2) yat srucy atiśiṣṭaṃ syāt taj juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Whatever is left over in the ladle, that he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/3-5) atha yatraivāvaskannaṃ bhavati taṃ deśam abhivimṛjya <vimṛgvarīṃ pṛthivīm ā vadāmi [PS 17.3.9, ;SS 12.1.29]>_iti prāṅmukho(!)paviśya_<agnir bhūmyām [PS 17.2.8, ;SS 12.1.19]> iti tisṛbhir ālabhyābhimantrayeta |
body.translated_text: Then, having wiped the very spot where the spilling occurred, [reciting] 'I address the earth that wipes away,' facing east and sitting down, he should touch and consecrate with the three [verses beginning] '<s>Agni</s> on the earth.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/5-7) atha cet sarvam eva skannaṃ syād yac carusthālyām atiśiṣṭaṃ syāt taj juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if everything has spilled, whatever is left over in the cooking pot, that he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/5-7) athāhavanīya ājyāhutiṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Then he should offer an <s>ājya</s> oblation in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>,

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/7-8) <yan me skannam [KauśS 6.1, VaitS 16.17]> ity etayarcā |
body.translated_text: with the verse 'Whatever of mine has spilled.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/8-10) <yan me skannaṃ manaso jātavedo yad vā 'skandad dhaviṣo yatra-yatra utpruṣo viprusaḥ saṃjuhomi satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ svāhā [KauśS 6.1]>_ity |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever of mine has spilled, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, from the mind, or whatever of the oblation has spilled here and there—I offer together the drops and scattered drops. May the desires of the sacrificer come true, <s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: % note case of pratīka/sakalapāṭha
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: case of pratīka/sakalapāṭha]

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/10-11) atha yasyāgnihotre 'medhyam āpadyeta kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if something impure should fall into one's <s>Agnihotra</s>—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/11-13) apareṇāhavanīyam uṣṇam iva bhasma nirūhya tatra tām āhutiṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Having removed ash, still warm as it were, to the west of the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, he should offer that oblation there.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/13) tad dhutaṃ cāhutaṃ ca bhavati |
body.translated_text: That becomes both offered and unoffered.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/13-14) yac carusthālyām atiśiṣṭaṃ syāt taj juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Whatever is left over in the cooking pot, that he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/14-15) atha cec carusthālyām evāmedhyam āpadyeta kā tatra prāyaścittis |
body.translated_text: Now, if something impure should fall into the cooking pot itself—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/15-17) tat tathaiva hutvāthānyām āhūya dohayitvā śrapayitvā tad asmai tatraivāsīnāyānvāhareyur |
body.translated_text: Having offered that in the same way, then having summoned another [cow], having it milked and cooked, they should bring it to him as he sits right there.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/17-18) (atha ūrdhvaṃ prasiddham agnihotram) |
body.translated_text: (Then onwards, the <s>Agnihotra</s> proceeds as established.)

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:74/18-20) atha yasyāhavanīyagārhapatyāv antareṇa yāno vā ratho vā nivarteta śvā vānyo vābhidhāvet kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if between the <s>Āhavanīya</s> and the <s>Gārhapatya</s> a vehicle or chariot should turn, or a dog or something else should run across—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:75/1-2) mantravanti ca kāryāṇi sarvāṇy adhyayanaṃ ca yat | nāntarāgamanaṃ teṣāṃ sādhu vichedanād bhayam ||
body.translated_text: 'All ritual acts accompanied by <s>mantras</s>, and Vedic study—there should be no passing between them; there is danger from the breaking of continuity.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:75/3-4) iti gārhapatyād adhy āhavanīya udatantuṃ niṣiñcan iyāt ||
body.translated_text: Thus, from the <s>Gārhapatya</s> toward the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, he should go pouring water in a continuous stream.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:75/4-6) <tantuṃ tanvan rajaso bhānum anv ihi jyotiṣmataḥ patho rakṣa dhiyā kṛtān || anulbaṇaṃ vayata joguvām apo || manur bhava janayā daivyaṃ janam || [.RV 10.53.6 etc.]>
body.translated_text: 'Stretching the thread, follow the light of the atmosphere; guard the paths made by thought, shining with light. Weave a web not entangled. Become <s>Manu</s>; generate the divine race.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:75-76/6-1) <taṃnvaṃs tantur upa sedur agne tvaṃ pathā rajasi devayānaḥ | tvayā 'gne pṛṣṭhaṃ vayam āruhemādhā devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ madema ||> [cf. Baudh;SS 13.43:150.8 <tvaṃ nas tantur uta setur agne><tvaṃ panthā bhavasi devayānaḥ><tvayāgne pṛṣṭhaṃ vayam āruhema [TB.2.4.2.6]><athā devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ madema>]
body.translated_text: 'Stretching that thread, they approached. O <s>Agni</s>, you are the path along the divine realm. Through you, O <s>Agni</s>, may we ascend to the summit; then with the gods may we rejoice in the feast.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:76/1-2) svāheti sarvatraitat prāyaścittam antarāgamane smṛtam ||
body.translated_text: With '<s>svāhā</s>'—this is everywhere the prescribed <s>prāyaścitta</s> for passing between, as remembered.

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:76/3) yajñasya saṃtatir asi yajñasya tvā saṃtatyā saṃtanomi |
body.translated_text: 'You are the continuity of the sacrifice; with the continuity of the sacrifice I extend you.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:76/4-6) vasūnāṃ rudrāṇām ādityānāṃ marutām ṛṣīṇāṃ bhṛgūṇām a"ngirasām atharvaṇāṃ brahmaṇaḥ saṃtatir asi brahmaṇas tvā samtatyā saṃtanomi |
body.translated_text: 'You are the continuity of the <s>Vasus</s>, the <s>Rudras</s>, the <s>Ādityas</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, the <s>Ṛṣis</s>, the <s>Bhṛgus</s>, the <s>Aṅgirasas</s>, the <s>Atharvans</s>, of <s>Brahman</s>; with the continuity of <s>Brahman</s> I extend you.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.3:76/6-8) <yan me chidraṃ manaso yac ca vācaḥ sarasvatī manyumantam jagāma viśvais tad devaiḥ saha saṃvidānaḥ saṃ dadhātu bṛhaspatiḥ [PS 19.38.6, ;SS 19.40.1]> || 3 ||
body.translated_text: 'Whatever breach there is in my mind or in my speech, which <s>Sarasvatī</s> has gone to with anger—may <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, in accord with all the gods, set that right.' || 3 ||

body.text: (AVPr_1.4:76/8-10) <mā na āpo medhāṃ mā brahma pramathiṣṭana | śuṣyadā yūyaṃ syandadhvam upahūto 'haṃ sumedhā varcasvī [PS 20.60.3, ;SS 19.40.2]> |
body.translated_text: 'O waters, do not destroy our wisdom, nor our <s>Brahman</s>. You who dry up, flow forth—I who am invoked, endowed with good wisdom and splendor.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.4:76/10-12) <mā no medhāṃ mā no dīkṣāṃ mā no hiṃsiṣṭaṃ yat tapaḥ śivā naḥ saṃsvaṃta āyuṣe śivā bhavantu mātaraḥ [PS 20.60.4, ;SS 19.40.3]> |
body.translated_text: 'Do not injure our wisdom, nor our <s>dīkṣā</s> (consecration), nor our <s>tapas</s> (austerity). May the flowing waters be auspicious for our life; may the mothers be auspicious.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.4:76/12-13) <namas te pathyā revati svasti mā parā-yaṇaḥ | svasti mā punarāyaṇaḥ [PS 20.61.1/2]> |
body.translated_text: 'Homage to you, O <s>Pathyā Revatī</s>! Be auspicious to me in departing; be auspicious to me in returning.'

body.text: % note mantra from PS 20, and relevance for stanza division in PS!
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: mantra from PS 20, and relevance for stanza division in PS]
'O waters, do not [destroy] our wisdom.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.4:76/14) <punar maitv indriyam [PS 3.13.6, ;SS 7.67.1]> iti ca ||4||
body.translated_text: 'May my vital power return to me'—and with this. || 4 ||

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:76/14-15) atha yasyāhavanīyo 'gnir jāgṛyād gārhapatya upaśāmyet kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire should blaze up while the <s>Gārhapatya</s> subsides—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:76-77/15-2) yat prā~ncam udvartayati tenāyatanā[c] cyavate yat pratyañcam asuravad yajñaṃ tanoti |
body.translated_text: If one fans it forward, it falls from its proper place; if backward, one performs the sacrifice in the manner of the <s>Asuras</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/2-3) yad anugamayatīśvarā vainaṃ tat prāṇā hāsyur iti vā |
body.translated_text: If one has it follow along, the <s>prāṇas</s> (vital breaths) would indeed leave him.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/3) atha nu katham iti |
body.translated_text: But then, how should one proceed?

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/4-6) sabhasmakam āhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇena dakṣiṇāgniṃ parihṛtya gārhapatyasyāyatane pratiṣṭhāpya tata āhavanīyaṃ praṇayet |
body.translated_text: Having carried the <s>Āhavanīya</s> with its ashes to the south of the <s>Dakṣiṇāgni</s>, having established it in the place of the <s>Gārhapatya</s>, from there one should lead forth the <s>Āhavanīya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/6-8) <bhadrād abhi śreyaḥ prehi [cf. PS 20.4.2, ;SS 7.8.1: adhi]> ity etayarca@@ gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāyotpūya caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīyagārhapatyāv antareṇa vyavetya juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: With the verse 'From the auspicious, go toward the better'—having melted <s>ājya</s> (ghee) in the <s>Gārhapatya</s>, having poured it out and taken a fourfold portion, passing between the <s>Āhavanīya</s> and <s>Gārhapatya</s>, he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/8-11) <ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣa [PS 20.61.5-6, sakala at KauśS 89.13]> iti dvābhyām etena u vā asya saṃtvaramāṇasyāhavanīyagārhapatyau janitāv <ayaṃ mā loko 'nusaṃtanutām [VaitS 7.12]> ity | [ed. janitā vayaṃ]
body.translated_text: With the two [verses] 'This <s>Agni</s> of ours, the overseer'—by this, for one acting quickly, the <s>Āhavanīya</s> and <s>Gārhapatya</s> are generated—[with] 'May this world extend me.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/11-12) etena ha vā asya saṃtvaramāṇasyāhavanīyagārhapatyau pāpmānam apahataḥ |
body.translated_text: By this indeed, for one acting quickly, sin is removed from the <s>Āhavanīya</s> and <s>Gārhapatya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/12-13) so 'pahatapāpmā jyotir bhūtvā devān apy etīti |
body.translated_text: He, having removed sin, becoming light, goes to the gods.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/13-14) athāhavanīya ājyāhutiṃ juhuyād <asapatnaṃ purastād [PS 10.8.4/12.6.5, ;SS 19.16.1]> ity etayarcā |
body.translated_text: Then he should offer an <s>ājya</s> oblation in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with the verse 'Without rival, from the front.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/14-15) atha yasyāgnihotraṃ śrapyamāṇaṃ viṣyandet tad adbhir upaninayet |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's <s>Agnihotra</s> being cooked should overflow, he should lead it down with water.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/16) tad anumantrayate |
body.translated_text: He consecrates that with mantras.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/16) <pṛthivīṃ turīyam [cf. AB 7.5.3]> ity etābhiḥ |
body.translated_text: With 'The earth, a quarter'—with these verses.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/16-17) <pṛthivīṃ turīyaṃ manuṣyān yajño 'gāt | tato mā draviṇam āṣṭa |
body.translated_text: 'The sacrifice went to the earth as a quarter, to humans. From there may it bring me wealth.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/18-20) aṃtarikṣe turīyaṃ | divi turīyam | (apsu turīyam | apsv ity āha bhūtāni tāni | devān yajño 'gāt | tato mā draviṇam āṣṭa |)
body.translated_text: 'To the atmosphere as a quarter; to heaven as a quarter; to the waters as a quarter—to the waters, it is said, are the beings. The sacrifice went to the gods. From there may it bring me wealth.'

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/20-21) <trātāram indram [PS 5.4.11, ;SS 7.86.1] | <yayor ojasā [PS 20.15.10, ;SS 7.25.1]>_iti caitā viṣṇuvaruṇadevatyā ṛco japati |
body.translated_text: '<s>Indra</s> the protector'; 'By whose might'—and these verses addressed to <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> he recites.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/21-22) yad vai yajñasya viriṣṭaṃ tad vaiṣṇavaṃ |
body.translated_text: For whatever in the sacrifice is damaged, that belongs to <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/22) yad guṣpitaṃ tad vāruṇaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever is tangled, that belongs to <s>Varuṇa</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/23) yajñasya vā ṛddhir |
body.translated_text: Or, it concerns the prosperity of the sacrifice.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77/23-24) bhūyiṣṭhām ṛddhim āpnoti yatraitā viṣṇuvaruṇadevatyā ṛco japaty |
body.translated_text: One obtains the greatest prosperity wherever these verses addressed to <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> are recited.

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:77-78/24-1) athādbhuteṣv etā eva tisro japet |
body.translated_text: And in the case of portents (<s>adbhuta</s>), one should recite these same three [verses].

body.text: (AVPr_1.5:78/1-2) tisro japet || 5 || iti yajñaprāyaścittasūtre prathamo 'dhyāyah samāptaḥ |
body.translated_text: One should recite three. || 5 || Thus ends the first chapter of the <s>Yajñaprāyaścittasūtra</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/3-4) atha yasya purodāśe 'medhyam āpadyeta kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if something impure should fall into the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake)—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/4-6) ājyenābhighārya <apsv antar [PS 1.2.4, ;SS 1.4.4]> iti sakṛd evāpsu hutvāthāhavanīya ājyāhutī juhuyād <asapatnaṃ purastād [PS 10.8.4/12.6.5, ;SS 19.16.1]> ity etābhyām ṛgbhyām |
body.translated_text: Having basted it with <s>ājya</s> (ghee), offering it once into the waters with [the verse] 'In the waters within,' then he should offer two <s>ājya</s> oblations in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with the two verses 'Without rival, from the front.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/6-7) atha yasya puroḍāśaḥ kṣāmo bhavati kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's <s>puroḍāśa</s> becomes burnt—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/7-8) so 'gnaye kṣāmavate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should prepare an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Kṣāmavat</s> (Agni associated with burning).

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/8) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/8-10) saṃsthitahomeṣu <pṛtanājitaṃ sahamānam [PS 20.33.9, ;SS 7.63.1]> iti madhyata opya tathā saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, after inserting 'The conqueror of armies, the prevailing one' in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions in the same manner.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/10-11) athāhavanīye tābhyām ṛgbhyām |
body.translated_text: Then in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with those two verses.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/11-12) atha yasyāgnihotraṃ tṛtīye nityahomakāle vichidyeta kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's <s>Agnihotra</s> is interrupted at the third regular time of offering—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/12-13) so 'gnaye tantumate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should prepare an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Tantumat</s> (Agni of the thread/continuity).

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/13) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/13-16) saṃsthitahomeṣu <tvam agne saprathā asi juṣṭo hotā vareṇyaḥ | tvayā yajñaṃ vi tanvate [PSK 20.51.7]> iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ samsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, after inserting 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, are widely spread, the beloved <s>Hotṛ</s>, the most excellent; through you they spread the sacrifice' in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: % note mantra from PSK 20 untraced in PSO
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: mantra from PSK 20, untraced in PSO]

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/16-17) <asapatnaṃ purastād [see above]> ity etābhyām ṛgbhyām |
body.translated_text: With the two verses 'Without rival, from the front.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/17-18) atha yasya sāṃnāyyaṃ vyāpadyeta kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's <s>sāṃnāyya</s> (mixture of fresh and sour milk) is spoiled—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/18) prātardohaṃ dvaidhaṃ kṛtvā tena yajeta |
body.translated_text: Dividing the morning milking into two parts, he should sacrifice with that.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/19-20) atha āhavanīya ājyāhutiṃ juhuyāt <trātāram indram [see above]> ity etayarcā |
body.translated_text: Then he should offer an <s>ājya</s> oblation in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with the verse '<s>Indra</s> the protector.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/20-21) prātardohaṃ ced apahareyuḥ sāyaṃdohaṃ dvaidhaṃ kṛtvā tena yajeta |
body.translated_text: If the morning milking is taken away, dividing the evening milking into two parts, he should sacrifice with that.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/21-22) athāhavanīya ājyāhutiṃ juhuyāt <trātāram indram [see above]> ity etayarcā |
body.translated_text: Then he should offer an <s>ājya</s> oblation in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with the verse '<s>Indra</s> the protector.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/22-23) atha cet sarvam eva sāṃnāyyaṃ vyāpadyeta kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if all of the <s>sāṃnāyya</s> is entirely spoiled—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/23-25) aindraṃ puroḍāśaṃ māhendraṃ vā sāṃnāyyasyāyatane pratiṣṭhāpya tena yajeta |
body.translated_text: Having established a <s>puroḍāśa</s> sacred to <s>Indra</s> or to <s>Mahendra</s> in the place of the <s>sāṃnāyya</s>, he should sacrifice with that.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/25-26) athāhavanīya ājyāhutiṃ juhuyāt <trātāram indram [see above]> ity etayarcā |
body.translated_text: Then he should offer an <s>ājya</s> oblation in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with the verse '<s>Indra</s> the protector.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/26-27) atha yasya havīṃṣi vyāpadyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's oblation materials are spoiled—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78/27) ājyasyaitāni nirupya tena yajeta |
body.translated_text: Having substituted <s>ājya</s> for them, he should sacrifice with that.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:78-79/27-1) athāhavanīya ājyāhutiṃ juhuyāt <trātāram indram [see above]> ity etayarcā |
body.translated_text: Then he should offer an <s>ājya</s> oblation in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with the verse '<s>Indra</s> the protector.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:79/1-2) atha cet sarvāṇy eva havīṃṣi vyāpadyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if all the oblation materials are entirely spoiled—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:79/2-3) ājyasyaitāni nirupyaitayājyahaviṣeṣṭyā yajeran |
body.translated_text: Having substituted <s>ājya</s> for them, they should sacrifice with a sacrifice consisting solely of <s>ājya</s> oblations.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:79/3) ity api hi kīrtita[ṃ] |
body.translated_text: For thus it has been declared.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:79/3) madhyā[s] tv eva bhavanti |
body.translated_text: But the middle [offerings] remain as they are.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:79/4) tair yajeta |
body.translated_text: He should sacrifice with those.

body.text: (AVPr_2.1:79/4-5) athāhavanīya ājyāhutiṃ juhuyāt <trātāram indram [see above]> ity etayarcā || 1 ||
body.translated_text: Then he should offer an <s>ājya</s> oblation in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with the verse '<s>Indra</s> the protector.' || 1 ||

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/5-6) athāto dṛṣṭābhyuddṛṣṭāṇīty ācakṣate |
body.translated_text: Now, these are called the 'observed and re-observed' [rites].

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/6) adya sāyam amāvāsyā bhaviṣyatīti |
body.translated_text: 'This evening will be the new-moon day.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/6-7) na pratiharaṇāya ca sa syāt |
body.translated_text: And he should not be available for the return [of the offering].

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/7-8) atha sa yo 'nyo brūyād adarśaṃ cādya purastād iti taṃ tu kim iti brūyāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if someone else should say, 'I did not see [the moon] today in the east'—he should say, 'What of that?'

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/8) atha vā |
body.translated_text: Or alternatively,

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/8-9) sa syād evādhas |
body.translated_text: he would indeed be below.

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/9) tām eva prāyaścittiṃ kṛtvā yajeteti dvaipāyanaḥ |
body.translated_text: Having performed that very <s>prāyaścitta</s>, he should sacrifice—thus says <s>Dvaipāyana</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/10) kṛtasya vai prāyaścittir bhavatīti lāṅgaliḥ |
body.translated_text: 'There is <s>prāyaścitta</s> for what has already been done'—thus says <s>Lāṅgali</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/10-11) samāpyaiva tena haviṣā yaddaivataṃ tad dhavi[ḥ] syāt |
body.translated_text: Having completed [the rite] with that very offering, whatever deity belongs to that oblation, that should be the offering.

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/12-13) athānyad dhavir nirvaped agnaye dātre puroḍāśam indrāya pradātre puroḍāśaṃ viṣnave śipiviṣṭāya puroḍāśam |
body.translated_text: Then he should prepare another offering: a <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Dātṛ</s> (Agni the Giver), a <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Indra Pradātṛ</s> (Indra the Bestower), and a <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/13-14) athaitān yathāniruptāṃs tredhā kuryād yathā brāhmaṇoktaṃ |
body.translated_text: Then he should divide those, as they were prepared, into three parts, as stated in the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79/15) nityāḥ purastaddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:79-80/15-1) saṃsthitahomeṣv <agniṃ vayaṃ trātāraṃ havāmahe ya imaṃ trāyatām asmād yakṣmād asmād āmayata[ḥ] | [PS 2.50.1]>
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, 'We invoke <s>Agni</s> the protector; may he protect this one from this <s>yakṣma</s> (disease), from this affliction.'

body.text: % note PS mantra
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: PS mantra]

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:80/1) <trātāram indram [see above]> |
body.translated_text: '<s>Indra</s> the protector.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:80/1-2) <uru viṣṇo vikramasva [PS 20.7.7, ;SS 7.26.3c]>_iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: 'Stride widely, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>'—after inserting in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_2.2:80/2-3) pāthikṛtīty ācakṣate paurṇamāsyamāvāsyeti cātipanne || 2 ||
body.translated_text: This is called the <s>Pāthikṛtī</s> (path-making rite), when the full-moon or new-moon [offering] has lapsed. || 2 ||

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/1) athāto 'bhyu[d]dṛṣṭānīty ācakṣate |
body.translated_text: Now, these are called the 're-observed' [rites].

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/1-2) adya sāyam amāvāsyā bhaviṣyatīti na pratiharaṇāya ca sa syāt |
body.translated_text: 'This evening will be the new-moon day'—and he should not be available for the return [of the offering].

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/2-4) atha sa yo 'nyo brūyād adarśaṃ cādya paścād iti taṃ tu kim iti brūyāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if someone else should say, 'I did not see [the moon] today in the west'—he should say, 'What of that?'

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/4) atha vā sa syād evādhas |
body.translated_text: Or alternatively, he would indeed be below.

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/4-5) tām eva prāyaścittiṃ kṛtvā yajeteti dvaipāyanaḥ |
body.translated_text: Having performed that very <s>prāyaścitta</s>, he should sacrifice—thus says <s>Dvaipāyana</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/5-6) kṛtasya vai prāyaścittir bhavatīti lāṅgalir |
body.translated_text: 'There is <s>prāyaścitta</s> for what has already been done'—thus says <s>Lāṅgali</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/6-8) <yena pathā vaivasvato yamo rājā no yayau agnir nas tena nayatu prajā[na]n vaiśvānaraḥ pathikṛd viśvagṛṣṭiḥ [PS 5.6.7]> |
body.translated_text: 'By which path <s>Yama Vaivasvata</s>, the king, departed—may <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, the knower of creatures, the path-maker, the all-radiating, lead us by that path.'

body.text: % note PS mantra, not closed by iti
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: PS mantra, not closed by 'iti']

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/8-9) samāpyaiva tena haviṣā yad daivataṃ tad dhaviḥ syāt |
body.translated_text: Having completed [the rite] with that very offering, whatever deity belongs to that oblation, that should be the offering.

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/9) athānyad dhavir nirvapet |
body.translated_text: Then he should prepare another offering:

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/9-11) agnaye pathikṛte puroḍāśam indrāya vṛtraghne puroḍāśaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ |
body.translated_text: a <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Pathikṛt</s> (Agni the Path-maker), a <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Indra Vṛtraghna</s> (Indra the Slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>), and a twelve-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Vaiśvānara</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/11) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/12) saṃsthitahomeṣu <tvam agne saprathā asi [see above]> |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, are widely spread.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/12-13) <yena pathā vaivasvataḥ [see above]> |
body.translated_text: 'By which path <s>Vaivasvata</s> [departed].'

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/13) <śāsa itthā mahān asi [PS 2.88.1, ;SS 1.20.4]> |
body.translated_text: 'O ruler, thus you are great.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/13-14) <vaiśvānaro na ūtaye [PS 19.9.4, ;SS 6.35.1]> iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: '<s>Vaiśvānara</s>, for our aid'—after inserting in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/14-15) mahāpāthikṛtīty ācakṣate |
body.translated_text: This is called the <s>Mahāpāthikṛtī</s> (great path-making rite).

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/15) ubhayor api pattayos |
body.translated_text: For both kinds of lapse.

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/15-16) tad āhur na te vidur ye tathā kurvanty |
body.translated_text: They say: those who do it that way do not know [the correct procedure].

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/16) atha nu katham iti |
body.translated_text: But then, how [should one proceed]?

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/16-18) gārhapatyājyaṃ vilāyotpūya caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīyagārhapatyāv antareṇātivrajya juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Having melted <s>ājya</s> in the <s>Gārhapatya</s>, having poured it out and taken a fourfold portion, passing between the <s>Āhavanīya</s> and <s>Gārhapatya</s>, he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/18-20) <asau ya udayāt puro vasāno nīlalohito 'tha dṛṣṭam adṛṣṭaṃ no duṣkṛtaṃ tat svāhā [?]>_ity |
body.translated_text: 'He who rises in the east, clothed in dark-red—whatever seen and unseen evil we have done, <s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/20) evam evābhyu[d]dṛṣṭe |
body.translated_text: Likewise in the case of the 're-observed':—

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81/20-22) <asau ya udayāt paścād vasāno nīlalohito [tya] 'tha dṛṣṭam adṛṣṭaṃ no duṣkṛtaṃ karat svāhā [?]>_iti |
body.translated_text: 'He who rises in the west, clothed in dark-red—whatever seen and unseen evil we have done, may he destroy it, <s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: % cf. with the mantra(s) just quoted: PS 20.25.1d
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: cf. with the mantra(s) just quoted: PS 20.25.1d]

body.text: (AVPr_2.3:81-82/22-1) sa ya evam etena tejasājyena yaśasā prīṇāti so 'syaiṣa dṛṣṭaḥ prāṇān yaśasā prīṇāti || 3 ||
body.translated_text: He who thus gratifies with this radiant <s>ājya</s> and with glory—this observed [rite] of his gratifies the <s>prāṇas</s> (vital breaths) with glory. || 3 ||

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/1-2) atha yo 'hutvā navaṃ prāśnīyād agnau vāgamayet kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one should eat new [grain] without having offered, or should bring it near the fire—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/2-3) so 'gnaye vratapataye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should prepare an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Vratapati</s> (Agni the Lord of Vows).

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/3) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/3-4) saṃsthitahomeṣv <agne prāśnāhi prathamas tvaṃ hi vettha yathā haviḥ [?]> |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, 'O <s>Agni</s>, partake first, for you know the offering.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/4-6) <vanvan havir yathā devebhyo yajamānaṃ ca varddhaya [?]> <agniś ca deva savitas [PS 19.27.1]> |
body.translated_text: 'Enjoying the oblation, increase the sacrificer among the gods.' '<s>Agni</s> and the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/6-7) <tvam agne vratapā asi [PS 19.47.4, ;SS 19.59.1]>| <idāvatsarāya [PS 19.51.1]>_iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the protector of vows.' '<s>Idā</s>, for the year'—after inserting in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: % note PS mantras
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: PS mantras]

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/7-11) yady anugatam agniṃ śaṅkamānā mantheyur mathite 'gnim adhigacheyur <bhadrād adhi śreyaḥ prehi [PS 20.4.2, ;SS 7.8.1]>_iti vyāhṛtibhiś ca mathitaṃ samāropyāthetarasmin <punas tvā prāṇaḥ [PS 12.19.3 (20.14.2?)]>_iti pañcabhir ājyāhutīr hutvā yathoktaṃ prākṛtā vṛttir |
body.translated_text: If, suspecting that the fire has followed, they should churn [a new fire], and upon finding fire in the churned one—with 'From the auspicious, go toward the better' and with the <s>vyāhṛtis</s>, placing [the fire] upon the churned one, then with 'May breath return to you' offering five <s>ājya</s> oblations, the natural procedure [resumes] as prescribed.

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/11-12) atha yasyāgnihotrī gharmadughā duhyamānā vāśyet kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's <s>Agnihotrī</s> cow or the <s>Gharma</s>-milking cow should low while being milked—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/12-15) aśanāpipāse evaiṣā yajamānasya saṃprakhyāya vāśyatīti tāṃ tṛṇam apy ādayet <sūyavasād bhagavatī [PS 16.69.10/20.12.4, ;SS 7.73.11/9.10.20]>_ity etayarcā |
body.translated_text: It is indeed hunger and thirst that she proclaims on behalf of the sacrificer by her lowing—one should give her grass with the verse 'The auspicious one rich in pasture.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/15-16) athāhavanīya ājyāhutīr juhuyād <dhātā dadhātu naḥ [PS 1.39.4, ;SS 7.17.1]> <pūrṇā darva [PS 1.106.5, ;SS 3.10.7]> iti dvābhyām ṛgbhyām |
body.translated_text: Then he should offer <s>ājya</s> oblations in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with the two verses '<s>Dhātṛ</s> bestow upon us' and 'Full ladle.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82/16-18) atha yasyāgnihotrī gharmadughā (vā) duhyamānopaviśet kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's <s>Agnihotrī</s> cow or the <s>Gharma</s>-milking cow should sit down while being milked—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:82-83/18-1) bhayaṃ vā eṣā yajamānasya prakhyāyopaviśati |
body.translated_text: It is indeed fear that she proclaims on behalf of the sacrificer by sitting down.

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:83/1-2) tasyā ūdhasy udapātraṃ ninayet_<śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaye [PS 1.1, ;SS 1.6.1]>_iti dvābhyāṃ |
body.translated_text: One should pour a pot of water upon her udder, with the two [verses] 'May the divine waters be auspicious for our aid.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:83/2-4) tām anumantrayate <yasmād bhītā niṣīdasi tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi paśūn naḥ sarvān gopāya namo rudrāya mīḍhuṣe [?]>_ity |
body.translated_text: He addresses her: 'From whatever you fear and sit down, from that make us fearless. Protect all our cattle. Homage to <s>Rudra</s> the bountiful.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:83/4-5) athainām utthāpayaty <ut tisṭha devy adite devān yajñena bodhaya | indrāya kṛṇvatī bhāgaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya ca [cf. ;SS 19.63.1]>_ity |
body.translated_text: Then he raises her up: 'Stand up, O goddess <s>Aditi</s>; awaken the gods with the sacrifice, making a share for <s>Indra</s>, for <s>Mitra</s>, and for <s>Varuṇa</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:83/5-8) utthitām anumantrayate <ud asthād devy adite devān yajñena bodhaya | āyuś ca tasya bhūtiṃ ca yajamānaṃ ca vardhaya [cf. ;SS 19.63.1]>_ity |
body.translated_text: He addresses her after she has risen: 'The goddess <s>Aditi</s> has stood up; awaken the gods with the sacrifice. Increase the life, prosperity, and [welfare of] the sacrificer.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.4:83/8-10) athāhavanīya ājyāhutīr juhuyān <mā no vidan [PS 1.20.1, ;SS 1.19.1]> ity etair abhayai raudraiś ca || 4 ||
body.translated_text: Then he should offer <s>ājya</s> oblations in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with 'May they not find us' and with these 'fearlessness' and <s>Raudra</s> verses. || 4 ||

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:83/10-12) atha yasya vapām āhutiṃ vā gṛhītāṃ śyenaḥ śakuniḥ śvā vānyo vāhared vāto vā vivamet kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if a hawk, a bird, a dog, or something else should carry away one's <s>vapā</s> (omentum) or an offering already taken up, or if the wind should scatter it—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:83/12-13) <divaṃ pṛthivīm [PS 3.12.7, ;SS 3.21.7]> ity abhimantryāthāhavanīya ājyāhutīr juhuyād <vāta ā vātu bheṣajam [PS 19.46.7, KauśS 117.3-4]> iti sūktena |
body.translated_text: Having consecrated it with 'Heaven and earth,' then he should offer <s>ājya</s> oblations in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with the hymn '<s>Vāta</s>, blow forth healing.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:83/14) atha yasya somagraho gṛhīto 'tisrāvet kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if the <s>Soma</s> cup (<s>graha</s>) already drawn should overflow—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:83/15-16) <drapsaś caskanda [PS 18.78.7/20.13.7, ;SS 18.4.28]>_ity abhimantryāthāhavanīya ājyāhutīr juhuyān <manase cetase dhiye [PS 19.10.1, ;SS 6.41.1]>_iti sūktena |
body.translated_text: Having consecrated it with 'The drop has fallen,' then he should offer <s>ājya</s> oblations in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with the hymn 'For mind, for thought, for wisdom.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:83/16-17) atha yasyāṣṭāpadī vaśā syāt kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's cow should have an eight-legged [calf]—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:83/17-18) darbheṇa hiraṇyaṃ baddhvādhyadhi garbhaṃ hiraṇyagarbheṇa juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Having tied gold with <s>darbha</s> grass, he should offer over the embryo with [the mantra] '<s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s>' (Golden Embryo).

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:83/18-23) yathāmuṃ sā garbham abhyaścotayad yathāmuṃ garbhaṃ sadarbham iva sahiraṇyaṃ tam uddhṛtya prakṣālyānupadaṃ śrapayitvā prākśirasam udakpādyaṃ kāmasūktena juhuyād anaṃgan <dhītī vā [PS 20.1.1, ;SS 7.1.1]>_ity aṣṭabhir nabhasvatībhir hiraṇyagarbheṇa vā | [ed. dhīti]
body.translated_text: Just as she has sprinkled that embryo [from her womb], so having extracted that embryo with its <s>darbha</s> and gold, having washed it and cooked it head-first with feet pointing northward, he should offer it with the <s>Kāmasūkta</s>; <s>Anaṅga</s> [or with] 'By wisdom' and the eight <s>Nabhasvatī</s> [verses], or with '<s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:83/23-24) atha yasyāsamāpte karmaṇi tāntriko 'gnir upaśāmyet kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if the ritual fire (<s>tāntrika agni</s>) should go out before the ritual is complete—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:83-84/24-2) <yaṃ tvam agne [PS 18.69.4, ;SS 18.3.6]> <punas tvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ [PS 17.30.6, ;SS 12.2.6]>_ity anyaṃ praṇīya prajvālya <mamāgne varcaḥ [PS 5.4.1, ;SS 5.3.1]>_iti sūktenopasamādhāya karmaśeṣam samāpnuyur |
body.translated_text: 'O you whom, <s>Agni</s>—'; 'May the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, and <s>Vasus</s> [restore] you again'—having led forth another [fire] and kindled it, having settled it with the hymn 'O <s>Agni</s>, my splendor,' they should complete the remainder of the ritual.

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/2-5) atha yasyāsamāpte karmaṇi barhir ādīpyeta tatra tan nirvāpya juhuyād <yad agnir barhir adahad vedyā vāso apoṃ bhata tvam eva no jātavedo duritāt pāhi tasmāt [AVPariś 37.5.2]> ||
body.translated_text: Now, if the sacred grass (<s>barhis</s>) should catch fire before the ritual is complete, having extinguished it, he should offer: 'If <s>Agni</s> has burnt the sacred grass or the garment of the altar, O bearer of waters, do you, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, protect us from that danger.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/5-6) <nirdagdhā no amitrā yathedaṃ barhis tathā | amitrāṇāṃ śriyaṃ bhūtiṃ tām eṣāṃ parinirjahi [AVPariś 37.5.3]> |
body.translated_text: 'Burnt are our enemies, just as this sacred grass is [burnt]. Destroy the prosperity and fortune of our enemies.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/7-8) <yatkāmās te juhumas tan no astu viśāmpate | ye devā yajñam āyānti te no rakṣantu sarvataḥ [AVPariś 37.5.4]> |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever we offer to you with desire, may that be ours, O lord of creatures. May the gods who come to the sacrifice protect us from all sides.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/8-9) <avadagdhaṃ duḥsvapnyam avadagdhā arātayaḥ sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ | mā tvā dabhyan yātudhānāḥ [AVPariś 37.5.5 (PS 7.7.9)]> |
body.translated_text: 'Burnt away is the bad dream, burnt away are the hostile powers and all the sorceresses. May the sorcerers not harm you.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/9-11) <mā bradhnaḥ śarmabhiḥ ṣṭuhi darbho rājā samudriyaḥ | pari naḥ pātu viśvataḥ [AVPariś 37.5.6 (PS 7.7.10)]> |
body.translated_text: 'Do not praise the reddish one with your shelters. <s>Darbha</s>, the king from the ocean, may he protect us on all sides.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/11-12) athānyad barhir upakalpyodakena saṃprokṣya punaḥ sṭṛṇāti |
body.translated_text: Then, having prepared other sacred grass, having sprinkled it with water, he spreads it again.

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/12-14) <idaṃ barhir amṛteneha siktaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ haritaṃ tat stṛtaṃ naḥ [AVPari;S 37.5.8]> |
body.translated_text: 'This sacred grass, sprinkled here with the immortal, golden, green—that is spread for us.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/14-15) <tad vai purāṇam abhinavaṃ stṛṇīṣva vāsaḥ praśastaṃ prati me gṛhāṇa [AVPari;S 37.5.8]>_iti |
body.translated_text: 'That which is ancient, spread it anew; accept from me this praiseworthy garment.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/15-16) atha yasya pitrye praṇīto 'gnir upaśāmyet kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if the fire led forth for a funeral rite should go out—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/16-20) bhasmālabhyābhimantrayed <dviṣantam agne dviṣatāṃ ca vittaṃ | prajāṃ dviṣadbhyo naya dakṣiṇena | pitrye praṇīta upaśāmyamānaḥ pāpmānam agne tam ito nudasva [?]> |
body.translated_text: Having touched the ashes, he should consecrate them: 'O <s>Agni</s>, [take] the enemy and the wealth of enemies. Lead the progeny of enemies away to the south. O you who are led forth for the funeral rite and are going out, O <s>Agni</s>, drive away that sin from here.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.5:84/20-26) <dviṣantam agne dviṣatāṃ ca vittaṃ gaccha tvam ādāya parāvato 'nyān pitrye praṇīta upaśāmyamāna iha prajāṃ dīrgham āyuś ca dhehi | yas tvam agne pramattānāṃ praṇīta upaśāmyasi [?]> <sukalpam agne ta[t] tvayā punas tvoddīpayāmasi [PS 17.30.5cd, ;SS 12.2.5cd]>_ity ucyamāne 'gniṃ praṇīya prajvālya_<indrasya kukṣir asi [PS 20.10.9, ;SS 7.111.1]>_iti dvābhyāṃ samidhāv abhyādadhyāt || 5 ||
body.translated_text: 'O <s>Agni</s>, [take] the enemy and the wealth of enemies. Go, taking others to the beyond. O you who are led forth for the funeral rite and are going out, grant progeny and long life here.' While reciting 'We kindle you again for good fortune,' having led forth the fire and kindled it, with '<s>Indra</s>'s belly you are' and with the two [verses], he should place two fuel-sticks upon it. || 5 ||

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:84-85/26-4) atha yasya yūpo virohed asamāpte karmaṇi tatra juhuyāt <yūpo virohañ chataśākho adhvaraḥ samāvṛto mohayiṣyan yajamānasya loke | vedābhigupto brahmaṇā parivṛto 'tharvabhiḥ śāntaḥ sukṛtām etu lokam || yūpo hy arukṣad dviṣatāṃ vadhāya na me yajño yajamānaś ca riṣyāt | saptarṣīṇāṃ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokas tatremaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca dhehi [KauśS 125.2]> ||
body.translated_text: Now, if the sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>) should sprout before the ritual is complete, he should offer there: 'The <s>yūpa</s>, sprouting with a hundred branches—may the sacrifice, complete, bewildering in the world of the sacrificer, guarded by the <s>Veda</s>, surrounded by <s>Brahman</s>, pacified by the <s>Atharvans</s>, go to the world of the virtuous. For the <s>yūpa</s> has sprouted for the destruction of enemies. May my sacrifice and the sacrificer not be harmed. Where is the world of the seven <s>Ṛṣis</s>, the virtuous—place this sacrifice and the sacrificer there.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:85/4-6) <yo vanaspatīnām upatāpo babhūva yad vā gṛhān ghoram utājagāma tan nirjagāmo haviṣā ghṛtena śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade [KauśS 135.9]> ||
body.translated_text: 'Whatever affliction has befallen the trees, or whatever dreadful thing has come to the houses—may we drive that away with oblation and ghee. May there be well-being for our bipeds and quadrupeds.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:85/6-9) <yo vanaspatīnām upatāpo na āgād yad vā yajñaṃ no 'dbhutam ājagāma | sarvaṃ tad agne hutam astu bhāgaśaḥ śivān vayam uttaremābhi vājān | tvaṣṭre svāhā [KauśS 135.9]>_iti hutvā |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever affliction has come upon the trees, or whatever portent has come to our sacrifice—may all that, O <s>Agni</s>, be offered portion by portion. May we cross over auspiciously to riches. To <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>.'—Having offered thus,

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:85/9-10) <tvaṣṭā me daivyaṃ vacaḥ [PS 19.2.1, ;SS 6.4.1]>_iti tvāṣṭraṃ vaiśvarūpam ālabheta |
body.translated_text: with 'O <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, my divine speech,' he should offer a <s>Tvāṣṭra Vaiśvarūpa</s> (all-formed) [animal] to <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:85/10-11) atha yasyāsamāpte karmaṇi yūpaḥ prapatet tatra juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if the sacrificial post should fall before the ritual is complete, he should offer there:

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:85/12-15) <ya indreṇa sṛṣṭo yadi vā marudbhir yūpaḥ papāta dviṣatāṃ vadhāya | taṃ nirjagāmo haviṣā ghṛtena śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade || tvaṣṭre svāhā [?]>_iti hutvā <tvaṣṭā me daivyaṃ vacaḥ [see above]>_iti tvāṣṭraṃ sarvarūpam ālabheta |
body.translated_text: 'The <s>yūpa</s> that fell, whether hurled by <s>Indra</s> or by the <s>Maruts</s>, for the destruction of enemies—may we drive it away with oblation and ghee. May there be well-being for our bipeds and quadrupeds. To <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>.'—Having offered thus, with 'O <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, my divine speech,' he should offer a <s>Tvāṣṭra Sarvarūpa</s> (all-formed) [animal] to <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:85/15-19) atha yasyāsamāpte karmaṇi yūpe dhvāṅkṣo nipatet tatra juhuyāt <ā pavasva hiraṇyavad aśvāvat soma vīravat | vājaṃ gomantam ā bhara svāhā [.RV 9.63.18]>_iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Now, if a crow should alight on the <s>yūpa</s> before the ritual is complete, he should offer there: 'Flow forth, O <s>Soma</s>, with golden, horse-rich, hero-rich streams. Bring us wealth rich in cattle, <s>svāhā</s>.'—After inserting in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:85-86/19-1) yadi duṣṭaṃ haviḥ syāt kīṭāvapannaṃ vā tat tasmin bhasmany upavaped apsu vety eke |
body.translated_text: If the oblation should be spoiled, or if insects have fallen into it, one should deposit it in the ashes or in water—some say.

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:86/1-2) <bhuvāya svāhā | bhuvanāya svāhā | bhuvanapataye svāhā | bhuvāṃ pataye svāhā | viṣṇave svāheti |
body.translated_text: 'To <s>Bhū</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Bhuvana</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Lord of Beings (<s>Bhuvanapatī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Lord of <s>Bhū</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:86/2-3) ete ha vai devānām ṛtvijas |
body.translated_text: These indeed are the <s>ṛtvij</s> (priests) of the gods.

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:86/3-4) ta evāsya tad dhutam iṣṭaṃ kurvanti |
body.translated_text: They make that offered and sacrificed for him.

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:86/4-6) yat prayājeṣv ahuteṣu prāg aṅgāraḥ skanded adhvaryave ca yajamānāya ca paśubhyaś cāghaṃ syād yadi dakṣiṇā brahmaṇe ca yajamānāya ca |
body.translated_text: If during the <s>prayāja</s> (preliminary oblations) before they are offered, an ember should fly forward, it would be harmful to the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, the sacrificer, and the cattle; if to the south, to the <s>Brahman</s> priest and the sacrificer.

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:86/6-7) yadi pratyag ghotre ca patnyai ca | [ed. dhotre]
body.translated_text: If to the west, to the <s>Hotṛ</s> and the wife [of the sacrificer].

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:86/7-8) yady udag agnīdhe ca yajamānāya ca paśubhyaś cāghaṃ syāt |
body.translated_text: If to the north, it would be harmful to the <s>Agnīdhra</s>, the sacrificer, and the cattle.

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:86/8) tam anupraharet |
body.translated_text: He should throw it [back into the fire].

body.text: (AVPr_2.6:86/9) <sahasrasṛṅgaḥ [PS 18.16.2, ;SS 13.1.2]> | ity etayarcā || 6 ||
body.translated_text: With the verse 'The thousand-horned one.' || 6 ||

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:86-87/9-1) atha yasyāgnayo mithaḥ saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's sacred fires should mingle with each other—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/1-2) so 'gnaye vītaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ (prāṅ) nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should prepare an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Vīti</s> (Agni of the feast).

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/2-3) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/3-5) saṃsthitahomeṣv <agna āyāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye ni hotā satsi barhiṣi [SV 1.1]>_iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, after inserting 'Come, O <s>Agni</s>, to the feast, being praised, to the offering of oblations; sit down as <s>Hotṛ</s> on the sacred grass' in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/5-6) atha yasyāgnayo grāmyeṇāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's sacred fires should mingle with the domestic fire—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/6-7) so 'gnaye vivicaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should prepare an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Vivici</s> (Agni who separates).

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/7) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/8-10) saṃsthitahomeṣv <agnim ī;le purohitaṃ viviciṃ ratnadhātamaṃ pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat [?]> | iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, after inserting 'I praise <s>Agni</s>, the foremost, the discriminating, the best bestower of treasures; may he carry forth our lives' in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/10-11) atha yasyāgnayaḥ śāvenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's sacred fires should mingle with a funeral fire—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/11-12) so 'gnaye śucaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should prepare an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Śuci</s> (Agni the Pure).

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/12) nityāḥ purastaddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/12-16) saṃsthitahomeṣv | <agniḥ śucivratatamaḥ śucir vipraḥ śuciḥ kaviḥ | śucī rocata āhutaḥ [TS 1.3.14.8bb, .RV 8.44.21]> || <ud agne śucayas tava śukrā bhrājanta īrate | tava jyotīṃṣy arcayaḥ [TS 1.3.14.8cc, .RV 8.44.17] svāheti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, '<s>Agni</s>, most faithful to holy vows, pure, the wise sage, pure the poet; pure he shines when the oblation is offered.' 'Your pure, bright flames rise up, O <s>Agni</s>; your rays of light blaze forth, <s>svāhā</s>.'—After inserting in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87/16-17) atha yasyāgnayo dāvenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's sacred fires should mingle with a forest fire—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:87-88/17-2) annādyaṃ vā eṣa yajamānasya saṃvṛjyāvṛta upa to 'raṇyād grāmam adhy abhyupaiti |
body.translated_text: It is indeed the food-offering of the sacrificer that, having been cut off, turns back and comes from the forest toward the village.

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/2-3) so 'gnaye 'nnādāyā 'nnapataye 'sṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should prepare an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Annāda Annapati</s> (Agni the Food-eater, Lord of Food).

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/3) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/4-5) saṃsthitahomeṣv | <apaścādaghvānnasya bhūyāsam [PS 20.43.9, ;SS 19.55.5]> | iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, after inserting 'May I not be without a share of food afterwards' in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/4-6) atha yasyāgnayo divyenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's sacred fires should mingle with celestial fire (lightning)—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/6-7) so 'gnaye jyotiṣmate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should prepare an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Jyotiṣmat</s> (Agni possessed of light).

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/7-8) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/8-10) saṃsthitahomeṣu | <vidyotate dyotate | vidyuto 'gnir jihvā | vidyutā bhrājanti dyotata ā ca dyotata [? Cf. PS 16.151.5a, 16.150.7a, 8a]> | iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, after inserting 'It flashes, it shines; lightning is the tongue of fire; with lightning they blaze, shine forth and shine' in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/11) atha yasyāgnayo 'bhiplaveran kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one's sacred fires should be flooded—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/11-12) so 'gnaye 'psumate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should prepare an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Apsumat</s> (Agni associated with water).

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/12-13) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/13-14) saṃsthitahomeṣv <apām agnis tanūbhiḥ [PS 5.7.8, ;SS 4.15.10]> | iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, after inserting '<s>Agni</s> [who is] in the waters with his bodies' in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88/14-15) atha yady anugatam abhyuddharet kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one should carry forth [the fire] after it has already followed [of its own accord]—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:88-89/15-1) so 'gnaye 'gnimate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should prepare an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Agnimat</s> (Agni possessed of fire).

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:89/1-2) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.7:89/2-7) saṃsthitahomeṣu | <śivau bhavatam adya naḥ [KauśS 108.2] | <agnināgniḥ saṃsṛjyate kavir gṛhapatir yuvā havyavāḍ juhvāsyaḥ [KauśS 108.2]> | <tvaṃ hy agne agninā vipro vipreṇa san satā sakhā sakhyā samidhyase [KauśS 108.2]> || <sa no rāsva suvīryam [.RV 5.13.5c; 8.98.12c; ;SS 20.108.3c]> iti madhyata opyātha saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet || 7 ||
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, 'May you two be auspicious for us today.' '<s>Agni</s> is joined with <s>Agni</s>, the wise householder, the young one, the oblation-bearer, the ladle-mouthed.' 'For you, O <s>Agni</s>, are kindled by <s>Agni</s>, the wise by the wise, the true by the true, the friend by friendship.' 'Grant us heroic strength.'—After inserting in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions. || 7 ||

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:89/7-8) atha ya āhitāgnis tantre pravāse mṛtaḥ syāt kathaṃ tatra kuryāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if one who has established the sacred fires should die while on a journey during the ritual procedure—what should be done in that case?

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:89/8-9) katham asyāgnihotraṃ juhuyur |
body.translated_text: How should they offer his <s>Agnihotra</s>?

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:89/9-10) anyavatsāyā goḥ payasety āhur adugdhāyā vā śūdradugdhāyā vā |
body.translated_text: With milk from a cow whose calf belongs to another—they say—or from an unmilked one, or from one milked by a <s>Śūdra</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:89/10-12) asarvaṃ vā etat payo yad anyavatsāyā goḥ śūdradugdhāyā vāsarvaṃ vā etad agnihotraṃ yan mṛtasyāgnihotraṃ |
body.translated_text: For that milk which is from a cow whose calf belongs to another, or which is milked by a <s>Śūdra</s>, is incomplete; and that <s>Agnihotra</s> which is the <s>Agnihotra</s> of a dead man is likewise incomplete.

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:89-90/12-1) tāvad agniṃ paricareyur yāvad asthnām āharaṇam |
body.translated_text: They should tend the fire until the bringing of the bones.

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:90/2) āhṛtyāgnibhiḥ saṃspṛśya taṃ pitṛmedhena samāpnuyur |
body.translated_text: Having brought [the bones] and having touched them to the fires, they should complete the <s>Pitṛmedha</s> (funeral rite) for him.

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:90/3-4) atha yaḥ samāropitāsamāropite mṛtaḥ syāt kathaṃ tatra kuryāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if one should die with the [fires] partially or not yet mounted [on the altar]—what should be done in that case?

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:90/4-5) so 'gnaye tantumate pathikṛte vratabhṛte puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped ekakapālaṃ saptakapālaṃ navakapālaṃ |
body.translated_text: He should prepare a <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Tantumat Pathikṛt Vratabhṛt</s> (Agni of Continuity, Path-maker, Vow-bearer)—of one, seven, or nine <s>kapālas</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:90/5-6) nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ |
body.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations [are performed].

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:90/6-8) saṃsthitahomeṣu | <tvam agne saprathā asi [see above] <yena pathā vaivasvataḥ [see above] <tvam agne vratapā asi [see above]>_iti madhyata opya (atha) saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet |
body.translated_text: Among the concluded oblations, after inserting 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, are widely spread,' 'By which path <s>Vaivasvata</s> [departed],' 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the protector of vows' in the middle, he should conclude with the <s>saṃsrāva</s> portions.

body.text: (AVPr_2.8:90/8-10) atha naṣṭe araṇī syātām anyayor araṇyor vihṛtya taṃ mathitvaitābhir eva hutvāthainaṃ samāpnuyuḥ || 8 ||
body.translated_text: Now, if [the fire] is lost, there should be two fire-sticks (<s>araṇī</s>); having separated from the other fire-sticks, having churned that [fire], and having offered with these very [verses], they should complete the rite for him. || 8 ||

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:90-91/10-1) atha yasyopākṛtaḥ paśuḥ prapatet kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if a consecrated sacrificial animal should escape—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:91/1-3) spṛtibhir juhuyād vāyave niyutvate yavāgūṃ nirupyānyaṃ tadrūpaṃ tadvarṇam ālabheta |
body.translated_text: Having offered with the <s>spṛti</s> (liberation) [mantras], having prepared a gruel for <s>Vāyu Niyutvat</s> (Vāyu with his team), he should consecrate another [animal] of the same kind and color.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:91/3-4) ājyenābhigbārya paryagni kṛtvopākurvīta |
body.translated_text: Having basted it with <s>ājya</s> (ghee) and having performed the fire-circling, he should consecrate it.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:91/4) ete vai devaspṛtayo |
body.translated_text: These indeed are the divine <s>spṛtis</s> (liberations).

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:91-92/4-4) <agneṣ ṭe vācaṃ spṛṇomi svāhā | vātāt te prāṇaṃ spṛṇomi svāhā | sūryāt te cakṣu spṛṇomi svāhā | candrāt te mana spṛṇomi svāhā | digbhyas te jyoti spṛṇomi svāhā | adbhyas te rasaṃ spṛṇomi svāhā | asthibhyas te majjānaṃ spṛṇomi svāhā | snehebhyas te snāvānaṃ spṛṇomi svāhā | oṣadhībhyas te lomāni spṛṇomi svāhā | pṛthivyās te śarīraṃ spṛṇomi svāhā | antarikṣāt ta ākāśaṃ spṛṇomi svāhā | mānuṣāt ta ākāśād divyam ākāśaṃ spṛṇomi svāhā | indrāt te balaṃ spṛṇomi svāhā | somāt te rājñaḥ kīrttiṃ yaśaś ca spṛṇomi svāhā> |
body.translated_text: 'From <s>Agni</s> I liberate your speech, <s>svāhā</s>. From <s>Vāta</s> (Wind) I liberate your breath, <s>svāhā</s>. From <s>Sūrya</s> I liberate your sight, <s>svāhā</s>. From <s>Candra</s> (Moon) I liberate your mind, <s>svāhā</s>. From the quarters I liberate your light, <s>svāhā</s>. From the waters I liberate your sap, <s>svāhā</s>. From the bones I liberate your marrow, <s>svāhā</s>. From the fat I liberate your sinews, <s>svāhā</s>. From the plants I liberate your hair, <s>svāhā</s>. From the earth I liberate your body, <s>svāhā</s>. From the atmosphere I liberate your space, <s>svāhā</s>. From human space I liberate your divine space, <s>svāhā</s>. From <s>Indra</s> I liberate your strength, <s>svāhā</s>. From <s>Soma</s> the king I liberate your fame and glory, <s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/5) iti ca hutvāthainaṃ punaḥ pradiśati <vāyave tvā [VSM 7.7 etc.]>_ity |
body.translated_text: Having offered thus, he then directs it again: 'For <s>Vāyu</s>, you [are designated].'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/6) atha yasyopākṛtaḥ paśur mriyeta kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if a consecrated sacrificial animal should die—what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/7) spṛtibhir eva hutvāthainam anudiśaty <ṛtave tvā [?]>_ity |
body.translated_text: Having offered with the <s>spṛti</s> (liberation) [mantras], he then directs it: 'For the <s>Ṛtu</s> (season), you [are designated].'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/8) atha yasyopākṛtaḥ paśuḥ saṃśīryeta kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if the consecrated sacrificial animal should fall apart, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/9-10) spṛtibhir eva hutvāthainam anudiśati | <rakṣobhyas tvā [?]>_iti |
body.translated_text: Having offered with the <s>spṛti</s> oblations, he then dismisses it, with 'From the <s>Rakṣas</s>es, you [are dismissed].'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/10) nānudeśanam ity āhur |
body.translated_text: 'There is no dismissal'—thus they say.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/10-11) yo vā eṣa prapatito bhavati tad yad enam adhigacheyur atha tena yajeta |
body.translated_text: Or, if the one that has fallen should be found, then one should sacrifice with it.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/11-14) atha yāv etau śīrṇamṛtau bhavatas tayoḥ prajñātāny avadānāny avadāyetarasya vā paśoḥ saṃpraiṣaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇān paricareyur apo vābhyupahareyuḥ spṛtibhir |
body.translated_text: Now, if the two [animals] that have collapsed and died—from them, having cut out the recognized offering portions, or having performed the concluding formula for another animal, they should serve the Brahmins or bring them water with the <s>spṛti</s> oblations.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/14-16) yadi vānyaḥ syā[c] chāmitram enaṃ prāpayeyus....ṣpṛtibhir eva hutvā śāmitram evainaṃ prāpayeyur |
body.translated_text: Or if there should be another [animal], they should bring it to the slaughterer... having offered with the <s>spṛti</s> oblations, they should bring it to the slaughterer.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/16-17) ata ūrdhvaṃ prasiddhaḥ paśubandho |
body.translated_text: From this point onward, the <s>paśubandha</s> (animal sacrifice) is well-known.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/17-18) atha ya upatāpinaṃ yājayet kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one should sacrifice for a person afflicted with fever, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/18) spṛtibhir eva hutvāgado haiva bhavati |
body.translated_text: Having offered with the <s>spṛti</s> oblations, he indeed becomes cured.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/18-19) atha ced bahava upatāpinaḥ syuḥ kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if there should be many who are afflicted with fever, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/19-20) spṛtibhir eva hutvāgado haiva bhavaty |
body.translated_text: Having offered with the <s>spṛti</s> oblations, he indeed becomes cured.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/20-21) atha yo 'dhiśrite 'gnihotre yajamāno mriyeta kathaṃ tatra kuryāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if the sacrificer should die while the <s>Agnihotra</s> fire is still kindled, how should one proceed in that case?

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/21-22) tatraivaitat paryādadhyād yathā sarvaśaḥ saṃdahyeteti |
body.translated_text: One should place it [the fire] right there upon [the body], so that it is completely burned.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92/22-23) athāhavanīya ājyāhutiṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Then in the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire, one should offer an <s>ājya</s> (clarified butter) oblation,

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:92-93/23-1) <yajña eti vitataḥ kalpamānaḥ [PS 18.77.3, ;SS 18.4.13]> | ity etayarcā |
body.translated_text: with the verse 'The sacrifice goes forth, stretched out, being prepared.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/1-2) atha ya aupavasathye 'hani yajamāno mriyeta kathaṃ tatra kuryāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if the sacrificer should die on the <s>upavasatha</s> (fasting) day, how should one proceed in that case?

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/2-3) tatraivaitat pradadhyād yathā sarvaśaḥ saṃdahyetety |
body.translated_text: One should place it [the fire] right there upon [the body], so that it is completely burned.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/3) athāhavanīya ājyāhutiṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Then in the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire, one should offer an <s>ājya</s> oblation,

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/3-4) <yajña eti vitataḥ kalpamānaḥ [see above]> ity etayarcā |
body.translated_text: with the verse 'The sacrifice goes forth, stretched out, being prepared.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/4-5) atha yaḥ samāsanneṣu haviḥṣu yajamāno mriyeta kathaṃ tatra kuryāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if the sacrificer should die when the sacrificial offerings have been brought near, how should one proceed in that case?

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/6-7) tatraivaitat paryādadhyād yathā sarvaśaḥ saṃdahyerann iti |
body.translated_text: One should place it [the fire] right there upon [them], so that they are completely burned.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/7) athāhavanīya ājyāhutiṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Then in the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire, one should offer an <s>ājya</s> oblation,

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/7-8) <apemaṃ jīvā arudhan gṛhebhyaḥ [PS 18.64.10, ;SS 18.2.27]> | ity etayarcā |
body.translated_text: with the verse 'The living ones have warded off this one from the houses.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/8-9) atha yo dīkṣito mriyeta katham enaṃ daheyus |
body.translated_text: Now, if the one who has been consecrated (<s>dīkṣita</s>) should die, how should they cremate him?

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/9) tair evāgnibhir ity āhur |
body.translated_text: 'With those very fires'—thus they say.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/10) havyavāhanāś caite me bhavanti tat kavyavāhanā iti |
body.translated_text: 'These are carriers of the <s>havya</s> (divine offerings) for me, so let them be carriers of the <s>kavya</s> (ancestral offerings)'—thus.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/10-11) atha nu katham iti |
body.translated_text: But then, how [should one proceed]?

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/11-12) śakṛtpiṇḍais tisra ukhāḥ pūrayitvā tāḥ prādadh[y]us |
body.translated_text: Having filled three pots with cow-dung cakes, they should place them [on the body].

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/12) tā dhūnuyus |
body.translated_text: They should shake them out.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/12-13) tā susaṃtāpā ye 'gnayo jāyeraṃs taiḥ samāpnuyuḥ |
body.translated_text: From those well-heated ones, whatever fires should arise, with those they should complete [the cremation].

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/13-14) bahir vā evaṃ (bhavan)ti te no vaite |
body.translated_text: Thus they become external—they are neither these [original fires] nor those.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/14-15) tasya tad eva brāhmaṇaṃ yad adaḥpuraḥ savane pitṛmedha āśiṣo vyākhyātās |
body.translated_text: For him, that very <s>brāhmaṇa</s> passage [applies] which has been explained regarding the blessings in the <s>pitṛmedha</s> (funeral rite), at the earlier pressing.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/15-18) taṃ yadi purastāt tiṣṭhantam upavadet taṃ brūyād <vasūnāṃ tvā devānāṃ vyātte 'pi dadhāmi | gāyatrīṃ parṣām adhaḥśirāvapadyasva [?]>_iti |
body.translated_text: If one should address him standing to the east, one should say to him: 'In the opened [mouth] of the <s>Vasus</s>, the gods, I place you. Enter the <s>Gāyatrī</s> assembly headfirst.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/18-20) taṃ yadi dakṣiṇatas tiṣṭhantam upavadet taṃ brūyād <rudrāṇāṃ tvā devānāṃ vyātte 'pi dadhāmi | traiṣṭubhīṃ parṣām adhaḥśirāvapadyasva [?]>_iti |
body.translated_text: If one should address him standing to the south, one should say to him: 'In the opened [mouth] of the <s>Rudras</s>, the gods, I place you. Enter the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> assembly headfirst.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/20-23) taṃ yadi paścāt tiṣṭhantam upavadet taṃ brūyād <ādityānāṃ tvā devānāṃ vyātte 'pi dadhāmi | jāgatīṃ parṣām adhaḥśirāvapadyasva [?]>_iti |
body.translated_text: If one should address him standing to the west, one should say to him: 'In the opened [mouth] of the <s>Ādityas</s>, the gods, I place you. Enter the <s>Jagatī</s> assembly headfirst.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93/23-25) taṃ yady uttaratas tiṣṭhantam upavadet taṃ brūyād <viśvesāṃ tvā devānāṃ vyātte 'pi dadhāmi | ānuṣṭubhīṃ parṣām adhaḥśirāvapadyasva [?]>_iti |
body.translated_text: If one should address him standing to the north, one should say to him: 'In the opened [mouth] of the <s>Viśve Devas</s>, the gods, I place you. Enter the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> assembly headfirst.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:93-94/25-1) taṃ yady antardeśebhyo vā tiṣṭhantam upavadet taṃ brūyāt ......... |
body.translated_text: If one should address him standing in the intermediate directions, one should say to him: .........

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:94/1-2) tasmai namas kuryāt |
body.translated_text: He should make obeisance to him.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:94/2-3) sa cet prati namas kuryāt kuśalenaivainam yojayet |
body.translated_text: If he returns the obeisance, one should engage him with something auspicious.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:94/3) sa cen na prati namas kuryāt tenābhicaret |
body.translated_text: If he does not return the obeisance, one should practice sorcery against him.

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:94/4) savyam agranthinā prasavyam agnibhiḥ parīyāt |
body.translated_text: He should circumambulate counter-sunwise with a knotless [garment] and counter-sunwise around the fires,

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:94/4-5) <vatsaro 'si parivatsaro 'si saṃvatsaro 'si [VSM 27.45]>_iti |
body.translated_text: with 'You are the year, you are the intercalary year, you are the full year.'

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:94/5-7) taṃ yadi jighāṃsed <yayoḥ sarvam [PS 19.55.1]> iti sūktena bādhakīḥ samidho 'bhyādadhyāt |
body.translated_text: If he should wish to slay him, with the hymn 'Of which two, everything,' he should add fuel sticks of <s>bādhakī</s> wood.

body.translated_text: [Editorial note: PS mantra in <s>pratīka</s>? Has the mantra been correctly identified? The following (<s>tṛtīyāham</s>: cf. 19.55.2e, 3e, 4d; <s>ucchiṣṭaḥ</s>: 19.55.1d) suggests it has.]

body.text: (AVPr_2.9:94/7) tṛtīyāhaṃ nātijīvati |
body.translated_text: On the third day, he does not survive.
