body.text: (AVPr_2.9:94/7-11) atha yo hotārddhahuta ucchiṣṭaḥ syāt sahaiva tenācamya_<agnir mā pātu vasubhiḥ purastāt [PS 7.16.1, ;SS 19.17.1]>_ity etāṃ japtvā yathārthaṃ kuryād yathārthaṃ kuryāt || 9 || iti yajñaprāyāścitte dvitīyo 'dhyāyah samāptaḥ || [ed. purastad]
body.translated_text: Now, if the <s>Hotṛ</s> priest should be in the state of having food remaining from an incomplete offering—having sipped water together with him, having recited 'May <s>Agni</s> protect me with the <s>Vasus</s> from the east,' he should perform the procedure as prescribed. || 9 || Thus ends the second chapter on sacrifice-<s>prāyaścitta</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/12) athāto somarūpāṇi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
body.translated_text: Now we shall explain the forms of <s>Soma</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/12) prajāpatir manasi |
body.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> in the mind.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/13) sārasvato vāci visṛṣṭāyāṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Sārasvata</s> in speech when released.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/13) vidhānaṃ dīkṣāyāṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Vidhāna</s> (ordinance) at the <s>dīkṣā</s> (consecration).

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/13-15) brahmavrate savitā saṃdhīyamāne 'ndho 'cheto divyaḥ suparṇaḥ parikhyāto |
body.translated_text: In the <s>Brahmavrata</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s> when being pressed—the blind, unconscious, divine <s>Suparṇa</s> (eagle), renowned.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/15) aditiḥ prāyaṇīye |
body.translated_text: <s>Aditi</s> at the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> (opening rite).

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/15-16) paśuṣṭhā nyupto |
body.translated_text: Standing among the animals when deposited.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/16) yajño hūyamāno |
body.translated_text: <s>Yajña</s> (sacrifice) when being offered.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/16) bhadro vicīyamānaḥ |
body.translated_text: <s>Bhadra</s> (auspicious) when being selected.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/17) chaṃdāṃsi mīyamāno |
body.translated_text: <s>Chandas</s> (meters) when being measured.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/17) bhagaḥ paṇyamāno |
body.translated_text: <s>Bhaga</s> (fortune) when being bargained for.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/17-18) asuraḥ krīto |
body.translated_text: <s>Asura</s> when bought.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/18) varuṇo 'pasaṃnaddhaḥ |
body.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> when unpacked.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/18) pūṣā somakrayaṇe |
body.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s> at the <s>Soma</s>-purchase.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/18-19) śipiviṣṭo 'rāv āsādyamāno |
body.translated_text: <s>Śipiviṣṭa</s> when being placed on the pressing-board.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/19) bṛhaspatir utthito |
body.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> when raised up.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/19-20) vāyur abhihriyamāṇo |
body.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> when being brought forth.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/20) adhipatiḥ prohyamāṇo |
body.translated_text: <s>Adhipati</s> (overlord) when being carried forward.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/20-21) agnīṣomīyaḥ paśav |
body.translated_text: <s>Agniṣomīya</s> is [the identity of] the animal.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/21) atithi (rudro | varuṇaḥ) sadātithye |
body.translated_text: <s>Atithi</s> (guest; <s>Rudra</s>; <s>Varuṇa</s>) at the guest-reception.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/21-22) varuṇaḥ saṃrāḍ |
body.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> the sovereign.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94/22) āsandyām āsādyamāna |
body.translated_text: When being placed on the throne.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:94-95/22-1) aindrāgno 'gnau mathyamāna |
body.translated_text: <s>Aindrāgna</s> when the fire is being churned.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/1) aindrāgno 'gnau praṇīyamāne |
body.translated_text: <s>Aindrāgna</s> when the fire is being led forward.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/1-2) sāma tānūnaptre |
body.translated_text: <s>Sāman</s> at the <s>Tānūnaptra</s> rite.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/2) tapo 'vāntaradīkṣāyāṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Tapas</s> (austerity) at the <s>Avāntaradīkṣā</s> (subsidiary consecration).

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/2) pṛthivy upasady |
body.translated_text: The earth at the <s>Upasad</s> rite.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/2-3) antarikṣam upasadi |
body.translated_text: The atmosphere at the <s>Upasad</s> rite.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/3) dyaur upasadi |
body.translated_text: Heaven at the <s>Upasad</s> rite.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/3-4) yajñasya pramābhimomnā pratimā vedyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ |
body.translated_text: The measure and counter-measure of the sacrifice when the <s>vedī</s> (altar) is being constructed.

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/4-5) paśava uttaravedyāṃ |
body.translated_text: The animals at the <s>uttaravedi</s> (high altar).

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/5) dyaur havirdhāne |
body.translated_text: Heaven at the <s>Havirdhāna</s> (oblation-shed).

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/5) antarikṣam āgnīdhrīye |
body.translated_text: The atmosphere at the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> (fire-kindler's shed).

body.text: (AVPr_3.1:95/6) pṛthivī sadasi || 1 ||
body.translated_text: The earth at the <s>sadas</s> (assembly hall). || 1 ||

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/6) prāṇa uparaveṣu |
body.translated_text: <s>Prāṇa</s> (breath) at the <s>uparavas</s> (pressing-stones).

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/6) bhrātṛvyā dhiṣṇyeṣu |
body.translated_text: The rivals at the <s>dhiṣṇyas</s> (fire-hearths).

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/6-7) paśavo barhiṣi | vedyāṃ stīryamāṇāyām |
body.translated_text: The animals at the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass), when it is being spread on the altar.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/7) apsu visarjane |
body.translated_text: In the waters at the releasing.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/7-8) prajāpatir hriyamāṇo |
body.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> when being carried.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/8) agnir āgnīdhrīye |
body.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> at the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/8-9) vaiṣṇava āsannakarmaṇi |
body.translated_text: <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> at the time of the near-rites.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/9) hasto visṛṣṭo |
body.translated_text: A hand when released.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/9) vaiṣṇavo yūpa |
body.translated_text: <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> at the <s>yūpa</s> (sacrificial post).

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/9-10) oṣadhayo raśanāyāṃ |
body.translated_text: Plants at the tying-rope.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/10) medha āprīṣu |
body.translated_text: <s>Medha</s> (sacrificial essence) at the <s>Āprī</s> hymns.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/10) haviḥ paryagnikṛtaḥ |
body.translated_text: <s>Havis</s> (oblation) when circumambulated with fire.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/10-11) pitṛdevatyaḥ paśau saṃjñapyamāne |
body.translated_text: Of the nature of the <s>Pitṛ</s>-deities when the animal is being slaughtered.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/11-12) yajñasya mithunaṃ pannejaneṣu |
body.translated_text: The pairing of the sacrifice at the washings.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/12) rakṣasāṃ bhāgadheyaṃ vapāyām udgṛhyamāṇāyāṃ |
body.translated_text: The portion for the <s>Rakṣas</s>es when the <s>vapā</s> (omentum) is being extracted.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/13) yajñasya saṃtatir vasatīvarīṣv abhihriyamāṇāsv |
body.translated_text: The continuity of the sacrifice when the <s>vasatīvarī</s> waters are being brought.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/13-15) indrāgnyor dhenur dakṣiṇasyām uttaravediśroṇyām avasādayati |
body.translated_text: The cow of <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>—he places it at the southern hip of the <s>uttaravedi</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/15) mitrāvaruṇayor dhenur |
body.translated_text: The cow of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>—

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/15-16) uttarasyām uttaravediśroṇyām avasādayati |
body.translated_text: he places it at the northern hip of the <s>uttaravedi</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/16-17) viśveṣāṃ devānām āgnīdhrīye |
body.translated_text: Of the <s>Viśve Devas</s> at the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/17) chaṃdāṃsy upavasathe |
body.translated_text: <s>Chandas</s> (meters) at the <s>upavasatha</s> (fasting day).

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/17) havirupāvahṛtaḥ |
body.translated_text: <s>Havis</s> (oblation) when offered up.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/18) sārasvataḥ prātaranuvāke |
body.translated_text: <s>Sārasvata</s> at the <s>prātaranuvāka</s> (morning litany).

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/18) atharvābhyuptaḥ |
body.translated_text: <s>Ātharva</s> when scattered.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/18-19) prajāpatir vibhajyamāne |
body.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> when being distributed.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/19) devatā vibhakte |
body.translated_text: The deity when distributed.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/19-29) indro vṛtrahendro 'bhimātihendro indro vṛtratur unnīyamāna |
body.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, <s>Indra</s> the destroyer of enemies, <s>Indra</s>—<s>Indra</s> the overcomer of <s>Vṛtra</s> when being elevated.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/20-21) āyur upāṃśvantaryāmayor |
body.translated_text: <s>Āyus</s> (life) at the <s>Upāṃśu</s> and <s>Antaryāma</s> cups.

body.text: (AVPr_3.2:95/21) yamo 'bhihitaḥ || 2 ||
body.translated_text: <s>Yama</s> when covered. || 2 ||

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:95-96/21-1) nibhūyapurādhāvanīye supūtaḥ pūtabhṛti suśukraśrīr manthaśrīḥ saktuśrīḥ kṣīraśrīḥ kakubhaḥ pātreṣu |
body.translated_text: Having been purified at the preliminary wash: well-purified, having the glory of the <s>pūtabhṛt</s> (purifier vessel), the glory of the well-bright, the glory of the <s>mantha</s> (churned drink), the glory of the <s>saktu</s> (barley meal), the glory of milk—[these are] the directions in the vessels.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/1-2) vāyur bahiṣpavamāne |
body.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> at the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> (external purification chant).

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/2) hotrā pravare |
body.translated_text: <s>Hotrā</s> at the <s>pravara</s> (selection of ancestry).

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/2) vasavaḥ prayājeṣu |
body.translated_text: The <s>Vasus</s> at the <s>prayājas</s> (preliminary offerings).

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/2-3) yaddevatyaḥ somas taddevatyaḥ paśur |
body.translated_text: Of whichever deity the <s>Soma</s> is, of that deity is the animal.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/3) vaiśvadeva unnīyamāna |
body.translated_text: <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> when being elevated.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/4) aindrāgna unnīto |
body.translated_text: <s>Aindrāgna</s> when elevated.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/4) rudro hūyamāno |
body.translated_text: <s>Rudra</s> when being offered.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/4-5) vāto māruto gaṇo 'bhyāvṛtto |
body.translated_text: <s>Vāta</s>, the <s>Marut</s> host, when turned around.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/5) nṛcakṣāḥ pratikhyāto |
body.translated_text: <s>Nṛcakṣas</s> (man-seeing) when recognized.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/5-6) bhakṣo bhakṣyamāṇaḥ |
body.translated_text: <s>Bhakṣa</s> (portion) when being consumed.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/6) sakhā bhakṣitaḥ |
body.translated_text: <s>Sakhā</s> (friend) when consumed.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/6) pitaro nārāśaṃsā |
body.translated_text: The <s>Pitṛs</s> (ancestors) at the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> cups.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/6-7) [ā]gneyaṃ prātaḥsavanam |
body.translated_text: Of <s>Agni</s>'s nature is the morning pressing.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/7) aindraṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ |
body.translated_text: Of <s>Indra</s>'s nature is the midday pressing.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/7-8) yajño dakṣiṇāyām |
body.translated_text: <s>Yajña</s> (sacrifice) at the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee).

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/8) aindrāṇi pṛṣṭhāni |
body.translated_text: Of <s>Indra</s>'s nature are the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> chants.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/8-9) vaiśvadevaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ |
body.translated_text: Of the <s>Viśve Devas</s>' nature is the third pressing.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/9) vaiśvānaro 'gniṣṭomam |
body.translated_text: <s>Vaiśvānara</s> is the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> (fire-praise rite).

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/10) aindrāvaruṇaṃ maitrāvaruṇasyokthaṃ bhavati |
body.translated_text: Of <s>Indra</s>-<s>Varuṇa</s>'s nature is the <s>uktha</s> (recitation) of the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> priest.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/10-11) aindrābārhaspatyaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsina ukthaṃ bhavati |
body.translated_text: Of <s>Indra</s>-<s>Bṛhaspati</s>'s nature is the <s>uktha</s> of the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> priest.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/11-12) aindrāvaiṣṇavam achāvākasyokthaṃ bhavati |
body.translated_text: Of <s>Indra</s>-<s>Viṣṇu</s>'s nature is the <s>uktha</s> of the <s>Acchāvāka</s> priest.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/12) aindraḥ ṣoḍaśīrātraḥ |
body.translated_text: Of <s>Indra</s>'s nature is the <s>Ṣoḍaśī</s> night-rite.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/12-13) paryāyāgneyo |
body.translated_text: Of <s>Agni</s>'s nature in the <s>paryāya</s> (cycle).

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/13) rāthaṃtaraḥ sandhiḥ |
body.translated_text: The <s>Rathantara</s> is the juncture.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/13) sauryam āśvinam |
body.translated_text: Of <s>Sūrya</s>'s nature is the <s>Āśvina</s> rite.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/13-14) ahar yajña |
body.translated_text: The day is the sacrifice.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/14) ādityā anuyājeṣu |
body.translated_text: The <s>Ādityas</s> at the <s>anuyājas</s> (concluding offerings).

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/14) yad antarā kriyate sa samudro |
body.translated_text: Whatever is performed in between—that is the ocean.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/14-15) varuṇo 'vabhṛthe |
body.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> at the <s>Avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath).

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/15) samudra rjīṣe |
body.translated_text: The ocean at the <s>ṛjīṣa</s> (residue) rite.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/15-16) yad avāre tīrthaṃ tat prāyaṇīyaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whichever is the near <s>tīrtha</s> (ford), that is the opening rite.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/16) yat pare tad udayanīyaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whichever is the far one, that is the concluding rite.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/16) vaiṣṇavo vaśāyāṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> in the barren cow.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/17) svar divi |
body.translated_text: <s>Svar</s> (heaven) in the sky.

body.text: (AVPr_3.3:96/17) kāsu brahma samiṣṭyām || 3 ||
body.translated_text: <s>Brahman</s> at the <s>samiṣṭyam</s> (concluding rite). || 3 ||

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:96/17-19) yasyā yasyāntataḥ somo vyāpadyeta tasyai tasyai devatāyā iṣṭiṃ nirvaped ājyahomān vā |
body.translated_text: Regarding whichever deity <s>Soma</s> should be damaged at the end, for that very deity one should prepare an <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) or <s>ājya</s> oblations.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:96/19) atha juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Then he should offer:

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:96/19-20) tvāṃ yajño viṣṇur iti ca |
body.translated_text: 'You, the sacrifice, <s>Viṣṇu</s>'—and with this.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:96/20-21) tvāṃ yajño viṣṇur yajñaviṣṇū anūnaṃ hitvā ātmānaṃ deveṣu vidayāmīti |
body.translated_text: 'You, the sacrifice, <s>Viṣṇu</s>—sacrifice and <s>Viṣṇu</s>—having left undiminished, I distribute myself among the gods'—thus.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:96/21-23) vanaspate 'ntataḥ syānuṣṭubhaṃ chandaso yaṃ tam abhyukta etena saṃdadhāmīti saṃdhāya <yan me skannam [see above]> iti skanne |
body.translated_text: 'O Lord of the forest'—at the end, being of the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> meter, whichever [verse] was addressed to him—having joined with 'By this I unite,' then with 'What has been spilled of mine' when there is spillage.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:96-97/24-1) <yad asmṛti [PS 20.8.9, ;SS 7.106.1]>_iti ca karmaviparyāseti ca tad <yad ṛkta oṃ bhūr janad [cf. GB 1.3.3e]> iti gārhapatye juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: With 'What was unremembered' and 'when there is a reversal of procedure'—that [he should rectify] with 'What was done rightly, <s>Oṃ Bhūḥ</s>, may it generate'—he should offer in the <s>Gārhapatya</s> fire.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/1-2) yadi yajuṣṭa oṃ bhuvo janad iti dakṣiṇāgnau juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If it was of the <s>Yajus</s>, '<s>Oṃ Bhuvaḥ</s>, may it generate'—he should offer in the <s>Dakṣiṇāgni</s> (southern fire).

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/3) yadi sāmata oṃ svar janad ity āhavanīye juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If it was of the <s>Sāman</s>, '<s>Oṃ Svaḥ</s>, may it generate'—he should offer in the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/4-5) yady atharvata oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om ity āhavanīya eva juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If it was of the <s>Atharvan</s>, '<s>Oṃ Bhūr Bhuvaḥ Svaḥ</s>, may it generate, <s>Oṃ</s>'—he should offer in the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire itself.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/5) atha daivatāny |
body.translated_text: Now, the deities [associated with the priestly offices]:

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/5) āgneyaṃ hautraṃ |
body.translated_text: The <s>Hautra</s> (office of the <s>Hotṛ</s>) belongs to <s>Agni</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/6) vāyavyam ādhvaryavaṃ |
body.translated_text: The <s>Ādhvaryava</s> (office of the <s>Adhvaryu</s>) belongs to <s>Vāyu</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/6) sauryam audgātraṃ |
body.translated_text: The <s>Audgātra</s> (office of the <s>Udgātṛ</s>) belongs to <s>Sūrya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/6-7) cāndramasaṃ brahmatvaṃ |
body.translated_text: The <s>Brahmatva</s> (office of the <s>Brahman</s> priest) belongs to <s>Candramā</s> (the Moon).

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/7) tasya ha vā agnir hotāsīt |
body.translated_text: For indeed <s>Agni</s> was his <s>Hotṛ</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/7) vāyur adhvaryuḥ |
body.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> was the <s>Adhvaryu</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/8) sūrya udgātā |
body.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s> was the <s>Udgātṛ</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/8) candramā brahmā |
body.translated_text: <s>Candramā</s> (the Moon) was the <s>Brahman</s> priest.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/8-9) pṛthivī vā ṛcām āyatanam |
body.translated_text: The earth indeed is the abode of the <s>Ṛc</s> verses.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/9) agnir jyotir antarikṣaṃ (vai) yajuṣām āyatanaṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is their light. The atmosphere indeed is the abode of the <s>Yajus</s> formulas.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/10) vāyur jyotir dyaur (vai) sāmnām āyatanam |
body.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> is their light. Heaven indeed is the abode of the <s>Sāman</s> chants.

body.text: (AVPr_3.4:97/10-12) āditya jyotir āpo 'tharvaṇām āyatanaṃ candramā jyotir iti ca || 4 ||
body.translated_text: <s>Āditya</s> (the Sun) is their light. The waters are the abode of the <s>Atharvan</s> [hymns]; <s>Candramā</s> (the Moon) is their light. || 4 ||

body.text: (AVPr_3.5:97/12-15) atha yad avocāmāpattau somaṃ ceti yajamānaṃ ced rājānaṃ stena ha vā prathamaś cāhareyuś cittavyāpatyur vā bhavet | ity āhāśmarathyaḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, as we have stated regarding the calamity of the <s>Soma</s> [sacrifice]: if the sacrificer, or the king, should be carried away by a thief first, or if there should be a mental derangement—thus says <s>Āśmarathya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.5:97/15) nety āhatuḥ kāṇvagopāyanau |
body.translated_text: 'No,' say <s>Kāṇva</s> and <s>Gopāyana</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.5:97/15-17) yadaiva karmābhyadhvaryur vihitas tadaiva sarvakratūn praty āpado vihitāḥ | ity āhur ācāryāḥ |
body.translated_text: 'As soon as the ritual procedure is administered by the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, remedies for all sacrifices against calamities are thereby prescribed'—thus say the teachers.

body.text: (AVPr_3.5:97/17-18) atha katham atra yajamānakarmāṇi syur |
body.translated_text: But how should the duties of the sacrificer be performed in that case?

body.text: (AVPr_3.5:97/18-19) upacārabhakṣapratiś cety adhvaryur asya yajamānakarmāṇi kuryāt |
body.translated_text: The <s>Adhvaryu</s> should perform for him the duties of the sacrificer: the attendance, the partaking of the <s>bhakṣa</s> (ritual drink), and the response.

body.text: (AVPr_3.5:97/19-21) atra yajamānāsane mārjālīye vā camasau nidhāya tatrāsya bhakṣakāle bhakṣāṇy upasthāpayeyur ā samiṣṭayajuṣo homāt |
body.translated_text: There, having placed the <s>camasa</s> cups at the sacrificer's seat or in the <s>Mārjālīya</s> (shed), they should set forth the <s>bhakṣas</s> (ritual drinks) for him at the appropriate time, up to the offering of the <s>Samiṣṭayajus</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.5:97-98/21-2) prāk samiṣṭayajur homāc ced yajamāna āgacchet samastān eva bhakṣajapān japtvā bhakṣayec cheṣaṃ |
body.translated_text: If the sacrificer should arrive before the <s>Samiṣṭayajus</s> offering, he should recite all the <s>bhakṣa</s> recitations together and partake of the remainder.

body.text: (AVPr_3.5:98/2-3) samāpyāvabhṛtham abhyupeyuḥ || 5 ||
body.translated_text: Having completed [the rite], they should proceed to the <s>Avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath). || 5 ||

body.text: (AVPr_3.6:98/3-4) atha ha yaṃ jīvan na śrutipathaṃ gachet kiyantam asya kālam agnihotraṃ juhuyur |
body.translated_text: Now, if a living person does not come to the path of hearing (i.e., cannot be contacted), for how long should they offer his <s>Agnihotra</s>?

body.text: (AVPr_3.6:98/4-7) yady eva hitam āyus tasyāśeṣaṃ prasaṃkhyā[ya] tāvantaṃ kālaṃ tad asyāgnihotraṃ hutvāthāsya prāyaṇīyena pracareyur |
body.translated_text: Having calculated the remainder of his allotted lifespan, they should offer his <s>Agnihotra</s> for that duration; then they should proceed with the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> (initiatory rite) for him.

body.text: (AVPr_3.6:98/7-8) vyākhyātaḥ pātraviniyogo 'pi yathaiva śarīrādarśane |
body.translated_text: The distribution of vessels (<s>pātraviniyoga</s>) has been explained, just as in the case when the body is not found.

body.text: (AVPr_3.6:98/8-9) sa cej jīvann āgachet kathaṃ vā proṣyāgatāya yathākāryaṃ karmāṇi kuryāt | [ed. karṃāṇi]
body.translated_text: If he should come back alive, how should they perform the prescribed rites for one who has returned from abroad?

body.text: (AVPr_3.6:98/9-11) sa cet svayamuttha[ḥ] syād punar asyāgnīn ādhāyādbhutāni vācako japam |
body.translated_text: If he should have risen of his own accord, they should establish his fires again and recite the portent-<s>prāyaścittas</s>, the <s>vācaka</s> recitations.

body.text: (AVPr_3.6:98/11) iti hutvā mārjayitvā tato 'yam āgataḥ karmāṇi kuryāt |
body.translated_text: Having offered and having purified, thereafter, having returned, he should perform the rites.

body.text: (AVPr_3.6:98/12-13) sa cet punar anuttha[ḥ] syāt tathā saṃsthitam evāsya tad agnihotraṃ bhavati |
body.translated_text: If, however, he should not have risen, then his <s>Agnihotra</s> remains concluded as it was.

body.text: (AVPr_3.6:98/13-14) jarāmaryaṃ vā etat sattraṃ yad agnihotram |
body.translated_text: For the <s>Agnihotra</s> is indeed a <s>sattra</s> (session) lasting until old age and death.

body.text: (AVPr_3.6:98/14) iti ha śrutir bhavati || 6 ||
body.translated_text: Thus says the <s>Śruti</s> (revealed text). || 6 ||

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:98/14-16) atha ya āhitāgnir vipravasann agnibhiḥ pramīyeta kathaṃ tatra pātraviniyogaṃ pratīyāt | ity āhāśmarathyaḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if one who has established the sacred fires, while away from home, should die along with his fires—how should one proceed with the distribution of vessels?—thus says <s>Āśmarathya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:98/17-18) yady anyāni pātrāṇi yajñāyudhānīty upasādya vihṛtyāgnim āhṛtya prajvālya vihareyur nirmathyam vā prajvālya viharet |
body.translated_text: If there are other vessels and sacrificial implements, having assembled and arranged them, having brought fire and kindled it, they should distribute [them]; or having kindled by churning, he should distribute.

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:98/19-20) ity etāvatāṅgaprabhṛtibhiḥ saṃsthāpyaivaṃ pātraviniyogam ity anuchādayet |
body.translated_text: Having completed thus far with the <s>aṅga</s> (subsidiary rites) and so forth, one should announce the distribution of vessels.

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:98/20-21) yad yad utsannāḥ syur vāraṇīsahitāni pātrāṇīty apsu samāvapet |
body.translated_text: Whatever [vessels] have fallen out of use, together with the wooden stirring-sticks—he should immerse them in water.

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:98/21) eṣā te 'gne |
body.translated_text: 'This is yours, O <s>Agni</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:99/1) yo agnis |
body.translated_text: 'Which <s>Agni</s>—'

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:99/1-3) tayā me hy āroha tayā me hy āviśety aśmamayāni vā lohamayāni vā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradadyāt |
body.translated_text: 'Ascend for me through that, enter into me through that'—whether they be of stone or of metal, he should give them to Brahmins.

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:99/3) daśarātraṃ niyatavratā[ḥ] syuḥ |
body.translated_text: They should observe strict vows for ten days.

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:99/3-4) saṃvatsaraṃ cāpi gotriṇaḥ |
body.translated_text: And those of the same <s>gotra</s> (lineage), for a year.

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:99/4) ekādaśyāṃ keśaśmaśrulomanakhāni vāpayitvā |
body.translated_text: On the eleventh day, having shaved the hair of the head, beard, body-hair, and nails,

body.text: (AVPr_3.7:99/5-6) adbhutāni prāyaścittāni vācākāṃ japam iti hutvā mārjayitvā tato yathāsukhacāriṇo bhavanti || 7 ||
body.translated_text: having offered the portent <s>prāyaścittas</s>, the <s>vācaka</s> recitations, and having purified—thereafter they live as they please. || 7 ||

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/6-9) atha yady enam anāhitāgnim iva vṛthāgninā daheyur evam asyaiṣa mṛtpātraviniyogeti patnya bhavatīty āhāśmarathyaḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, if they should cremate him with an ordinary fire as if he had not established the sacred fires, then this is the earthen-vessel distribution for him—it belongs to the wife, says <s>Āśmarathya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/9) nety āhatuḥ kāṇvagopāyanau |
body.translated_text: 'No,' say <s>Kāṇva</s> and <s>Gopāyana</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/9-11) yadaiva kārmābhy adhvaryur vihitas tadaiva sarvakratūn praty āpado vihitāḥ | ity āhur ācāryāḥ |
body.translated_text: 'As soon as the ritual procedure is administered by the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, remedies for all sacrifices against calamities are thereby prescribed'—thus say the teachers.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/11-13) atha katham asyām āpattau yathaiva śarīrādarśane vā samāmnātānām āpadāṃ kathaṃ tatra pātraviniyogaṃ pratīyād ity āhāśmarathyaḥ |
body.translated_text: But how, in this calamity or when the body is not found, should one proceed with the distribution of vessels for the prescribed emergencies?—thus says <s>Āśmarathya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/14-16) araṇyor agnīn samāropya śarīrāṇām ardham ..... eṣā tūṣṇīṃ nirmathya prajvālya vihṛtya madhye 'gnīnām edhāṃś citvā darbhān saṃstīrya tatrāsya śarīrāṇi nidadhyuḥ |
body.translated_text: Having placed the fires upon the fire-sticks (<s>araṇī</s>), half of the bodily remains... having silently churned and kindled [fire], having distributed, having piled fuel-sticks in the midst of the fires and strewn <s>darbha</s> grass, they should place his bodily remains there.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/16-17) bhāruṇḍasāmāni gāpayet |
body.translated_text: He should have the <s>Bhāruṇḍa</s> <s>Sāmans</s> (chants) sung.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/17-18) yady agāthaḥ syād athāpy asāma kuryāt |
body.translated_text: If he is not capable of singing, then he should perform the rite without <s>Sāman</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/18-20) śarīrādarśane pālāśatsarūṇy āhṛtyāthaitāni puruṣākṛtīni kṛtvā ghṛt[en]ābhyajya māṃsatvagasthy asya ghṛtaṃ ca bhavatīti ha vijñāyate | [ed. vi(r)jñā-]
body.translated_text: When the body is not found, having brought <s>Palāśa</s> (Butea) wood, having fashioned them into the form of a man, and having anointed [them] with ghee—this represents his flesh, skin, bones, and ghee—so it is known.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/20-22) yady āhavanīyo devalokaṃ yadi dakṣiṇāgniḥ pitṛlokaṃ yadi gārhapatyo mānuṣyalokaṃ |
body.translated_text: If the <s>Āhavanīya</s> [goes first], [he goes to] the world of the gods; if the <s>Dakṣiṇāgni</s>, to the world of the ancestors; if the <s>Gārhapatya</s>, to the world of humans.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/22-23) yadi yugapat sarveṣv asya lokeṣv avaruddhaṃ bhavatīti ha vijñāyate |
body.translated_text: If simultaneously, he is held in all his worlds—so it is known.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/23-25) tasmād yugapad eva sarvāṃt sādayitvātha yady enam an[v]ālabheta punar dahet |
body.translated_text: Therefore, having extinguished all [fires] simultaneously, if one should touch him [the effigy], one should cremate again.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/25) stenam iva tv eva brūyāt |
body.translated_text: But one should declare him as a thief.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99/25-27) yat kiṃ cāvidhivihitaṃ karma kriyate tasyaiṣaiva sarvasya k;lptiḥ sarvasya prāyaścittiś ceti hi śrutir bhavati |
body.translated_text: Whatever ritual act is performed contrary to the prescribed rules—for all of that, this alone is the remedy, this alone is the expiation—thus says the <s>Śruti</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:99-100/27-1) athāpy atrāgner ayatā somatanūr bhavati |
body.translated_text: And here also, the <s>Soma</s>-body of <s>Agni</s> becomes unrestrained.

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:100/1-2) samanvāgamevāvāṃ karmasu samanv ātrāgamayet |
body.translated_text: 'May we both follow together in the rites; may he follow here together.'

body.text: (AVPr_3.8:100/2-4) yat kiṃcid yajñe viriṣṭam āpadyeta tasyaiṣaiva sarvasya k;lptiḥ sārvasya prāyaścittiś ca | iti hi śrutir bhavati || 8 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever damage occurs in the sacrifice—for all of that, this alone is the remedy, this alone is the expiation—thus says the <s>Śruti</s>. || 8 ||

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/4-5) athātaḥ sattriṇāṃ vakṣyāmaḥ |
body.translated_text: Now we shall speak about the <s>Sattrin</s> (participants in a <s>Sattra</s> communal sacrifice).

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/5-7) pravṛtte tantre 'ntastantre vā gṛhapatir upatāpaḥ yasyāyur gṛhī[t]vānugacheḥ kāmaṃ tasya putraṃ bhrātaraṃ vopadīkṣya samāpnuyur |
body.translated_text: If, during the ongoing ritual or within the ritual procedure, the <s>Gṛhapati</s> (householder-patron) should fall ill, one should follow him taking his lifespan; willingly, having consecrated his son or brother as substitute, they should complete [the rite].

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/7-8) (na samāpnuyur) |
body.translated_text: (They should not complete it.)

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/8) na vā ṛtvijāṃ caikam iva |
body.translated_text: Nor [should they substitute] one of the <s>ṛtvij</s> (priests) as if he were [the householder].

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/8-9) nety āhāśmarathyaḥ |
body.translated_text: 'No,' says <s>Āśmarathya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/9) na hi gṛhapater upadīkṣā vidyate |
body.translated_text: For there is no provision for substitute-consecration of the <s>Gṛhapati</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/9-10) gṛhapatiṃ samīkṣya yadi manyeta |
body.translated_text: Examining the <s>Gṛhapati</s>, if one thinks,

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/10-11) jīved ayam ahorātrāv ity ekāhāny (ekadvivāsavane) sarvāṇi savanāni samāveśayet |
body.translated_text: 'This one will live a day and a night,' one should compress all the <s>savanas</s> (pressings) into a single-day ceremony.

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/11-12) yasmiṃs tu samāveśayet tasya savanasya vaśam upayāntītarāṇi |
body.translated_text: Whichever <s>savana</s> he compresses into, the others come under its authority.

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/12-14) savanāni nānātantrāṇi ced api bhavanti durgāpattau ca samāse veṣṭīnāṃ samāveśa[yed] vakṣyakāmaḥ |
body.translated_text: Even if the <s>savanas</s> have separate ritual threads, in a dire emergency one desiring brevity should compress the <s>iṣṭis</s> (offerings).

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/14-16) yāḥ kāś caikatantrā iṣṭaya[ḥ] syur avyavahitāḥ kāmaṃ tā ekatantre samāveśya haviṣām ānupūrvyeṇa pracaret |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>iṣṭis</s> may be of a single ritual thread, uninterrupted—one may willingly compress them into a single thread and proceed with the oblations in their proper sequence.

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/16-17) prāk sviṣṭakṛto mukhaṃ tu pañcājyāhutīr juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Before the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> (the deity's share), he should offer five <s>ājya</s> oblations as the opening.

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/17-18) agnaye somāya viṣṇava indrāgnibhyāṃ prajāpataya iti |
body.translated_text: To <s>Agni</s>, to <s>Soma</s>, to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, to <s>Indrāgnī</s>, and to <s>Prajāpati</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.9:100/18-20) yadi sauviṣtakṛtyā pracaranti khalu vai yadi bahūni vā sruveṇa yathāvadānenātikrāmet || 9 ||
body.translated_text: If they proceed with the <s>Sauviṣṭakṛtya</s> (post-offering rite), indeed, if there are many [offerings], he should pass over them with the ladle in the manner prescribed. || 9 ||

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:100/20) athātaḥ sa[t]triṇāṃ vakṣyāmaḥ |
body.translated_text: Now we shall speak about the <s>Sattrins</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:100/21-22) pravṛtte tantre saṃnaddhedhmābarhiṣi paścāc candramasaṃ paśyet |
body.translated_text: When the ritual is in progress, after the fuel and sacred grass have been prepared, one should observe the moon in the west.

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:100/22-23) ya eṣāmā(mā)vāsyāyām āgneyaḥ puroḍāśas taṃ pāthikṛtaṃ karoti prakṛtyetaraṃ vinā |
body.translated_text: The <s>Āgneya</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> that belongs to them on the new-moon day—he makes it the <s>Pāthikṛta</s> (path-making offering), the other one being the standard form.

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:100/23-24) etad yajñaś chidyate ya etām antareṣṭiṃ tanvīta | iti hi śrutir bhavati |
body.translated_text: 'The sacrifice is broken for one who performs this intermediate <s>iṣṭi</s>'—thus says the <s>Śruti</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:100-101/24-2) atha yasya paurṇamāsyaṃ (vā) vyāpadyeta kāmaṃ tatra prākṛtīḥ kuryāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if the full-moon [offering] should be spoiled, one may willingly perform the standard rites for that.

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:101/2-3) tad ya[ḥ] kratur [dyāvākrato vā vāyo] vidyate 'tha nirvapati |
body.translated_text: Whatever rite is known—then he prepares:

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:101/3-4) āgneyam aṣṭākapālam aindram ekādaśakapālam āsādya havīṃṣi prāyaścittīr juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Having placed an eight-<s>kapāla</s> <s>Āgneya</s> (cake for <s>Agni</s>) and an eleven-<s>kapāla</s> <s>Aindra</s> (cake for <s>Indra</s>), and having set down the oblations, he should offer the <s>prāyaścitta</s> oblations.

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:101/4-6) yad udagān mahato mahimā asya māno asya jagataḥ pārthivasya mā naḥ prāpad duchunā kācid anyā | [ed. uchunā, cf. PS 19.16.5d]
body.translated_text: 'That which has gone upward—great is its majesty; it is the measure of this earthly world. May no misfortune befall us from any other quarter.'

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:101/6-7) kasmai devāya haviṣā paridadema svāheti |
body.translated_text: 'To which god should we offer this oblation? <s>Svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:101/7) athātaḥ paśubandhaḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, the <s>Paśubandha</s> (animal sacrifice).

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:101/7-9) pari yajñasya bhojyasya bhojyavatkā mo ye kecit tatrasthāḥ paśavaḥ somakāriṇā teṣāṃ bhakṣabhakṣaṇaṃ |
body.translated_text: Regarding the sacrificial feast: whatever animals are present there, being <s>Soma</s>-performers—their ritual partaking of the <s>bhakṣa</s> [is prescribed].

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:101/9-10) tad yathā |
body.translated_text: Namely, as follows:

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:101/10-12) varāha-mārjā[ra]-māhiṣāṃ śakuno 'nyo 'vadānāni māṃsāni jāṃgalāni ca yady aśiṣaḥ syān māsi māsi ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If one should eat boar, cat, buffalo, bird, or other meat portions, or wild game meat, one should offer the <s>Ṣaḍḍhotṛ</s> oblation month by month.

body.text: (AVPr_3.10:101/12-19) sūryaṃ te cakṣur gacchatu vāto ātmānaṃ prāṇo dyāṃ pṛṣṭham antarikṣam ātmāṅgair yajñaṃ pṛthivīṃ śarīraiḥ vācaspate 'chidrayā vācāchidrayā juhvā devāvṛdhaṃ divi hotrām airayat svāheti ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ hutvā prajāpatiḥ sarvam evedam utsṛjet | iti hi śrutir bhavati ||10|| (ity atharvavede vaitānasūtre prāyaścittaprasaṃge ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ iti yajñaprāyaścitte tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ) [ed. tritīyo]
body.translated_text: 'May your eye go to the sun, your breath to the wind, your back to heaven, your body to the atmosphere, your limbs to the sacrifice, your body to the earth. O <s>Vācaspati</s>, with unbreached speech, with unbreached ladle, he raised the god-increasing <s>Hotrā</s> to heaven, <s>svāhā</s>.'—Having offered the <s>Ṣaḍḍhotṛ</s>, <s>Prajāpati</s> should release all this. Thus says the <s>Śruti</s>. || 10 || (Thus ends the third chapter of the <s>Yajñaprāyaścitta</s>, the eleventh chapter in the context of <s>prāyaścitta</s> in the <s>Vaitānasūtra</s> of the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.)

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:101/20-21) (sānnāyyaṃ yad udbo)dhayeyuś ced vatsā vāyavyā(yā) yavāgvā sā[nnāy]yaṃ yajeta |
body.translated_text: If they should revive the <s>sāṃnāyya</s>, and the calves—a gruel for <s>Vāyu</s>; he should sacrifice with the <s>sāṃnāyya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:101-102/21-1) apy ekasyā[ṃ] dhītāyām adhītā dohayet |
body.translated_text: Even if milked from only one cow, he should have it milked.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:102/1-2) adhītābhiḥ saṃsthāpya dhītānām vatsān apākṛtya śvaḥ sāṃnāyyena yajeta |
body.translated_text: Having concluded with the milked [portions], having removed the calves of the milked cows, the next day he should sacrifice with the <s>sāṃnāyya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:102-103/2-2) sāyaṃ dohaṃ ced apahareyuḥ prātardohaṃ dvaidhaṃ kṛtvānyatarat sāyaṃdohasthāne kṛtvobhābhyāṃ yajeta |
body.translated_text: If they should take away the evening milking, having divided the morning milking in two, placing one part in place of the evening milking, he should sacrifice with both.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:103/2-5) prātardohaṃ ced apahareyuḥ sāyaṃdohaṃ dvaidhaṃ kṛtvānyatarat prātardohasthāne kṛtvobhābhyāṃ yajeta |
body.translated_text: If they should take away the morning milking, having divided the evening milking in two, placing one part in place of the morning milking, he should sacrifice with both.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:103/5-7) ubhau ced duṣyeyātām aindraṃ pañcaśarāvam odanaṃ nirupyāgneyena pracaryaindreṇānupracared uttarām upoṣya(to) v(ād)obhābhyāṃ yajeta |
body.translated_text: If both should be spoiled, having prepared a five-dish rice-porridge for <s>Indra</s>, proceeding first with the <s>Āgneya</s> (rite for <s>Agni</s>) and then with the <s>Aindra</s> (rite for <s>Indra</s>), having fasted the next day, he should sacrifice with both.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:103-104/7-1) sarvāṇi ced dhavīṃṣy apahareyur duṣyeyur vājyena ca devatā yajeta |
body.translated_text: If all the oblation materials should be taken away or spoiled, he should sacrifice to the deity with <s>ājya</s> alone.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:104/1-2) athānyām adoṣām iṣṭiṃ tanvītā(m | a)po duṣṭam abhyavahareyur |
body.translated_text: Then he should perform another faultless <s>iṣṭi</s>. The spoiled oblation should be disposed of in water.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:104/2) brāhmaṇair abhakṣ[y]a[ṃ] duṣṭaṃ havir |
body.translated_text: A spoiled oblation is not to be consumed by Brahmins.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:104/3-5) bhūtaṃ ced ājyaṃ skanded bhūpataye svāheti tribhir prādeśair diśo mimāya tad yajamāno devāñ janam agann ity anuṣaṅgaḥ |
body.translated_text: If the consecrated <s>ājya</s> should spill—'To the Lord of Existence (<s>Bhūpati</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!'—having measured the quarters with three spans, 'The sacrificer has gone to the gods'—this is the continuation.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:104/5-6) yajñasya tvā pramayeti catasṛbhiḥ parigṛhṇīyāt |
body.translated_text: With 'The measure of the sacrifice, you' and the four [verses], one should take hold.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:104/6-7) yajñasya tvā pramayonmayābhimayā pratimayā (paridadema) svāheti |
body.translated_text: 'The measure of the sacrifice—by forward measure, upward measure, counter-measure, and reverse measure we [consign you], <s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:104-105/7-1) anutpūtaṃ ced ājyaṃ skanded vittaṃ prāṇaṃ dadyāt |
body.translated_text: If unpurified <s>ājya</s> should spill, one would lose one's wealth and <s>prāṇa</s> (life-breath).

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:105/1-4) tathotpūtam utpūyamānaṃ ced ghṛtaṃ dadyād athotpūtam utpūyamānaṃ ced ghṛtaṃ prāṇaṃ dadyād devatāntare ced ghṛtam |
body.translated_text: Likewise if purified; if <s>ghṛta</s> (ghee) being purified should spill, it would give [loss of] <s>prāṇa</s>; if it is between deities, then [loss of] the ghee.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:105/4) āhutilopavyatyāse |
body.translated_text: In case of reversal or omission of oblations:

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:105/4-5) tvaṃ no agne | sa tvaṃ na | iti sarvaprāyaścittaṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, for us'; 'You yourself, for us'—one should offer as the all-encompassing <s>prāyaścitta</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:105/6-8) <tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvān devasya heḍo 'vayāsisīṣṭhāḥ | yajiṣṭho vahnitamaḥ śośucāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi pramumugdhy asmat [.RV 4.1.4]> ||
body.translated_text: 'O <s>Agni</s>, knowing the wrath of the god <s>Varuṇa</s>, may you seek to avert it from us. Most worshipping, most carrying, blazing—release from us all hatreds.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:105/8-10) <sa tvaṃ no agne 'vamo bhavotī nediṣṭho asyā uṣaṣo vyuṣṭau | ava yakṣva no varuṇaṃ rarāṇo vīhi mṛḍīkaṃ suhavo na edhi svāhā [.RV 4.1.5]>_iti |
body.translated_text: 'O <s>Agni</s>, be you the nearest to us in this dawning of this <s>Uṣas</s>; appease <s>Varuṇa</s> for us, being gracious; seek for us well-being, be easy to invoke, <s>svāhā</s>'—with this [verse].

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:105-106/10-2) devatāvadāne yājyānuvākyāvyatyāse 'nāmnātaprāyaścittānāṃ vā yady ṛkto 'bhy ābādhaḥ syād bhūr janad iti gārhapatye juhuyāt | [ed. -vyatyāsa]
body.translated_text: In the interchange of the invocatory (<s>yājyā</s>) and offering (<s>anuvākyā</s>) verses at the deity-offering, or when unnamed <s>prāyaścittas</s> (expiations) [are needed]—if the error pertains to the <s>Ṛk</s>, one should offer in the <s>Gārhapatya</s> with '<s>Bhūḥ</s>, may it generate.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:106/2) yadi yajuṣṭa oṃ bhuvo janad iti dakṣiṇāgnau juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If it pertains to the <s>Yajus</s>, '<s>Oṃ Bhuvaḥ</s>, may it generate'—one should offer in the <s>Dakṣiṇāgni</s> (southern fire).

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:106/3) yadi sāmata oṃ svar janad ity āhavanīye juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If it pertains to the <s>Sāman</s>, '<s>Oṃ Svaḥ</s>, may it generate'—one should offer in the <s>Āhavanīya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:106/3-7) yady anājñātā brahmata om bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om ity āhavanīya eva juhuyād ājyabhāgānte sve devatām āvāhayiṣyan yasyai(va) havir niruptaṃ syāt tatontayā yajetājyasyaitāni nirupya |
body.translated_text: If it pertains to the <s>Brahman</s> (Atharvan) and is unrecognized, '<s>Oṃ Bhūr Bhuvaḥ Svaḥ</s>, may it generate, <s>Oṃ</s>'—one should offer in the <s>Āhavanīya</s> itself. At the end of the <s>ājyabhāga</s> portions, when about to invoke the deity, for whichever deity the offering was prepared, one should sacrifice with that concluding formula, having apportioned these <s>ājya</s> offerings.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:106/7-9) yadi bhāginīṃ nāvāhayed yatra smaret tatrainām upotthāyāvāhyāvāpasthāne yajeta |
body.translated_text: If he should not invoke the entitled deity, wherever he remembers, rising up from there and invoking her, he should sacrifice at the <s>avāpasthāna</s> (appointed place).

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:106/9) barhiṣi skanne nādriyeta |
body.translated_text: If [the oblation] has fallen on the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass), he should not heed it.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:106-107/9-1) dakṣiṇena ced yajetārddharcāt pratiṣṭhāṃ dadyāt |
body.translated_text: If he sacrifices from the right side, he should give stability from a half-verse.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:107/1-2) puroḍāśe du[ḥ]śrite sarpiṣy annaṃ catuḥśarāvam odanaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadyāt |
body.translated_text: If the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake) is badly cooked, he should give four bowls of food with ghee and rice to the Brahmins.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:107/3) tatas tam eva punar nirvapet |
body.translated_text: Then he should prepare that very same [offering] again.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:107/4-5) puroḍāśe vikṣāme yato 'syākṣāmaḥ syāt tato yajeta | [ed. purodāṣe]
body.translated_text: If the <s>puroḍāśa</s> becomes partially spoiled, he should sacrifice from the part that is unspoiled.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:107/5) dveṣyāya taṃ dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ ca |
body.translated_text: He should give the [spoiled] part, along with the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (fee), to an enemy.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:107-108/5-1) puroḍāśe sarvakṣāme nirvapaṇaprabhṛtyām udāhṛtya |
body.translated_text: If the <s>puroḍāśa</s> is completely spoiled, [one should repeat] from the beginning of the preparation onwards.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:108/1-2) kapāle naṣṭa ekahāyanaṃ dadyāt |
body.translated_text: If a <s>kapāla</s> (potsherd) is lost, he should give a yearling [cow].

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:108-109/2-2) <dhātā dadhātu pituḥ pitānaṣṭo gharmo viśvāyur yato jātas tato 'py avāṃ svāhā [cf. Mān;SS 3.1.24-25]>_iti juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: 'May <s>Dhātṛ</s> bestow—the father of the father—the lost <s>gharma</s> (hot milk offering), of universal life; from where born, thence also us two, <s>svāhā</s>'—thus he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:109/2-3) kapāle bhinne <gāyatryā tvā śatākṣarayā saṃdadhāmi [MS 1.4.13:62.19]>_iti saṃdhāya <dhātā dadhātu [see above]>_ity eva juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If a <s>kapāla</s> is broken—having joined it with 'With the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, the hundred-syllabled, I join you'—he should offer with 'May <s>Dhātṛ</s> bestow' as above.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:109/4-5) āgneya[m] ekakapālaṃ nirvaped āśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālaṃ saumyaṃ catuḥkapālaṃ |
body.translated_text: He should prepare a one-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni</s>, a two-<s>kapāla</s> for the <s>Aśvins</s>, a three-<s>kapāla</s> for <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and a four-<s>kapāla</s> for <s>Soma</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:109/5-8) naṣṭe bhinne ca bhārgavo hotā kīṭāvapannaṃ sānnāyyaṃ madhyamena parṇena <mahī dyauḥ [.RV 1.22.13]>_ity antaḥparidhideśe ninayet |
body.translated_text: When [a <s>kapāla</s>] is lost or broken, the <s>Bhārgava</s> <s>Hotṛ</s> should carry the <s>sānnāyya</s> (mixed milk offering) contaminated by insects to the space within the enclosing sticks, using the middle <s>palāśa</s> leaf, with 'Great heaven.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:109-110/8-1) <mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatāṃ | piprtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ svāhā [.RV 1.22.13]>_iti |
body.translated_text: 'May great heaven and earth satisfy this sacrifice of ours; may they fill us with nourishments, <s>svāhā</s>'—with this [verse].

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:110-111/1-5) prāk prayājebhyo 'ṅgāraṃ barhisy adhiṣkanden <namas te astv āyate namo astu parāyate | namo yatra niṣīdasi [TB 3.7.2.7]>_ity abhimantrya_<āhaṃ yajñaṃ dadhe nirṛter upasthāt taṃ deveṣu paridadāmi vidvān | suprajās tvaṃ śataṃ hi māmadanta iha no devā mahi śarma yachata>_ity ādāya <sahasraśṛṅgaḥ [PS 18.16.2, ;SS 4.5.1]>_ity anuprahṛtya |
body.translated_text: If before the <s>prayājas</s> (preliminary offerings) an ember should jump onto the <s>barhis</s>—having addressed it with 'Homage to you going forth, homage to you going away; homage where you sit down,' and taking it up with 'I take up the sacrifice from the lap of <s>Nirṛti</s>; I give it to the gods, knowing. Rich in offspring, you—for a hundred [years] they delight me; O gods, grant us great shelter here,' and having offered it up with 'Thousand-horned.'
'May not the great one [harm] us.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:111/5) <tvaṃ no agne [see above]> |
body.translated_text: 'You, O <s>Agni</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:111/5-7) <somānaṃ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ [.RV 1.18.1]> |
body.translated_text: 'O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, make <s>Soma</s> beautiful-sounding, even as <s>Kakṣīvān</s> who is the son of <s>Uśij</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:111/7) <sa tvaṃ no 'gne [see above]> |
body.translated_text: 'You, O <s>Agni</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:111/7-8) <vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ viśvarūpam adābhyaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ vareṇyaṃ [.RV 3.62.6]> |
body.translated_text: 'The bull of the peoples, of all forms, inviolable, <s>Bṛhaspati</s> most excellent.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:111/8-9) <ud uttamaṃ mumugdhi no vi pāśaṃ madhyamaṃ cṛta avādhamāni bādhata [cf. .RV 1.25.21]> |
body.translated_text: 'Release us upward from the uppermost [bond]; cut through the middle snare; thrust away the lower ones.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.1:111/9-10) <ud uttamaṃ varuṇa [PS 18.82.6, ;SS 7.83.3/18.4.69]>_ity etābhir juhuyāt || 1 ||
body.translated_text: 'Upward, the highest, O <s>Varuṇa</s>'—with these [verses] he should offer. || 1 ||

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:111/10-12) sarvāṇi ced āhutivelāyāṃ patny anālambhukā syāt tām aparudhya yajeta |
body.translated_text: If at the time of all oblations the wife should be in a state of impurity, having secluded her, he should sacrifice.

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:111-112/12-1) samāpyāmo 'ham asmi sā tvam iti tasyā dakṣiṇaṃ hastam anvālabhyopāhvayīta |
body.translated_text: Having completed [the rite], 'I am the male, you are the female'—having touched her right hand, he should call her back.

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:112/1-3) āhutiś ced bahiṣparidhi skanded āgnīdhraṃ brūyuḥ saṃkrahiṣyāṃ tvā juhudhīti |
body.translated_text: If the oblation should leap beyond the enclosing sticks, one should tell the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> (fire-kindler) priest: 'I shall restrain; you offer.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:112/3-4) tasmai pūrṇapātraṃ dadyāt |
body.translated_text: One should give him a full vessel [as a gift].

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:112/4-6) puroḍāśaś ced adhiśrita udvijed utpated vā tam udvāsya barhiṣy āsādayet kim utpatasi kim utproṣṭhāḥ śāntaḥ śānter ihāgahi |
body.translated_text: If the <s>puroḍāśa</s> already placed on the fire should jump up or fly off, having removed it, one should place it on the <s>barhis</s>: 'Why do you fly up? Why do you flee? Calmed, come here for the sake of peace;

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:112-113/6-1) aghoro yajñiyo bhūtvāsīda sadanaṃ svam āsīda sadanaṃ svam ||
body.translated_text: having become non-terrible and fit for sacrifice, sit in your own seat, sit in your own seat.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:113/1-3) mā hiṃsīr deva preṣita ājyena tejasājyasva mā naḥ kiṃcana rīriṣo | yogakṣemasya śāntyā asmin āsīda barhir iti |
body.translated_text: 'O god-sent one, do not harm! Blaze with the splendor of <s>ājya</s>; do not injure anything of ours. For the peace of prosperity and security, sit upon this <s>barhis</s>'—thus.

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:113/3-4) taptaṃ cet karma (guṇo) tv antariyāt sarvaprāyaścittaṃ hutvā modvijet |
body.translated_text: If, when the action is in progress, a defect should intervene—having offered the all-<s>prāyaścitta</s> (complete expiation), one should not be troubled.

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:113/4-6) (nāṅgāhutim antarhitāṃ dadyān | na ta-pa-varga-nimittābhāvāt pradhānalope 'ntarāye vā nirvaped vyāpadyeta) |
body.translated_text: (One should not give an intermediate limb-oblation; without the cause of the <s>ta</s>-<s>pa</s> class [of sounds], when there is loss of the main [offering] or an obstacle, one should prepare [anew] or it would be destroyed.)

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:113/6-7) śeṣ(ād avadyeṣ)aś ced vyāpadyetājyena sviṣṭakṛdiḍe samāpnuyāt |
body.translated_text: If, after the remainder, the offering portions should be damaged, one should complete with the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> <s>iḍā</s> offering using <s>ājya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:113/8-9) samāpte ced duṣṭo na kṛtām antarāṃ vā vidyāt punariṣṭir abhyāvarteta |
body.translated_text: If, after completion, [the sacrificer] discovers it was flawed or finds an intervening [error]—a re-performance of the <s>iṣṭi</s> should be undertaken.

body.text: (AVPr_4.2:113/9) yajño yajñasya prāyaścittir bhavatīti || 2 [||]
body.translated_text: 'Sacrifice is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for sacrifice'—thus. || 2 ||

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:113/10-11) agnyādheye samitsv āhitāsu nāgniṃ gṛhād uddhareyur nānyata āhareyur |
body.translated_text: At the <s>Agnyādheya</s> (fire-establishment), when the fuel-sticks have been placed, one should neither take the fire out of the house nor bring it from elsewhere.

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:113/11) na prayāyān nānugachet |
body.translated_text: One should not depart, nor should one follow [a departing fire].

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:113/11-13) yadi prayāyād anugached vā saṃvatsaraṃ saṃvatsarābhiprāyo vā yadi tvared brahmaudanaṃ paktvā punaḥ samidham abhyādadhyāt |
body.translated_text: If one should depart or follow, for a year—or one whose intention is for a year—if pressed for time, having cooked <s>brahmaudana</s> (Brahmin's rice), one should again place fuel upon [the fire].

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:113/13-15) agnihotraṃ ced anabhyuddhṛtaṃ śaraśarāsyād amuṃ samūheti brūyāt |
body.translated_text: If the <s>Agnihotra</s>, not having been taken out, should be [scattered] by arrows—one should say, 'Gather that together.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:113/15-16) viṣyannam <agne tvaṃ naḥ [.RV 5.24.1, KauśS 68.31]>_iti juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If [the milk] has been spoiled, one should offer with 'O <s>Agni</s>, you for us.'

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:113/16-19) madhyamena parṇena <mahī dyaur [see above]> iti tan (madhyame palāśāvāṇaparṇena <mahī dyaur> iti tan mamadhyame palāśāvāṇaparṇena <mahī dyaur> ity) antaḥparidhideśe ninayet |
body.translated_text: With the middle <s>palāśa</s> leaf, with 'Great heaven,' he should carry it to the space within the enclosing sticks.

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:113-114/19-1) [d]uhyamānā ced avabhi[n]dyād anyasyāṃ sthālyāṃ dohayitvādhiśrayet |
body.translated_text: If [the milk] should split while being milked, having milked into another vessel, one should heat it.

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:114/1-4) adhiśriyamāṇaṃ ce[t] skanded adhiśritam unnīyamānam unnītaṃ punar eva sannam ahutaṃ skandet punar ānīyānyāṃ dohayitvādhiśrityonnīya juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If it should spill while being heated, or after being heated, or while being taken out, or after being taken out, or even after settling if not yet offered, it spills—one should bring it back again, milk into another [vessel], heat it, take it out, and offer.

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:114/4-6) prācīnaṃ ced dhriyamāṇaṃ skandet prajāpater viśvabhṛtaḥ skannāhutam asi svāheti | [ed. prajapater]
body.translated_text: If it should spill while being held toward the east—'You are the spilled-but-unoffered of <s>Prajāpati Viśvabhṛt</s> (All-sustainer), <s>svāhā</s>'—thus.

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:114-115/6-3) dohanaprabhṛtyā homa skandet <samudraṃ tvā prahiṇomi [PS 20.27.7, cf. ;SS 10.5.23]>_ity apo ninīya_<ud uttamam> ity abhimantrya_<ud uttamaṃ mumugdhi naḥ [see above]>_<ud uttamam varuṇa [see above]>_iti vāruṇy(en)ājyāhutīr juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If it should spill at any point from the milking up to the offering—having carried the water away with 'I send you to the ocean,' having addressed it with 'Upward the highest,' he should offer <s>Vāruṇī</s> <s>ājya</s> oblations with 'Upward the highest, release us' and 'Upward the highest, O <s>Varuṇa</s>.'

body.text: % note samudraṃ tvā = Paippalāda form of the mantra; ;SS has samudraṃ vaḥ.
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: <s>samudraṃ tvā</s> = Paippalāda form of the mantra; ŚS has <s>samudraṃ vaḥ</s>.]

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:115-116/3-1) (chāvalīṃ deva) sāyaṃ [yasya] skanno homaḥ syāt prātar nāśnīyāt |
body.translated_text: If the evening offering should have been spilled, one should not eat in the morning.

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:116/2) prāta[r ya]sya skanno homaḥ [syāt] sāyaṃ nāśnīyān |
body.translated_text: If the morning offering should have been spilled, one should not eat in the evening.

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:116/3-4) (mantraskannaṃ) ced abhivarṣen <mitro janān yātayati [.RV 3.59.1]>_iti samidham ādhāyānyā(ṃ) dugdhvā punar juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If the mantra-consecrated [offering] should be rained upon—with '<s>Mitra</s> directs the people,' having placed a fuel-stick, having milked into another [vessel], one should offer again.

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:116/4-7) <mitro janān yātayati bruvāṇo mitro dādhāra pṛthivīm uta dyāṃ | mitraḥ kṛṣṭīr animiṣābhicaṣṭe mitrāya havyaṃ ghṛtavaj juhota svāhā [see above]>_iti mantrasaṃskṛtaṃ |
body.translated_text: '<s>Mitra</s> directs the people as he speaks; <s>Mitra</s> sustains the earth and heaven; <s>Mitra</s> watches over the peoples without blinking; to <s>Mitra</s> offer the oblation rich in ghee, <s>svāhā</s>'—thus, mantra-consecrated.

body.text: (AVPr_4.3:116/7-9) kīṭāvapannaṃ <hiraṇyagarbhaḥ [PS 4.1.1, ;SS 4.2.7]>_iti valmīkavapāyām avanīyānyāṃ dugdhvā punar juhuyāt || 3 ||
body.translated_text: If contaminated by insects—with '<s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s> (Golden Embryo),' having poured it onto an anthill, having milked into another [vessel], one should offer again. || 3 ||

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:116-117/9-3) agnihotraṃ ced anabhyuddhṛtaṃ sūryo 'bhyudiyād <ihaiva kṣemya edhi mā prahāsīr mām amum āmuṣyāyaṇam [Aap;SS 9.7.6]> iti śamayitvā praṇīya pravṛttātipattau maitraṃ caruṃ nirvapet sauryam ekakapālaṃ |
body.translated_text: If the <s>Agnihotra</s>, not having been taken out, should be overtaken by sunrise—with 'Stay right here in well-being, do not abandon me, that one, the son of so-and-so,' having pacified it, having led it forward, when there is a lapse in the regular procedure, one should prepare a <s>caru</s> (porridge) for <s>Mitra</s> and a one-<s>kapāla</s> [offering] for <s>Sūrya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:117/4) varo dakṣiṇā |
body.translated_text: A choice [animal] is the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (fee).

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:117/4-5) agnīn upasamādhāya yajamānaḥ patnī vābhuñjānau vāgyatāv araṇīpāṇī sarvāhṇam upāsīyātām |
body.translated_text: Having replenished the fires, the sacrificer and wife, or [the sacrificer alone], not eating, observing silence, holding the fire-churning sticks in hand, should sit the entire day.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:117/6) dvayor gavoḥ sāyam agnihotraṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: In the evening, from two cows, one should offer the <s>Agnihotra</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:117-118/6-1) agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: One should prepare a twelve-<s>kapāla</s> <s>puroḍāśa</s> for <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:118/1-5) yadi hy ayaṃ divā prajāsu hi manyeta <sajūr jātavedo divā pṛthivyā haviṣo vīhi svāhā [cf. MS 1.8.6:123.1]>_iti sajūruho vā syāt <sajūr agnaye divā pṛthivyā haviṣo vīhi svāhā [cf. KS 6.8:57.20/KauśS 74.15]>_iti dvādaśarātram agnihotraṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: For if one should think 'this [fire] indeed [was established] during the day among the people'—with 'Together with <s>Jātavedas</s>, by day, O Earth, partake of the oblation, <s>svāhā</s>'—or if it should be a <s>sajūḥ</s>-offering—with 'Together with <s>Agni</s>, by day, O Earth, partake of the oblation, <s>svāhā</s>'—he should offer the <s>Agnihotra</s> for twelve nights.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:118-119/5-1) yadi na viramayed <agnaye suśīryatamo juṣasva svāhā [?]>_ity aparaṃ dvādaśarātraṃ niśāyāḥ sāyamāhuter atipattir prātarāśe prātarāhuter āsādyāgnihotram ā tamitor āsīta |
body.translated_text: If [the irregularity] does not cease—with 'O <s>Agni</s>, most glowing, be pleased, <s>svāhā</s>'—for another twelve nights. When there is a lapse of the night's evening oblation, [one should fast until] the morning meal; of the morning oblation, having reached the <s>Agnihotra</s> [time], one should sit until darkness.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:119/1-2) saṃsthāpyauṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad [d]oṣā vastoḥ svāheti juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Having concluded, '<s>Oṃ Bhūr Bhuvaḥ Svaḥ</s>, may it generate, evening and morning, <s>svāhā</s>'—thus he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:119/2-3) atha prātar aharaha rātriṃrātrim ity upasthāne syāt |
body.translated_text: Then in the morning—day by day, night by night—thus should be the procedure.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:119/3-4) agnaye 'bhyujjuṣasva svāhā_iti sruveṇa gārhapatye juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: 'O <s>Agni</s>, be pleased, <s>svāhā</s>'—with the sacrificial ladle he should offer in the <s>Gārhapatya</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:119/4-6) yasyānnaṃ nādyāt tasmai brāhmaṇāya dadyāt adhastāt samidham āharet |
body.translated_text: He should give [food] to a Brahmin who would not otherwise eat; one should place a fuel-stick from below.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:119/6) smṛtāgnihotrī tiraśco darbhān dakṣiṇāgrān kuryāt |
body.translated_text: One who remembers the <s>Agnihotrī</s> [cow] should place <s>darbha</s> grass sideways with tips pointing south.

body.text: (AVPr_4.4:119-120/7-2) yasyobhāv anugatau sūryo 'bhinimloced abhyudiyād vāraṇiṃ gatā vā naśyeyur asamārūḍhā vā prakṛtyaiva punar ādadhīta || 4 || iti yajnaprāyaścitte caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ||
body.translated_text: If for one whose both [fires] have been followed, the sun should set or rise [during the procedure], or if the fire-churning sticks should be lost or not mounted [on the fire]—one should re-establish [the fires] simply according to the regular procedure. || 4 || Thus ends the fourth chapter on sacrifice-<s>prāyaścitta</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:121/1-2) agnihotraṃ ced anabhyuddhṛtaṃ sūryo 'bhinimloced brāhmaṇo bahuvid uddharet |
body.translated_text: If the <s>Agnihotra</s>, not having been taken out, should be overtaken by sunset—a learned Brahmin should take it out.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:121/2-3) yo brāhmaṇo bahuvit syāt samuddharet |
body.translated_text: Whichever Brahmin is learned should lift it out.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:121/3-4) sarveṇaivainaṃ tad brāhmaṇa uddhared yenāntarhita[ṃ] hiraṇyam agrato haret |
body.translated_text: The Brahmin should lift it out entirely, by which [means] the gold placed within should be taken in front.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:121/4-5) vāruṇaṃ yavamayaṃ caruṃ nirvaped <ita eva prathamam> iti |
body.translated_text: One should prepare a <s>caru</s> (porridge) of barley for <s>Varuṇa</s>, with 'From here itself, first.'

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:121-122/5-4) <ita eva prathamaṃ jājñe agnir ābhyo yonibhyo adhi jātavedāḥ | sa gāyatryā triṣṭubhā jagatyānuṣṭubhā devo devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan [KauśS 133.6, TB 1.4.4.8]>_iti paścād gārhapatyalakṣaṇasyāraṇī nidhāya mathitvā |
body.translated_text: 'From here itself, first was born <s>Agni</s>, from these wombs, <s>Jātavedas</s>; may he, the god, knowing, carry the oblation to the gods with <s>Gāyatrī</s>, <s>Triṣṭubh</s>, <s>Jagatī</s>, and <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>'—having placed the fire-churning sticks behind the mark of the <s>Gārhapatya</s> and having churned.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:121/1-2) <iṣe rāyyai ramasva [TB 1.4.4.8]>_ity ādadhyāt |
body.translated_text: 'For nourishment, for wealth, delight'—thus he should establish [the fire].

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:122/4-6) <iṣe rāyyai ramasva sahase dyumna ūrje 'patyāya | saṃrāḍ asi svarāḍ asi sārasvatau tvotsau prāvatām [cf. TB 1.4.4.8]> iti | [ed. rayyai]
body.translated_text: 'For nourishment, for wealth, delight; for strength, for splendor, for food, for offspring. You are the supreme ruler, you are the self-ruler; may the two <s>Sārasvata</s> streams protect you'—thus.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:122/6-7) yaḥ kaś cāgnīnām anugachen nirmanthyaś ced dakṣiṇāgnim |
body.translated_text: Whichever of the fires should follow [the departing person]—if it is the <s>Dakṣiṇāgni</s>, it should be churned anew.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:123/1-2) ahute cet sāyaṃ pūrvo 'nugached agnihotram adhiśrityonnīyāgninā pūrveṇoddhṛtyāgnihotreṇānudravet |
body.translated_text: If, when the evening [oblation] has not been offered, the first [fire] should follow—having heated the <s>Agnihotra</s> [milk], having taken it out, having lifted it up with the first fire, one should run after [the fire] with the <s>Agnihotra</s> [offering].

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:123/3) adattapūrvadhanaṃ dadyāt |
body.translated_text: One should give wealth not previously given.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:123/3) śvas tapasvatīṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: The next day, one should prepare a <s>tapasvatī</s> offering.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:123/4-6) <āyāhi tapasā janiṣv agne pāvako arciṣā | upemāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama | ā no yāhi tapasā janeṣv āgne pāvaka dīdyat | havyā deveṣu no dadhat [Aap;SS 9.3.3]>_iti havīṃṣi dadyāt |
body.translated_text: 'Come with austerity, O <s>Agni</s>, born with a purifying flame; accept this praise of mine. Come to us with austerity among the people, O purifying <s>Agni</s>, blazing; placing our oblations among the gods'—with these [verses] he should give the offerings.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:123/6-7) sāyam ahutam atītarasminn etad eva prāyaścittam anyatrāpi ṣṇutyā cet |
body.translated_text: When the evening [oblation] has not been offered and [the fire] has crossed over [to the next day]—this same <s>prāyaścitta</s> [applies], and also elsewhere if heard.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:123/8-9) ahute cet prātaḥ pūrvo 'nugacched avadāheṣum aśnīyāt |
body.translated_text: If, when the morning [oblation] has not been offered, the first [fire] should follow—one should eat food without any burning [quality].

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:123/9-10) teṣv alabhyamāneṣu bhasmanāraṇiṃ saṃspṛśya mathitvāvadadhyāt |
body.translated_text: If those [items] are not available, having touched the fire-churning stick with ash and having churned, one should establish [the fire].

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:123/10) agnaye jyotiṣmata iṣṭiṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should perform an <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) to <s>Agni Jyotiṣmat</s> (Luminous Agni).

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:123-124/10-2) ahute cet prātar aparo vānugacched anugamayitvā pūrvaṃ mathitvāparam uddhṛtya juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If it remains unoffered and in the morning another [fire] follows, or is made to follow, having churned the first and having taken out the second, he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_5.1:124/2-3) tvaramāṇaḥ pūrvam agnim anvavasāya tataḥ paścāt prāñcam uddhṛtya juhuyāt || 1 ||
body.translated_text: Being in haste, having placed the first fire, then afterward having taken out [fire] facing east, he should offer. || 1 ||

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:124-125/4-1) uparuddhe cen mathyamāno na jāyeta yatra dīpyamānaṃ parāpaśyet tata āhṛtyāgnihotraṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If [the fire] is obstructed and when being churned does not ignite, wherever he sees a blazing [fire], having brought it from there, he should offer the <s>Agnihotra</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/1-2) yadi taṃ na vinded brāhmaṇasya dakṣiṇe pāṇau juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If he does not find that, he should offer into the right hand of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/2-3) tato brāhmaṇaṃ na paricakṣīta |
body.translated_text: Thereafter he should not despise a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/3-4) yadi taṃ na vinded ajāyā dakṣiṇe karṇe juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If he does not find that, he should offer into the right ear of a she-goat.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/4) tato 'jāṃ nāśnīyāt |
body.translated_text: Thereafter he should not eat goat [meat].

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/4-5) yadi tāṃ na vinded darbhastambeṣu juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If he does not find that, he should offer upon clumps of <s>darbha</s> grass.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/5) tato darbheṣu nāsīta |
body.translated_text: Thereafter he should not sit upon <s>darbha</s> grass.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/5-6) yadi tān na vinded apsu juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If he does not find those, he should offer into water.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/6) tato 'dbhiḥ pādau na prakṣālayīta |
body.translated_text: Thereafter he should not wash his feet with water.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/6-7) yadi tān na vinded dhiraṇye juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If he does not find those, he should offer into gold.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/7) tato hiraṇyaṃ na bibhṛyāt |
body.translated_text: Thereafter he should not wear gold.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/8) āpadi mathitvā vihṛtyāgnihotraṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: In an emergency, having churned [fire] and separated [it], he should offer the <s>Agnihotra</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/8-10) agnihotre ced anabhyuddhṛte haviṣi vā nirupte śakuniḥ śyenaḥ śvā vāntareṇa vyaveyād <idaṃ viṣṇur [;SS 7.26.4]> iti |
body.translated_text: If during the <s>Agnihotra</s>, when [the fire] has not been taken up, or when the oblation has been poured out, a bird, hawk, or dog should pass in between, [he should recite] '<s>idaṃ viṣṇuḥ</s>' [ŚŚ 7.26.4].

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/10-11) <idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame tredhā nidadhe padaṃ | samūḍham asya pāṃsure [;SS 7.26.4]> |
body.translated_text: '<s>Viṣṇu</s> strode across this; he placed his foot in three ways; it is gathered in his dust' [ŚŚ 7.26.4].

body.text: % note ;SS mantra in pratīka+sakalapāṭha
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: ŚŚ mantra in <s>pratīka</s> (incipit) and complete recitation format]

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/11-12) <pra tad viṣṇur [PS 20.7.10, ;SS 7.26.2]> iti bhasmanā padam upavapet |
body.translated_text: With '<s>pra tad viṣṇuḥ</s>' [PS 20.7.10, ŚŚ 7.26.2], he should scatter the footprint with ashes.

body.text: (AVPr_5.2:125/12-16) ano rathāsya puruṣo [vā] vyaveyād <yad agne pūrvaṃ nihitaṃ padaṃ hi te sūryasya raśmīn anvātatāna | tatra rayiṣṭhām anusaṃbharaitāṃ saṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyā [Mān;SS 3.4.10]>_ity ādadhyāt || 2 ||
body.translated_text: If a cart, chariot, or person should pass in between, with '<s>yad agne pūrvaṃ nihitaṃ padaṃ hi te sūryasya raśmīn anvātatāna | tatra rayiṣṭhām anusaṃbharaitāṃ saṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyā</s>' [MānŚŚ 3.4.10], he should re-establish [the fire]. || 2 ||

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:125-126/16-2) anvāhitāgniś cet prayāyāt <tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirasastama viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthag agne kāmāya yemire [.RV 8.43.18, Mān;SS 1.6.3.1]> iti hutvā prayāyāt |
body.translated_text: If one who maintains the sacred fires should set out on a journey, having offered with '<s>tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthag agne kāmāya yemire</s>' [RV 8.43.18, MānŚŚ 1.6.3.1], he should depart.

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:126/2-4) anvāhitaś ced anugached <anv agnir [;SS 7.82.4/18.1.27]> ity anyaṃ praṇīyāgnyanvādhānavratopāyanābhyāṃ manasopasthāya bhūr iti vyāharet |
body.translated_text: If one who maintains fires should follow [his extinguished fire], with '<s>anv agniḥ</s>' [ŚŚ 7.82.4/18.1.27], having led out another [fire], and having mentally attended to the fire-establishment and offering-approach rites, he should utter '<s>bhūḥ</s>.'

body.text: % note anv agnir not in PS
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: <s>anv agniḥ</s> not found in PS]

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:126/4-5) pāthikṛtī syāt patho 'ntikād darbhān āharet |
body.translated_text: He should perform the <s>pāthikṛtī</s> (path-rite); he should gather <s>darbha</s> grass from near the road.

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:126/5) anaḍvān dakṣiṇā |
body.translated_text: A bull is the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee).

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:126-127/5-1) sarvatra pāthikṛtyām anaḍvān |
body.translated_text: Everywhere in the <s>pāthikṛtī</s>, a bull [is the fee].

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:127/1-3) agnīnāṃ cet kaś cid upavakṣ(ay)et sa śam[yā]yā[ḥ] prāg vāsaṃ pāthikṛtī syāt |
body.translated_text: If any one of the fires should go out, he should perform the <s>pāthikṛtī</s> while dwelling east of the <s>śamyā</s> (yoke-pin).

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:127/3-5) śam[yā]yāḥ parā(k) parās(y)āc ced <idaṃ ta ekam [PS 18.69.5, ;SS 18.3.7]> iti tānt saṃbharet <para ū ta ekam [ibid.]> iti dvitīyaṃ dvitiyena |
body.translated_text: If [the fire goes out] beyond or west of the <s>śamyā</s>, with '<s>idaṃ ta ekam</s>' [PS 18.69.5, ŚŚ 18.3.7] he should collect them; the second [he collects] with '<s>para ū ta ekam</s>' [ibid.], with the second [verse].

body.text: % para ū: does ;SS really have pura ū (e-text)?
body.translated_text: [Editorial note: <s>para ū</s>—does ŚŚ really have <s>pura ū</s> (e-text)?]

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:127/5) tṛtīyaṃ <tṛtīyena jyotiṣā [ibid.]>_iti |
body.translated_text: The third [he should collect] with '<s>tṛtīyena jyotiṣā</s>' [ibid.].

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:127/5-6) tasmād avakhyāyās tatra nirvapet |
body.translated_text: Thereafter, having observed from that [point], he should perform the offering there.

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:127/6-7) adhi ced anuprāyāya mathitvā tatraikān vaset kālātipāte ca darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
body.translated_text: If he sets out further, having churned [fire], he should stay one night there; and in case of delay, [he should perform] the <s>Darśapūrṇamāsa</s> (new and full moon) rites.

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:128/1-2) vidhyardhasamāpte ced aparādhaṃ vidyāt (samāpte cet s)trīn haviṣyāt |
body.translated_text: If an error is found when the rite is half-completed—if when completed—he should fast for three [days].

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:128/2-3) agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake) on twelve potsherds to <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:128/3-4) yasya havir niruptaṃ purastāc candramā abhyudiyāt tāṃs tredhā taṇḍulān vibhajet |
body.translated_text: If the moon rises before [the completion of the offering] for one whose oblation has been poured, he should divide those rice grains into three parts.

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:128/4-5) ye madhyamās tan agnaye dātre 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet |
body.translated_text: The middle ones—he should offer as a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Dātṛ</s> (Agni the Giver).

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:128/5-6) ye sthaviṣṭhās tān indrāya pradātre dadhani caruṃ |
body.translated_text: The largest ones—[he should offer] as <s>caru</s> (porridge) in curds to <s>Indra Pradātṛ</s> (Indra the Bestower).

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:128/6-7) ye kṣodiṣṭhās tān viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya |
body.translated_text: The smallest ones—[he should offer] to <s>Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_5.3:128/7-8) śrite prāg ukte taṇḍulābhāvād ardhaṃ vā vidyāt || 3 ||
body.translated_text: When cooked, as stated previously, if rice grains are lacking, he should know it as half [the rite]. || 3 ||

body.text: (AVPr_5.4:128/8-9) agnaye vītaye 'ṣṭākapālam puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped yasyāgnayo mithaḥ saṃsṛjyeran |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Vīti</s> (Agni of the Feast) for one whose fires have become mutually mixed.

body.text: (AVPr_5.4:128/9-11) agnaye vivicaye 'ṣtākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped yasyāgnayo grāmyeṇāgninā saṃsṛjyeran |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Vivici</s> (Agni of Separation) for one whose fires have become mixed with the domestic fire.

body.text: (AVPr_5.4:128/11-13) agnaye śucaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped yasyāgnayaḥ śāvenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Śuci</s> (Pure Agni) for one whose fires have become mixed with funerary fire.

body.text: (AVPr_5.4:128/13-14) agnaye 'nnādāyā 'nnapataye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped yasyāgnayo dāvenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Annāda</s> (Food-eating Agni) and <s>Annapati</s> (Lord of Food) for one whose fires have become mixed with forest fire.

body.text: (AVPr_5.4:128/14-16) agnaye jyotiṣmate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped yasyāgnayo divyenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Jyotiṣmat</s> (Luminous Agni) for one whose fires have become mixed with lightning fire.

body.text: (AVPr_5.4:128/16-17) agnaye 'gnimate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped yasyāgnayo 'bhiplaveran |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Agnimat</s> (Fire-possessing Agni) for one whose fires have been flooded.

body.text: (AVPr_5.4:128-129/17-2) agnaye 'gnimate 'sṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped ya āhavanīyam anugatam abhyuddharet |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Agnimat</s> for one who takes out the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire that has followed [another fire].

body.text: (AVPr_5.4:129/2-4) agnaye kṣāmavate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped yasyāhitāgner agnigṛhān agnir dahed anagnir gṛhān vā |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Kṣāmavat</s> (Ground-possessing Agni) for one whose fire-hall is burned by fire while maintaining sacred fires, or whose fireless dwelling is burned.

body.text: (AVPr_5.4:129/4-6) agnaye vratapataye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ ni[r]vaped ya āhitāgnir ārtijam aśru kuryāt tataḥ pravaset |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Vratapati</s> (Lord of Vows Agni) for one who, while maintaining sacred fires, sheds tears from distress; thereafter he should go forth.

body.text: (AVPr_5.4:129-130/6-2) agnaye vratabhṛte 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped parvaṇi yo vratavelāyām avratyaṃ cared agnaye tantumate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāṣaṃ nirvaped yasya saṃtatam agnihotraṃ juhuyuḥ || 4 ||
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Vratabhṛt</s> (Vow-bearing Agni) for one who during a <s>parvan</s> (juncture) in the vow-period performs non-observance. He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on eight potsherds to <s>Agni Tantumat</s> (Thread-possessing Agni) for one whose <s>Agnihotra</s> is continually offered [by others]. || 4 ||

body.text: (AVPr_5.5:130/2-3) atha saṃnipatiteṣu prāyaścitteṣu vaivicīṃ prathamāṃ kuryāt |
body.translated_text: Now, when expiatory rites have accumulated, he should perform the <s>vaivicī</s> (separation rite) first.

body.text: (AVPr_5.5:130/3-4) tato 'gnaye śucaye |
body.translated_text: Then [the rite] to <s>Agni Śuci</s> (Pure Agni).

body.text: (AVPr_5.5:130/4-5) vrātapatīm antataḥ kṣāmavatīṃ parivarttayed yasyāgniṣv anyaṃ yājayed yo vā yajet |
body.translated_text: The <s>vrātapatī</s> (lord-of-vows rite) [should be done] at the end; the <s>kṣāmavatī</s> (ground-rite) should be substituted for one who sacrifices for another upon his fires, or for one who [so] sacrifices.

body.text: (AVPr_5.5:130/5-7) mārutaṃ trayodaśakapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvaped yasya yamau putrau jāyeyātāṃ gāvo vā |
body.translated_text: He should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on thirteen potsherds to <s>Māruta</s> (<s>Vāyu</s>) for one to whom twin sons or twin cows are born.

body.text: (AVPr_5.5:130/7-8) yamasūr dakṣiṇā dhenur bhāryā vā |
body.translated_text: The <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (fee) is a cow that has borne twins, or a wife.

body.text: (AVPr_5.5:130/8-9) pṛṣadājyaṃ cet skannaṃ <skannā dyaur [Aap;SS 9.17.1]> ity abhimantrya |
body.translated_text: If the <s>pṛṣadājya</s> (curded butter) is spilled, having consecrated it with '<s>skannā dyauḥ</s>' [ĀpŚŚ 9.17.1]—

body.text: (AVPr_5.5:130-131/9-5) <skannā dyauḥ skannā pṛthivī skannaṃ viśvam idaṃ jagat skannādo viśve devāḥ prā skannā[t] prāyatāṃ havir [Aap;SS 9.17.1]> ity abhimantrya_<iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvam [PS 19.21.10, ;SS 20.127.12]> ity anyasya pṛṣadājyasya juhuyāt paśugavā cet sruvair hutvāsrāvaṃ yāty avadānam akarmety anyasyāṃ dṛḍhatarāyāṃ śrapayeyur |
body.translated_text: having consecrated with '<s>skannā dyauḥ skannā pṛthivī skannaṃ viśvam idaṃ jagat skannādo viśve devāḥ prā skannāt prāyatāṃ haviḥ</s>' [ĀpŚŚ 9.17.1], with '<s>iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvam</s>' [PS 19.21.10, ŚŚ 20.127.12] he should offer of another [portion of] curded butter. If the animal offering [goes awry]—having offered with ladles, if the offering goes without the cutting portion, as a non-ritual act—they should cook in another, firmer [vessel].

body.text: (AVPr_5.5:131/5-6) [yady] avadānaṃ na vindet tadājyasyāvadyet |
body.translated_text: If he does not find the cutting portion, then he should cut from the ghee.

body.text: (AVPr_5.5:131/6-8) upākṛtaś cet paśuḥ prapated vāyavyāṃ yavāgūṃ nirupyānyaṃ tadrūpaṃ tadvarṇam iti samānaṃ || 5 ||
body.translated_text: If a consecrated animal should run away, having poured a <s>yavāgū</s> (barley gruel) offering to <s>Vāyu</s>, [he should procure] another of the same form and same color—thus the same [rule applies]. || 5 ||
