body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/8-11) atha yasyāhargaṇe [']visamāpte yūpo virohet pravṛhya yūpavirūḍhāny avalopya <tapo hy agne antarām amitrāṃ tapa śaṃsam araruṣaḥ parasya tapo vaso cikitāno acittān vi te tiṣṭhantām ajarā ayāsaḥ [.RV 3.18.2, Aap;SS 14.29.3]> |
body.translated_text: Now, for one whose sacrificial series is incomplete and whose <s>yūpa</s> (sacrificial post) sprouts, having pulled up the post and scraped off the sprouts, [he should recite] '<s>tapo hy agne antarām amitrāṃ tapa śaṃsam araruṣaḥ parasya tapo vaso cikitāno acittān vi te tiṣṭhantām ajarā ayāsaḥ</s>' [RV 3.18.2, ĀpŚŚ 14.29.3].

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/11-14) <yo naḥ sanutyo abhidāsad agne yo antaro mitramaho vanuṣyāt | tam ajarebhir vṛṣabhis tava svais tapā tapiṣṭha tapasā tapasvān [.RV 6.5.4]> |
body.translated_text: '<s>yo naḥ sanutyo abhidāsad agne yo antaro mitramaho vanuṣyāt | tam ajarebhir vṛṣabhis tava svais tapā tapiṣṭha tapasā tapasvān</s>' [RV 6.5.4].

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/14-16) <yasmāt kṛṇoti ketum ā naktaṃ cid dūra ā sate | pāvako yad vanaspatīn yasmān minoty ajaro (nabhihita) [.RV 5.7.4, Aap;SS 14.29.3]> iti dve |
body.translated_text: '<s>yasmāt kṛṇoti ketum ā naktaṃ cid dūra ā sate | pāvako yad vanaspatīn yasmān minaty ajaro</s>' [RV 5.7.4, ĀpŚŚ 14.29.3]—these two [verses].

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/16-18) pañcabhir aparaṃ paryukṣya <suparṇā vācam [PS 19.31.16, ;SS 6.49.3]> iti virūḍhāni hutvā punaḥsamāyāt tasmiṃs tvāṣṭram ajaṃ piṅgalaṃ paśuṃ bahurūpam ālabheta |
body.translated_text: Having sprinkled the other [post] with five [verses], with '<s>suparṇā vācam</s>' [PS 19.31.16, ŚŚ 6.49.3], having offered the sprouts, he should perform the <s>punaḥsamāya</s> (re-integration rite). In that rite, he should sacrifice a multi-colored tawny goat belonging to <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/18-19) agninā tapo 'nvabhavat |
body.translated_text: With fire (<s>Agni</s>), he attained <s>tapas</s> (ascetic heat).

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/19) vācā brahma |
body.translated_text: With speech (<s>Vāc</s>), <s>Brahman</s> (sacred knowledge).

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/19) maṇinā rūpāṇi |
body.translated_text: With the jewel, forms.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/19) indreṇa devān |
body.translated_text: With <s>Indra</s>, the gods.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/20) vātena prāṇān |
body.translated_text: With <s>Vāta</s> (wind), the vital breaths.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/20) sūryeṇa dyāṃ |
body.translated_text: With <s>Sūrya</s> (sun), heaven.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/20) candramasā nakṣatrāṇi |
body.translated_text: With the moon, the <s>nakṣatras</s> (lunar mansions).

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/21) yamena pitṝn |
body.translated_text: With <s>Yama</s>, the <s>Pitṛs</s> (ancestors).

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/21) rājñā manuṣyān |
body.translated_text: With the king, men.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/21) upalena nādeyān |
body.translated_text: With a stone, the river-creatures.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/21-22) ajagareṇa sarpān |
body.translated_text: With a python, serpents.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/22) vyāghreṇāraṇyān paśūn |
body.translated_text: With a tiger, wild animals.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/22) śyenena patatriṇaḥ |
body.translated_text: With a hawk, birds.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/23) vṛṣṇāśvān |
body.translated_text: With a stallion, horses.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/23) ṛṣabheṇa gāḥ |
body.translated_text: With a bull, cattle.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/23) bastenājāḥ |
body.translated_text: With a he-goat, goats.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131/23) vṛṣṇināvīḥ |
body.translated_text: With a ram, sheep.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:131-132/23-1) vrīhiṇānnāni |
body.translated_text: With rice, foods.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:132/1) yavenauṣadhīḥ |
body.translated_text: With barley, herbs.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:132/1) nyagrodhena vanaspatīn |
body.translated_text: With the <s>nyagrodha</s> (banyan) tree, forest trees.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:132/1-2) udumbarenorjaṃ |
body.translated_text: With the <s>udumbara</s> (fig) tree, nourishment.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:132/2) gāyatryā chandāṃsi |
body.translated_text: With the <s>Gāyatrī</s> (meter), the meters.

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:132/2) trivṛtā stomān |
body.translated_text: With the <s>trivṛt</s> (threefold <s>stoma</s>), the <s>stomas</s> (praise-chants).

body.text: (AVPr_5.6:132/2-4) brāhmaṇena vācam iti brahmā pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyāt || 6 || iti yajñaprāyaścitte pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ |
body.translated_text: With a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, speech—thus the <s>Brahmā</s> priest should offer the <s>pūrṇāhuti</s> (full oblation). || 6 || Thus ends the fifth chapter on sacrificial expiation.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:132/5) athātaḥ saumikāni vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, henceforth we shall expound the <s>Saumika</s> (Soma-related) rites.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:132/5-7) havirdhāne cet prapateyātāṃ purā bahiṣpavamānād adhvaryur dakṣiṇam udgṛhṇīyāt |
body.translated_text: If the <s>Havirdhāna</s> (oblation-hall) carts should fall before the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> (external purification chant), the <s>Adhvaryu</s> priest should lift up the southern one.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:132/7) pratiprasthātopastabhnuyāt |
body.translated_text: The <s>Pratiprasthātṛ</s> (assistant priest) should prop it up.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:132/7-8) pratiprasthātottaram udgṛhṇīyāt |
body.translated_text: The <s>Pratiprasthātṛ</s> should lift up the northern one.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:132/8-11) adhvaryur upastabhnuyād yathāprakṛti stambhānopamānau (!) <sam aśvinor avasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema | ā no rayiṃ vahatam ota vīrān ā viśvāny amṛtā saubhagāni [.RV 5.42.18 etc.]> |
body.translated_text: The <s>Adhvaryu</s> should prop it up, [restoring] the pillars to their original form, with '<s>sam aśvinor avasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema | ā no rayiṃ vahatam ota vīrān ā viśvāny amṛtā saubhagāni</s>' [RV 5.42.18 etc.].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:132/11-12) <śiro yajñasya pratidhīyatām amṛtaṃ devatāmayaṃ> |
body.translated_text: 'Let the head of the sacrifice be restored—the immortal, made of divinity.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:132/12) vaiṣṇavyāḥ |
body.translated_text: [This is] of the <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s> [group of mantras].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:132/12-16) (kriyatāṃ śira āśvinyāḥ pratihrīyatāṃ amṛtāṃ) <dyubhir aktubhiḥ paripātam asmān ariṣṭebhir aśvinā saubhagebhiḥ | tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyaur [.RV 1.112.25]> ity āgnīdhrīye juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: 'Let the head be made; of the <s>Āśvinī</s> [rite], let it be restored, the immortal'—'<s>dyubhir aktubhiḥ paripātam asmān ariṣṭebhir aśvinā saubhagebhiḥ | tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ</s>' [RV 1.112.25]—he should offer in the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> fire.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:132/16-18) audumbarīṃ ced apahareyur yam eva kāṃ cit prachidyāvadadhyād adhvaryur udgātā yajamānaḥ |
body.translated_text: If they should carry away the <s>Audumbarī</s> (fig-wood post), the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, <s>Udgātṛ</s>, and <s>Yajamāna</s> (sacrificer) should set up whatever [post] they cut.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:132/18-19) <ūrg asy ūrjaṃ mayi dhehi | śriyāṃ tiṣṭha pratiṣṭhitā | divaṃ stabdhvāntarikṣaṃ ca pṛthivyāṃ ca dṛḍhā bhava [Aap;SS 14.33.2]>_iti |
body.translated_text: With '<s>ūrg asy ūrjaṃ mayi dhehi | śriyāṃ tiṣṭha pratiṣṭhitā | divaṃ stabdhvāntarikṣaṃ ca pṛthivyāṃ ca dṛḍhā bhava</s>' [ĀpŚŚ 14.33.2].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/1) <dhartri dharitri janitri yamitri [Aap;SS 14.33.2]>_iti brahmā |
body.translated_text: The <s>Brahmā</s> priest [recites] '<s>dhartri dharitri janitri yamitri</s>' [ĀpŚŚ 14.33.2].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/1-2) antaḥsadaso bahiṣpavamānena stūyur |
body.translated_text: Those inside the <s>sadas</s> (ritual enclosure) should be praised with the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/2-5) dīkṣitasya gārhapatyo 'nte gārhapatyo 'nugacched <agniṃ naro dīdhitibhir araṇyor hastacyutī janayanta praśastaṃ | dūredṛśaṃ gṛhapatim atharyum [.RV 7.1.1, Aap;SS 14.16.1]> iti mathitvāvadadhyāt |
body.translated_text: If the <s>Gārhapatya</s> (household) fire of the consecrated person goes out at the end, the <s>Gārhapatya</s> should follow [the procedure]; having churned [new fire] with '<s>agniṃ naro dīdhitibhir araṇyor hastacyutī janayanta praśastaṃ | dūredṛśaṃ gṛhapatim atharyum</s>' [RV 7.1.1, ĀpŚŚ 14.16.1], he should re-establish it.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/5-6) āśv anupraṇītaś ced anugached etayaiva mathitvāvadadhyāt |
body.translated_text: If the <s>Anupraṇīta</s> (led-forth) fire follows quickly, having churned with this very [mantra], he should re-establish it.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/6-7) agnayaś cen mithaḥ saṃsṛjyerann <agnināgniḥ saṃsṛjyate [.RV 1.12.6; cf. KauśS 108.1-2]>_ity ete japet |
body.translated_text: If the fires should become mutually mixed, he should recite these [verses beginning with] '<s>agnināgniḥ saṃsṛjyate</s>' [RV 1.12.6; cf. KauśS 108.1-2].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/7-9) śālāmukhīyaś ced anugacched gārhapatyāt praṇīya <bhadraṃ karṇebhir [see below]> iti catasro japet |
body.translated_text: If the <s>Śālāmukhīya</s> (hall-entrance) fire should follow [i.e., go out], having led [fire] from the <s>Gārhapatya</s>, he should recite four [verses beginning with] '<s>bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ</s>' [see below].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/9-11) <bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhir yajatrāḥ | sthirair aṅgais tuṣṭuvāṃsas tanūbhir vyaśema devahitaṃ yad āyuḥ [.RV 1.89.8, Aap;SS 14.16.1]> |
body.translated_text: '<s>bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhir yajatrāḥ | sthirair aṅgais tuṣṭuvāṃsas tanūbhir vyaśema devahitaṃ yad āyuḥ</s>' [RV 1.89.8, ĀpŚŚ 14.16.1].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/11-13) <svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svasti nas tārkṣyo 'riṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatir dadhātu [.RV 1.89.6, Aap;SS 14.16.1]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:133/11-13) 'May <s>Indra</s> of great renown grant us well-being; may <s>Pūṣan</s>, the all-knowing, grant us well-being; may <s>Tārkṣya</s> of unharmed felly grant us well-being; may <s>Bṛhaspati</s> grant us well-being' [RV 1.89.6, Āpastamba Śrautasūtra 14.16.1].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/13-16) <pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ | agnijihvā manavaḥ sūracakṣaso viśve no devā avasā gamann iha [.RV 1.89.7, Aap;SS 14.16.1]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:133/13-16) 'The <s>Maruts</s> with dappled horses, sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>, moving auspiciously, having gone to the assemblies; with <s>Agni</s> as their tongue, the <s>Manus</s>, with the sun as their eye — may all the gods come here to our aid' [RV 1.89.7, Āpastamba Śrautasūtra 14.16.1].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/16-18) <śatam in nu śarado anti devā yatra naś cakrā jarasaṃ tanūnāṃ | putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyur gantoḥ [.RV 1.89.9, Aap;SS 14.16.1]> | iti |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:133/16-18) 'Surely a hundred autumns are before us, O gods, within which you have set old age upon our bodies; in which sons become fathers — do not harm us in the midst of our life's journey' [RV 1.89.9, Āpastamba Śrautasūtra 14.16.1]. Thus.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/18-19) <preddho agne [see below]> iti catasṛbhir juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:133/18-19) 'O kindled <s>Agni</s>' [see below] — with these four [verses] he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/19-20) <preddho agne dīdihi puro no jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha | tvāṃ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ [.RV 7.1.3]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:133/19-20) 'O kindled <s>Agni</s>, shine before us with unceasing radiance, O youngest one; the prizes continuously come to you' [RV 7.1.3].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/20-23) <sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvāḥ sapta rṣayaḥ sapta dhāma priyāṇi | sapta hotrāḥ saptadhā tvā yajanti sapta yonīr āpṛṇasva ghṛtena svāhā [TS 1.5.3.2 etc.]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:133/20-23) 'Seven are your fuel-sticks, O <s>Agni</s>, seven your tongues, seven the sages, seven your beloved abodes; seven <s>Hotṛ</s> priests offer to you sevenfold — fill your seven wombs with ghee, <s>svāhā</s>' [TS 1.5.3.2 etc.].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/23-25) <yan me manasaś chidraṃ yad vāco yac ca me hṛdaḥ | ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ tat siñcatu rādhasā [Aap;SS 14.16.1]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:133/23-25) 'Whatever gap there is in my mind, in my speech, or in my heart — may the god <s>Bṛhaspati</s> fill that with his bounty' [Āpastamba Śrautasūtra 14.16.1].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133/25) <mamāgne varcaḥ [PS 5.4.1, ;SS 5.3.1]>_iti |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:133/25) 'O <s>Agni</s>, my radiance' [PS 5.4.1, ŚS 5.3.1] — thus.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:133-134/25-1) ekāgnidhrīyaś ced anugacched gārhapatyāt praṇīya <mamāgne varcaḥ [see above]> iti ṣaḍbhir juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:133-134/25-1) If the <s>Ekāgnidhrīya</s> (single fire-hall) fire should follow, having led it forth from the <s>Gārhapatya</s>, with 'O <s>Agni</s>, my radiance' [see above] he should offer six oblations.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:134/1-2) auttaravedikaś ced anugacchec chālāmukhīyāt praṇīya_<imo agne [see below]>_iti trayodaśabhir juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:134/1-2) If the <s>Auttaravedika</s> (fire on the northern altar) should follow, having led it forth from the <s>Śālāmukhīya</s>, with 'These, O <s>Agni</s>' [see below] he should offer thirteen oblations.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:134/2-4) <imo agne vītatamāni havyājasro vakṣi devatātim achā prati na īṃ surabhīṇi vyantu [.RV 7.18.1]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:134/2-4) 'O <s>Agni</s>, bear these most abundant oblations ceaselessly to the divine assembly; may our fragrant offerings be accepted in return' [RV 7.18.1].

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:134/4-5) <sapta te agne samidhaḥ [see above]> | <yan me manasaś chidraṃ [see above]> | <mamāgne varca [see above]> iti juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:134/4-5) 'Seven are your fuel-sticks, O <s>Agni</s>' [see above]; 'Whatever gap in my mind' [see above]; 'O <s>Agni</s>, my radiance' [see above] — he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:134/5-7) paśuśrapaṇaś ced anugacched auttaravedikāt praṇīya <tvaṃ no agne [see above]> <sa tvaṃ na [see above]> iti sarvaprāyaścittaṃ hutvā |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:134/5-7) If the <s>Paśuśrapaṇa</s> (animal-cooking) fire should follow, having led it forth from the <s>Auttaravedika</s>, with 'You for us, O <s>Agni</s>' [see above] and 'You, that' [see above] — having offered the complete <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation),

body.text: (AVPr_6.1:134/7-8) yady ukhyo 'nugacchet punaḥ punaḥ prajvālya || 1 ||
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.1:134/7-8) If the pot-fire should follow, he should rekindle it again and again. || 1 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:134/8-10) <kāyamāno vanā tvaṃ yan mātṝr ajagann apaḥ | na tat te agne pramṛṣe nivartanaṃ yad dūre saṇn ihābhavaḥ [.RV 3.9.2]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:134/8-10) 'Being kindled, you, O <s>Agni</s>, went to the waters, your mothers, having left the forests — that turning back of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, I do not forget, that you, being far away, came to be here' [RV 3.9.2].

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:134-135/10-2) <yās te agna ārdrā yonayo yāḥ kulāyinīḥ | ye te agna indavo yā u nābhayaḥ | yās te agne tanva ūrjo nāma tābhiṣ ṭvam ubhayībhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ śataṃ cinvānas tanvā niṣīdata [cf. KS 39.3:121.4]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:134-135/10-2) 'Those moist wombs of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, those that are like nests, those drops of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, and those navels, those bodies of yours named vigor — with both kinds of these, being in accord, piling up a hundred bodies, sit down' [cf. KS 39.3:121.4].

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:135/2-4) <sākaṃ hi śucinā śuciḥ praśastā kratunājani | vidvā"n asya vratā dhruvā vayā ivānu rohate [.RV 2.5.4]>_ity ādhāya samidhaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ dadyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:135/2-4) 'Together with the pure one, the pure one, praised, was born with wisdom; knowing his firm ordinances, he grows like branches' [RV 2.5.4] — having thus placed the fire, he should give a black fuel-stick.

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:135/4-5) vāsoyugaṃ dhenuṃ vā |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:135/4-5) A pair of garments or a cow [should be given as a fee].

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:135/5-8) yady ukhā vā bhidyeta tair eva kapālaiḥ saṃcityānyāṃ kṛtvā <syūtā devebhir amṛtenāgāḥ [PS 19.44.1, Aap;SS 16.26.6]> <ukhāṃ svasāram adhi vedim asthāt satyaṃ pūrvair ṛṣibhiś cākupāno agniḥ pravidvān iha tat karotu [Aap;SS 16.26.6]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:135/5-8) If the pot should be broken, having reassembled it with those very potsherds and making another one, [he should recite]: 'Sewn by the gods, you have come with the immortal' [PS 19.44.1, Āpastamba Śrautasūtra 16.26.6]; 'The pot-sister stood upon the altar; truly, in union with the ancient sages, may <s>Agni</s>, the knower, do that here' [Āpastamba Śrautasūtra 16.26.6].

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:135/8) <stavādejarudharanamadrir [?]> ity anumantrayet |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:135/8) 'stavādejarudharanamadrir [?]' — he should consecrate it thus.

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:135/9-11) vasatīvarīś cet skandeyuḥ <pṛthivī vibhūvarī sinīvāly uruṃdhety āvṛtte | namas te bhuvo viśva[ṃ] tad [cf. KS 35.3:51.16/Aap;SS 14.17.3. See apparatus note 964, and cf. reading of D with KS/Aap;SS. On this basis, a first step towards improving the edition has been taken]> gṛhītvā <māndā vāśā [see below]> iti catasṛbhir āgnīdhrīye juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:135/9-11) If the <s>vasatīvarī</s> (overnight) waters should be spilled: '<s>Pṛthivī</s>, the broad, <s>Sinīvālī</s>, wide' at the turning; 'Homage to you, O Earth, all that' — having taken them, with 'The lowing, soft ones' — with these four [verses] he should offer in the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> fire.

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:135/11-13) <māndā vāśāḥ śundhyūr ajirāḥ | undatīḥ suphenāḥ jyotiṣmatīs tamasvatīr | mitrabhṛtaḥ kṣatrabhṛtaḥ svarāṣṭrā iha māvata [TS 2.4.7.2] |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:135/11-13) 'The lowing, soft, pure, swift ones; the surging, well-foaming, luminous, dark ones; bearing friendship, bearing sovereignty, self-ruling — remain here with us' [TS 2.4.7.2].

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:135/13-14) <vṛṣṇo aśvasya saṃdānam asi vṛṣṭyai tvopa nahyāmi [TS 2.4.7.2]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:135/13-14) 'You are the tying-post of the stallion horse; I bind you for rain' [TS 2.4.7.2].

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:135-136/14-1) <devā vasavā agne indra sūrya | devā udno dattodadhiṃ bhintta divas parjanyād antarikṣāt samudrāt tato no vṛṣṭyāvata [cf. TS 2.4.8.1]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:135-136/14-1) 'O gods, <s>Vasus</s>, <s>Agni</s>, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Sūrya</s> — O gods, give water, release the cloud, split it from heaven, from <s>Parjanya</s>, from the atmosphere, from the ocean — thence rain upon us' [cf. TS 2.4.8.1].

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:136/1-4) <devā yujo mitrāvaruṇāryamā yuktaṃ devāḥ sapītayo apāṃ napāt tanūnapān narāśaṃsa udno datto 'dadhiṃ bhintta divas parjanyād antarikṣāt samudrāt tato no vṛṣṭyāvata [cf. TS 2.4.8.1]>_iti |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:136/1-4) 'O gods, companions, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aryaman</s> — the yoked ones, O gods, co-drinkers, <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, <s>Tanūnapāt</s>, <s>Narāśaṃsa</s> — give water, release the cloud, split it from heaven, from <s>Parjanya</s>, from the atmosphere, from the ocean — thence rain upon us' [cf. TS 2.4.8.1] — thus.

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:136/4-5) pravṛttāś cet syuḥ <saṃ mā siñcantu [PS 6.18-19, ;SS 7.33.1]>_iti saṃsiñcet | [em., ed. samā-]
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:136/4-5) If they have begun to flow, with 'Sprinkle me together' [PS 6.18-19, ŚS 7.33.1] he should sprinkle.

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:136/5-6) nivṛttāś cet syur <apām ūrmī [;SS 20.28.4?]>_iti gṛhītvā ṣaḍbhir āhavanīye juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:136/5-6) If they have ceased to flow, with 'The wave of the waters' [ŚS 20.28.4?] — having taken them, with six [verses] he should offer in the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire.

body.text: % note mantra not in PS
body.translated_text: % Note: mantra not found in the <s>Paippalāda Saṃhitā</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_6.2:136/6-8) <indriyāvān madintamas taṃ vo māva kramiṣam | achinnaṃ tantuṃ pṛthivyā anu geṣam [TS 1.2.3.3]> iti hutvā || 2 ||
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.2:136/6-8) 'Possessed of power, most intoxicating — may I not stumble against you; may I follow the uncut thread of the earth' [TS 1.2.3.3] — having offered thus. || 2 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:136/8-10) abhivṛṣṭe some <dyauś ca tvā pṛthivī ca śṛṇītām antarikṣaṃ ca [cf. KS 35.11:58.9]> | <indur indum avāgād indor indro 'pāt [TB 3.7.10.6, Aap;SS 14.29.2, cf. KS 35.11:58.14]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:136/8-10) When <s>Soma</s> has been rained upon: 'May heaven and earth and the atmosphere hear you' [cf. KS 35.11:58.9]; 'The drop went to the drop; <s>Indra</s> drank from the drop' [TB 3.7.10.6, Āpastamba Śrautasūtra 14.29.2].

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:136/10-13) <yajñaś ca tvā vāyuś ca śṛṇītām [cf. KS 35.11:58.12]> <ahaś ca tvā rātrīś ca śṛṇītāṃ [KS 35.11:58.9]> <darśaś ca tvā paurṇamāsaś ca śṛṇītāṃ [cf. KS 35.11:58.13]> <yajñaś ca tvā dakṣiṇā ca śṛṇītāṃ [cf. KS 35.11:58.12]> <dakṣaś ca tvā mānasaś ca śṛṇītām [cf. PS 20.37.5a]> <arkaś ca tvāśvamedhaś ca śṛṇītām [KS 35.11:58.14]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:136/10-13) 'May the sacrifice and <s>Vāyu</s> hear you' [cf. KS 35.11:58.12]; 'May day and night hear you' [KS 35.11:58.9]; 'May the new moon and full moon hear you' [cf. KS 35.11:58.13]; 'May the sacrifice and the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> hear you' [cf. KS 35.11:58.12]; 'May skill and intention hear you' [cf. PS 20.37.5a]; 'May the fire-hymn and the <s>Aśvamedha</s> hear you' [KS 35.11:58.14].

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:136/13-16) <.... ś ca tvā .... indur indum upāgāt sāyāme so ma bhūt sarva tasya ta indav | indrapītasyopahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi [;Sāṅkh;SS 13.12.10, TB 3.7.10.6, Aap;SS 14.29.2]>_ity abhimṛṣṭasya bhakṣayet |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:136/13-16) '... the drop went to the drop; at the evening pressing, let this <s>Soma</s> be complete in all its parts, O drop; of that drunk by <s>Indra</s>, that which was invoked — being invoked, I partake' [Sāṅkhāyana Śrautasūtra 13.12.10, TB 3.7.10.6, Āpastamba Śrautasūtra 14.29.2] — he should partake of what has been consecrated by touch.

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:136/16-18) sasomaṃ cec camasaṃ sadasi stotreṇābhyupākuryāt_<hiraṇyagarbhas [see above, note in combination with next mantra also TAA 1.13.3]> <tad it padam [TB 3.7.10.6]> iti dvābhyāṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:136/16-18) If a <s>Soma</s>-containing <s>camasa</s> cup should be overturned in the assembly by a chant, with '<s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s>' [see above] and 'That is the foot' [TB 3.7.10.6] — with these two he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:136/19-20) <tad it padaṃ na viciketa vidvān yan mṛtaḥ punar apy eti jīvān [TB 3.7.10.6]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:136/19-20) 'That is the foot which the wise one did not discern — that which, having died, again comes back to life' [TB 3.7.10.6].

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:136/20-21) pravṛttā ca sthalī syāt <trivṛd yad bhuvanasya rathavṛj jīvo garbho na mṛtasya jīvāt svāhā [TB 3.7.10.6]>_iti |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:136/20-21) And if the cooking-pot should have been set in motion: 'The threefold turning of the chariot-wheel of existence — the living from the womb of the dead one to life, <s>svāhā</s>' [TB 3.7.10.6] — thus.

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:136-137/21-1) anyaś ced āgrāyaṇād gṛhṇīyād āgrāyaṇaś ced upadasyed āgrayaṇād gṛhṇīyād grahebhyo vāhṛtya śukradhruvau varjam |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:136-137/21-1) If another should draw from the <s>Āgrāyaṇa</s> cup, or if the <s>Āgrāyaṇa</s> should subside, he should draw from the <s>Āgrāyaṇa</s>, or else having taken away from the cups, excluding the <s>Śukra</s> and <s>Dhruva</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:137/1) <ātmā yajñasya [.RV 9.6.8]>_iti catasṛbhir juhuyāt | [ed. ā tvā yajñasya]
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:137/1) 'The self of the sacrifice' [RV 9.6.8] — with these four [verses] he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:137/1-3) <ātmā yajñasya raṃhyā[t] suṣvāṇaḥ pavate sutaḥ | pratnāni pāti kāvyaḥ [.RV 9.6.8, KS 35.6:54.14]> | [ed. ā tvā yajñasya]
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:137/1-3) 'The self of the sacrifice speeds forth; the well-pressed <s>Soma</s>, when extracted, is purified; the poet guards the ancient laws' [RV 9.6.8, KS 35.6:54.14].

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:137/3-4) <goṣā indo nṛṣā asy aśvasā vājasā uta | pratnāni pāti kāvyaḥ [.RV 9.2.10, KS 35.6:54.16]> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:137/3-4) 'O drop, you are the winner of cattle, the winner of men, the winner of horses, the winner of prizes; the poet guards the ancient laws' [RV 9.2.10, KS 35.6:54.16].
(AVPr 6.3:137/4) 'The god of gods' [PS 15.9.5-6? MS 4.14.12:236.3, TB 2.4.8.3?] — these two [mantras].

body.text: % if the identification with PS 15.9.5-6 is correct (and the iti dve tends to corroborate this, because those two mantras stand at the end of PS 15.9), then deva needs to be emended to devā, and we have here a PS mantra without sakalapāṭha.
body.translated_text: % Editorial note: If the identification with PS 15.9.5-6 is correct (and the 'iti dve' tends to corroborate this), then 'deva' needs to be emended to 'devā,' yielding a PS mantra without <s>sakalapāṭha</s> (full recitation).

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:137/4-8) dhruvaś ced upadasyet pravṛttā cet sthālī syād <vasavas tvādīs tarpayantu rudrās tvā tarpayantu | ādityās tvā tarpayantu [?]>_ity utsṛjya <dhruvā dyaur [PS 19.6.9, ;SS 6.88.1]> ity abhimantrya <dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa [PS 19.6.4, ;SS 7.94.1]>_iti gṛhītvā_<āyurdā asi dhruvaḥ>_iti catasṛbhir āgnīdhrīye juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:137/4-8) If the <s>Dhruva</s> (fixed) cup should subside, or if the cooking-pot should have been set in motion: 'May the <s>Vasus</s> satisfy you, may the <s>Rudras</s> satisfy you, may the <s>Ādityas</s> satisfy you' — having released, and having consecrated with 'Firm is the heaven' [PS 19.6.9, ŚS 6.88.1], and having taken with 'The firm one by the firm one' [PS 19.6.4, ŚS 7.94.1], with 'You are the giver of life, O <s>Dhruva</s>' — with these four he should offer in the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> fire.

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:137/8-11) <āyurdā asi dhruva āyur me dāḥ svāhā | varcodā asi dhruvo varco me dāḥ svāhā | tejodā asi dhruvas tejo me dāḥ svāhā | sahodā asi dhruvaḥ saho me dāḥ svāhā> |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:137/8-11) 'You are the giver of life, O <s>Dhruva</s> — give me life, <s>svāhā</s>; you are the giver of splendor, O <s>Dhruva</s> — give me splendor, <s>svāhā</s>; you are the giver of brilliance, O <s>Dhruva</s> — give me brilliance, <s>svāhā</s>; you are the giver of strength, O <s>Dhruva</s> — give me strength, <s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.3:137/11-13) grāvṇi śīrṇe dyotānasya mārutasya brahmasāmena stuvīrann ity eke bhakṣaṇīyam uparaveṣv apinayet || 3 ||
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.3:137/11-13) If the pressing-stone should be shattered, they should chant with the <s>Brahma-sāman</s> of the <s>Dyotānasya Mārutasya</s> — thus say some; the portion to be consumed should be placed upon the pressing-boards. || 3 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:137/13-14) apidagdhe some kṛtāṃtvād upakrameraṇyaṃ vacanāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:137/13-14) When <s>Soma</s> has been burned: because the rite has been completed, the commencement should be undertaken anew, according to the injunction.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:137/14-15) japtvā purā dvādaśyā punar dīkṣāvāṃtādviti |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:137/14-15) Having recited [the mantras] before the twelfth day, he should undergo re-initiation (<s>dīkṣā</s>) and so forth.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:137/15-16) tatra tā dadyād yāḥ kasyai tvā dāsya bhavati |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:137/15-16) There he should give those gifts which belong to the formula 'To whom shall I give you?'

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:137/16-17) tathaivainām ṛtvijo yājayeyur |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:137/16-17) Just so should the <s>ṛtvij</s> (officiating) priests have him sacrifice.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:137/17-18) yady akrītasomam apahareyur anyaḥ krītavyaḥ |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:137/17-18) If they should carry away the unpurchased <s>Soma</s>, another should be bought.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:137/18-19) yadi krīto naṣṭaḥ syāt sā nityābhiṣicyaḥ |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:137/18-19) If the purchased one should be lost, it should be perpetually consecrated.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:137/19) rājāhāra iti kiṃcid deyaṃ |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:137/19) 'A royal offering' — something should be given.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:137-138/19-1) tenāsya sa parikrīto bhavati |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:137-138/19-1) By that, his <s>Soma</s> becomes purchased.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:138/1-2) yadi somaṃ na vindeyuḥ pūtīkān abhiṣuṇuyur |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:138/1-2) If they should not find <s>Soma</s>, they should press <s>pūtīka</s> plants as a substitute.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:138/2-3) yadi na pūtīkān arjunāny atha yā eva kāś cauṣadhīr āhṛtyābhiṣuṇuyuḥ |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:138/2-3) If not <s>pūtīka</s> plants, then <s>arjuna</s> trees; or whatever herbs they bring, those they should press.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:138/3-4) pañcadaksiṇaṃ kratuṃ saṃsthāpayeyur ekadakṣiṇaṃ vā |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:138/3-4) They should conclude the sacrifice with a five-<s>dakṣiṇā</s> rite, or a single-<s>dakṣiṇā</s> one.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:138/4-5) yena yajñena kāmayeta tena yajeta |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:138/4-5) With whichever sacrifice he desires, with that he should sacrifice.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:138/5) [a]tra yat kāmayeta tatra tad dadyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:138/5) Whatever he desires there, that he should give.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:138/5-7) prātaḥsavanāc cet kalaśo vidīryeta vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu tṛcā stūyur |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:138/5-7) If a jar should split during the morning pressing, they should chant with the <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s> <s>tṛca</s> (triplet of verses) containing the epithet <s>Śipiviṣṭa</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:138/7-10) (mādhyaṃdinaś cet pavamāne samādhyaṃdināt pavamānā) yadi mādhyaṃdinārbhavasya pavamānasya purastād vaṣaṭkāranidhanaṃ sāma kuryāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:138/7-10) If at the midday pressing during the <s>Pavamāna</s> chant — from the mid-<s>Pavamāna</s> — if at the midday pressing, he should perform the <s>sāman</s> of <s>Arbhava</s>'s <s>Pavamāna</s> with the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> ending before it.

body.text: (AVPr_6.4:138/10) yadi tṛtīyasavana etad eva || 4 ||
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.4:138/10) If at the third pressing, the same procedure applies. || 4 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:138/10-12) <bhūmir bhūmim agān mātā mātaram apy agāt | ṛdhyāsma putraiḥ paśubhir yo no dveṣṭi sa bhidyatām [KauśS 136.2]> iti |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.5:138/10-12) 'Earth went to earth, mother went to mother; may we prosper with sons and cattle — let him who hates us be split apart' [Kauśika Sūtra 136.2] — thus.

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:138/12-14) yan mārttikaṃ bhidyeta tadāpo gamayet tathaiva dārumayaṃ <ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ [PS 18.11.7, ;SS 14.2.47]>_ity etayālabhyābhimantrayate |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.5:138/12-14) If an earthen vessel should break, he should send it to the waters; likewise a wooden one — with 'Who even without binding' [PS 18.11.7, ŚS 14.2.47] — having taken it with this verse, he should consecrate it.

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:139/1-2) sarvatra śīrṇe bhinne naṣṭe 'nyaṃ kṛtvā <punar maitv indriyam [PS 3.13.6, ;SS 7.67.1]> ity ādadīta |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.5:139/1-2) Whenever anything is shattered, broken, or lost, having made another, with 'May my strength return to me' [PS 3.13.6, ŚS 7.67.1] he should take it up.

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:139/2-4) bahiṣpavamānaṃ cet sarpatāṃ prastotā vichidyeta brahmaṇe varaṃ dattvā tatas tam eva punar vrṇīyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.5:139/2-4) If during the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> (external purification) chant, the <s>Prastotṛ</s> (leading chanter) should be interrupted as the chants proceed, having given a gift to the <s>Brahman</s> priest, he should then select that same one again.

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:139/4-5) yad udgātā vichidyeta sarvavedasadakṣiṇena yajñena yajeta |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.5:139/4-5) If the <s>Udgātṛ</s> (chanting priest) should be interrupted, he should sacrifice with a sacrifice having all the <s>Vedas</s> as its fee.

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:139/5-6) evaṃ sarveṣāṃ vichinnānāṃ sarpatām ekaikasmin kuryāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.5:139/5-6) Thus, for all those who are interrupted among the chanters proceeding, he should perform the expiation for each one individually.

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:139/6-7) <dyauś ca ma indraś ca me [TS 4.7.6.2]> | <tantuṃ tanvan [.RV 10.53.6, TS 3.4.2.2]> | <mā pra gāma patho vayam [PS 17.25.2 / ;SS 13.1.59, .RV 10.57.1]> iti |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.5:139/6-7) 'May heaven and <s>Indra</s> be mine' [TS 4.7.6.2]; 'Weaving the thread' [RV 10.53.6, TS 3.4.2.2]; 'May we not go astray from the path' [PS 17.25.2 / ŚS 13.1.59, RV 10.57.1] — thus.

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:139/7-9) śastrāc cec chastram anuśaṃsan vyāpadyeta <mā pragāma patho vayam [see above]> iti pañcabhir juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.5:139/7-9) If from one <s>śastra</s> (recitation) to another, while continuing the recitation, the priest should falter, with 'May we not go astray from the path' [see above] — with five [verses] he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:139/9-11) rāthaṃtaraṃ cet stūyamānaṃ vyāpadyeta <samyag digbhyaḥ [von Negelein no doubt correctly refers to PS 15.1.1: samyan digbhyaḥ]> iti dvābhyāṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: (AVPr 6.5:139/9-11) If the <s>Rathantara</s> <s>sāman</s> should fail while being chanted, with 'Rightly from all quarters' [cf. PS 15.1.1] — with two [verses] he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:139/11-12) yavādīnām avapannānāṃ vyāvṛttānām uttarāsāṃ yathāliṅgaṃ dvābhyāṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: For barley and other grains that have been sown, when they are reversed, for the succeeding ones, he should offer with two verses according to their characteristic mark.

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:139/12-14) nārāśaṃsā(d) unnetād upadasyerann <ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣaḥ [PS 20.61.5-6, sakala at KauśS 89.13]> iti dvābhyāṃ |
body.translated_text: If they should fall from the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> vessel when being elevated, [he should offer] with two verses [beginning with] 'This <s>Agni</s> is our overseer.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.5:139/14) pānnejanyāś ced upadasyet <saṃ mā siñcantu [see above]>_iti saṃsiñcet || 5 ||
body.translated_text: If something should fall from among those to be washed, he should sprinkle with 'Let them sprinkle me together.' || 5 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:139/15-18) atha ced dhutāhutau somau pītāpītau vā saṃsṛjyeyātāṃ <yajñasya hi stha ṛtvijā [.RV 8.38.1]> <gavīndrāgnī kalpatā yuvaṃ hutāhutasya cāsyā yasyendrāgnīvītaṃ pibata ghṛtam imāṃ ghṛtam [?]> iti dvābhyāṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: Now, if two <s>Soma</s> libations—one offered and one unoffered, or one drunk and one undrunk—should become mixed together, he should offer with two verses: 'For you are the <s>ṛtvij</s> (priests) of the sacrifice' and 'For the cow, O <s>Indra</s>-<s>Agni</s>, arrange yourselves—of the offered and unoffered, and of this whose <s>Indra</s>-<s>Agni</s> share, drink the ghee.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:139/18-20) prātaḥsavanāc cet kalaśo vidīryeta vaiṣṇavatīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu gaurīvitena stūyuḥ |
body.translated_text: If the jar should break during the morning pressing, they should chant the <s>Gaurīvita</s> hymn with verses addressed to <s>Viṣṇu</s> and containing [the epithet] <s>Śipiviṣṭa</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:139-140/20-1) samānajanapadau cet somau saṃsavau syātāṃ pūrvo 'gniṃ parigṛhṇīyāt pūrvo devatāḥ parigṛhṇīyāt |
body.translated_text: If two <s>Soma</s> pressings should be simultaneous in the same district, the first should claim the fire, the first should claim the deities.

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/1-2) nātirātryā prātaranuvākam upākuryāt |
body.translated_text: One should not begin the morning recitation with the <s>Atirātra</s> (overnight rite).

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/2-4) <abhiṣṭāvyātha saṃveśāyopaveśāya gāyatryai chandase 'bhibhūtyai svāhā [Aap;SS 14.26.2]>_iti purastāt prātaranuvākasya juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: He should offer before the morning recitation [with the verse]: 'Having praised, for sleeping, for resting, for the <s>Gāyatrī</s> meter, for conquest, <s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/4-5) <triṣṭubhaḥ>_iti mādhyaṃdine vidviṣāṇayoḥ saṃsavāv iti vijñāyate |
body.translated_text: 'Of the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>'—at the midday pressing. 'When two who are hostile to each other perform simultaneous pressings'—thus it is known.

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/5-7) savanīyānantaram agnaye yaviṣṭhāyāṣṭākapālam ity āhavanīye mahad abhyādadhyāt |
body.translated_text: After the pressing-day offerings, he should place a large [log] on the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire, [with] an eight-<s>kapāla</s> cake for <s>Agni Yaviṣṭha</s> (youngest <s>Agni</s>).

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/7-8) saṃbhārāṇāṃ caturbhiś caturbhiḥ pratidiśaṃ juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: He should offer with four each of the ritual ingredients in each direction.

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/8-9) uttamam āgnīdhrīye somabhāga[ṃ] brāhmaṇeṣu śaṃse[t] |
body.translated_text: The final <s>Soma</s>-share in the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> [fire], he should recite among the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/9-10) vajrāṇāṃ śyenaviṣamasya ca phaṭkāraprabhṛty anujānīyāt |
body.translated_text: Regarding the <s>vajra</s> hymns and the <s>śyena-viṣama</s>, beginning with the <s>phaṭkāra</s> exclamation, he should authorize.

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/10-12) sarveṣu cābhicārikeṣu saṃdīkṣitānāṃ ca vyāvarttetāgneran brāhmaṇaḥ procya <jīvā nāma sthā tā imaṃ jīvet(v)a [MS 4.8.7:115.5]> |
body.translated_text: And in all sorcery rites, for those who have been co-consecrated, he should turn away from <s>Agni</s>, the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> priest declaring: 'By name you are the living ones; may this one live by them.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/12) <upajīvā nāma sthā tā imaṃ jīveta [?]> |
body.translated_text: 'By name you are the subsidiary living ones; may this one live by them.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/13) <jīvikā nāma sthā tā imaṃ jīveta saṃjīveta [MS 4.8.7:115.5]> |
body.translated_text: 'By name you are the means of livelihood; may this one live and be revived by them.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/13-14) <jīvalā nāma sthā tā imaṃ jiveta saṃjīveta [?]> |
body.translated_text: 'By name you are the life-giving ones; may this one live and be revived by them.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/14-15) <saṃjīvikā nāma sthā tā imaṃ jīve(s)t(v)a [Aap;SS 14.20.8]> | ity apaḥ paribrūyāt |
body.translated_text: 'By name you are the reviving ones; may this one live by them.' Thus he should address the waters.

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140/15-16) tāsām udagarvāk kuryāt |
body.translated_text: Of those [waters], he should make them flow northward.

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:140-141/16-1) <upāṃśvantaryāmau ca cet te prāṇāpānau pātām | upāṃśusavanas te vyānaṃ pātu | śrotraṃ cāśvinau pātāṃ | dakṣakratū te mitrāvaruṇau pātāṃ | stana ity ṛtupātre | ātmānaṃ ta āgrayaṇaḥ pātu | aṅgāni ca ta ukthyaḥ pātu | āyuṣ ṭe dhruvaḥ pātu | vīryaṃ te lakṣmīḥ pātv [Aap;SS 14.21.4]> iti juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: 'If the <s>Upāṃśu</s> and <s>Antaryāma</s> [cups]—may they protect your <s>prāṇa</s> (inbreath) and <s>apāna</s> (outbreath). May the <s>Upāṃśu</s> pressing protect your <s>vyāna</s> (diffused breath). May the <s>Aśvins</s> protect your hearing. May <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> protect your dexterity and intention. The breasts [are] the seasonal cups. May the <s>Āgrayaṇa</s> protect your self. May the <s>Ukthya</s> protect your limbs. May the <s>Dhruva</s> protect your lifespan. May <s>Lakṣmī</s> (prosperity) protect your vigor'—thus he should offer.

body.text: (AVPr_6.6:141/1-3) <puṣṭinā puṣṭiṃ prāṇena prāṇaṃ tejasā tejaś cakṣuṣā cakṣuḥ śrotreṇa śrotram āyuṣāyuḥ punar dehi [?]>_iti sakṛd etāni juhuyād brahmāṇi sūktāni || 6 ||
body.translated_text: 'With nourishment, nourishment; with breath, breath; with splendor, splendor; with sight, sight; with hearing, hearing; with lifespan, lifespan—restore again'—these <s>Brahman</s> hymns he should offer once each. || 6 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.7:141/3-4) brahmā brāhmaṇācchaṃsī vaindravāyavād grahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt |
body.translated_text: The <s>Brahmā</s> priest or the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> should take the cup from the <s>Vaiṇḍravāyava</s> [offering].

body.text: (AVPr_6.7:141/4-7) sa cen mriyetāgnibhya eva trīn aṅgārān uddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ śroṇiṃ prati dagdhvāsthīny upanidadhyus |
body.translated_text: If that one should die, having extracted three embers from the fires, having burned the right hand toward the hip, they should deposit the bones.

body.text: (AVPr_6.7:141/7-8) tasya putraṃ bhrātaraṃ vopadīkṣāṃ samāpnuyuḥ |
body.translated_text: They should complete the substitute consecration for his son or brother.

body.text: (AVPr_6.7:141/8-12) sa cen mriyetāgnibhya eva trīn aṅgārān uddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ śroṇiṃ pratitapyaiva dagdhvā hotuḥ pramukhā ṛtvijaḥ prācīnāvītaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇān ūrūn āghnānāḥ sarparājñīnam (ūrttyā) kīrttayantaḥ stotre stotre 'sthipuṭam upanidadhyuḥ |
body.translated_text: If that one should die, having extracted three embers from the fires, having heated the right hand toward the hip and burned it, the <s>ṛtvij</s> priests, led by the <s>Hotṛ</s>, having put on the sacred thread on the left shoulder, striking their right thighs, reciting the hymn to the Serpent Queen, should deposit a bone-casket at each <s>stotra</s> (chant).

body.text: (AVPr_6.7:141/13) saṃvatsare 'sthipuṭaṃ nidadhyuḥ |
body.translated_text: After a year, they should deposit the bone-casket.

body.text: (AVPr_6.7:141/13-14) saṃvatsare 'sthīni yājayet |
body.translated_text: After a year, he should have the bones ritually offered.

body.text: (AVPr_6.7:141/14-15) samāpte saṃvatsare dīkṣitānāṃ ced upadīkṣeta somaṃ vibhajya viśvajitātirātreṇa |
body.translated_text: When a year is completed, if one should undergo substitute consecration for the consecrated ones, distributing the <s>Soma</s> through a <s>Viśvajit Atirātra</s> sacrifice.

body.text: (AVPr_6.7:141-142/15-2) yady āśvinī[ṣu] śasyamānāsv ādityaṃ purastān na paśyeyur aśvaṃ śvetaṃ rukmapratihitaṃ purastād avasthāpya sauryaṃ śvetaṃ (g)ajam upālaṃbhyam ālabheta tasya tāny eva tantrāṇi yāni savanīyasyuḥ purastāt saṃdhi camasāsavānām anupradānaṃ syāt |
body.translated_text: If, during the <s>Āśvinī</s> recitations, they should not see the sun in the east, having stationed in front a white horse adorned with gold, he should sacrifice a white elephant dedicated to <s>Sūrya</s>. The ritual procedures for that are the same as those of the pressing-day; before the juncture of the cup-libations there should be a subsequent gift.

body.text: (AVPr_6.7:142/2-4) aśvamedhe ced aśvo nāgacched āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla iti mṛgākhare ṣaḍḍhaviṣkām iṣṭiṃ nirvaped daśahaviṣam ity eke |
body.translated_text: If in an <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse sacrifice) the horse should not come, he should perform a six-oblation <s>iṣṭi</s> in the deer-park, with an eight-<s>kapāla</s> cake for <s>Agni</s>; some say a ten-oblation one.

body.text: (AVPr_6.7:142/4-6) vaḍavāṃ ced aśvo 'bhīyād agnaye 'ṃhomuce 'ṣṭākapālaṃ sauryaṃ payo vāyavyāv ājyabhāgau || 7 ||
body.translated_text: If the horse should mount a mare, [he should offer] an eight-<s>kapāla</s> cake to <s>Agni Aṃhomuc</s> (releaser from distress), milk for <s>Sūrya</s>, and <s>ājya</s> portions for <s>Vāyu</s>. || 7 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.8:142/6) somarūpeṣūkta ācāryakalpo |
body.translated_text: In matters concerning <s>Soma</s> forms, the procedure of the teacher has been stated.

body.text: (AVPr_6.8:142/6-7) brāhmaṇaṃ tu bhavati |
body.translated_text: But it is [also found in] the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_6.8:142/7-9) trayastriṃśad vai yajñasya tanvaḥ | ity ekānnatriṃśo pākanagnim aśvaṇām ity arthalopān nivṛttis |
body.translated_text: There are indeed thirty-three forms of the sacrifice. Thus, from the twenty-ninth, the domestic fire, the horse—from the loss of meaning, there is cessation.

body.text: (AVPr_6.8:142/9-17) trīṇi vā caturgṛhītāny anuvākasyety ācāryā ete nityakalpāyārtvijyetarūpayasāṃ tanvām ārttim ārchatāṃ cottarāṃ vā saṃdhiṃ saṃdhāya juhuyād iti taittirīyabrāhmaṇam iṣṭvā taddaivatyāmedhikīyatāmarttir vidyāj jāmiṃ puruṣavidhiṃ māyayā vā yajñasaṃbandhinīṃ vāṅmanaścintāyāṃ prāg viharaṇād ārtāya prajāpatir manasi sārasvato vāci visṛṣṭāyāṃ vidhānaṃ dīkṣāyāṃ brahmavrate svāhety etena nyāyena vājasaneyībrāhmaṇamoghena mantrāḥ k;lptāḥ |
body.translated_text: Three or four collections per section—thus the teachers [say]. These are the permanent procedures for the priestly office and other forms. For the body-forms of those suffering, he should offer having joined the latter juncture—thus the <s>Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa</s>. Having sacrificed, one should know that affliction pertaining to the deity of that sacrifice, the familial human procedure, or the sacrifice-related [affliction] in speech, mind, and thought. Before the ritual wandering, for the afflicted, <s>Prajāpati</s> [acts] in the mind; <s>Sārasvata</s> in speech. When released, the procedure during consecration, in the <s>Brahmavrata</s>, with '<s>svāhā</s>'—by this method, the <s>mantras</s> are established through the <s>Vājasaneyī Brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: (AVPr_6.8:142/17-18) prajāpataye svāhā dhātre svāhā pūṣṇe svāhety |
body.translated_text: '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Prajāpati</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Dhātṛ</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Pūṣan</s>!'

body.text: (AVPr_6.8:142/18-20) aparāhṇikaś cet pravargyo 'bhyastam iyāt_<śukro 'si [PS 1.57.5/18.56.4/19.44.21, ;SS 2.11.5/17.1.20]> <divo 'chata [?]> iti juhuyād vyāhṛtibhiś ca |
body.translated_text: If the <s>Pravargya</s> (hot-milk rite) of the afternoon should go astray, he should offer with 'You are bright' and 'From heaven you shone forth,' and with the <s>vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred exclamations).

body.text: (AVPr_6.8:142/20-22) śvaḥsutyāṃ ced ahutāyāṃ tadahartāv apāgached <indrāya harivate [Aap;SS 13.17.2, Mān;SS 2.5.4.4]> iti brūyād ihānvīcamatibhir iti tisrbhiḥ |
body.translated_text: If, on the day before the pressing, when the offering has not been made, he should depart on that very day, he should say 'To <s>Indra</s> of the bay horses'—with three [verses] beginning with 'here with attentions.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.8:142/22-23) prātaranuvākaṃ ced duritam upākuryāt <pra vāṃ daṃsāṃsy aśvināv avocam [see below]> iti pañcabhir juhuyāt || 8 ||
body.translated_text: If an error should arise during the morning recitation, he should offer with five verses [beginning with] 'I have proclaimed your wondrous deeds, O <s>Aśvins</s>.' || 8 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:142-143/23-1) <pra vāṃ daṃsāṃsy aśvināv avocam asya patiḥ syāṃ sugavaḥ suvīraḥ | uta paśyann aśnuvan dīrgham āyur astam ivej jarimāṇaṃ jagamyām [.RV 1.116.25]> || 1 ||
body.translated_text: 'I have proclaimed your wondrous deeds, O <s>Aśvins</s>; may I be the lord of this, rich in cattle, rich in heroes; and seeing, attaining a long life, may I go to old age as to a home.' || 1 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/1-3) <madhvaḥ somasyāśvinā madāya pratno hotā vivāsate vāṃ | barhiṣmatī rātrir viśritā gīr iṣā yātaṃ nāsatyo 'pa vājaiḥ [.RV 1.117.1]> || 2 ||
body.translated_text: 'For the enjoyment of the sweet <s>Soma</s>, the ancient <s>Hotṛ</s> priest invites you, O <s>Aśvins</s>; the night is spread with sacred grass, the song is offered—come with provisions, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>.' || 2 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/3-5) <yo vām aśvinā manaso javīyān rathaḥ svaśvo viśa ājigāti | yena gachathaḥ sukṛto duroṇaṃ tena narā vartir asmabhyaṃ yātaṃ [.RV 1.117.2]> || 3 ||
body.translated_text: 'That chariot of yours, O <s>Aśvins</s>, swifter than thought, with fine horses, which reaches all peoples—by which you go to the home of the righteous, by that, O heroes, come to us for protection.' || 3 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/5-7) <ṛṣiṃ narāv aṃhasaḥ pāñcajanyam ṛbīṣād atriṃ muṃcatho gaṇena | minantā dasyor aśivasya māyā anupūrvaṃ vṛṣaṇā codayantā [.RV 1.117.3]> || 4 ||
body.translated_text: 'The seer, O heroes, the descendant of the five peoples, from distress—you freed <s>Atri</s> from the pit with your host; destroying the illusions of the ungodly <s>Dasyu</s>, driving on in due order, O mighty ones.' || 4 ||

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/7-10) <aśvaṃ na gūḍham aśvinā durevair ṛṣiṃ narā vṛṣaṇā rebham apsu | saṃ taṃ riṇītho viprutaṃ daṃsobhir na vāṃ jūryanti pūrvyā kṛtāni [.RV 1.117.4]> || 5 || iti |
body.translated_text: 'Like a hidden horse, O <s>Aśvins</s>, from difficult paths—the seer, O heroes, O mighty ones, <s>Rebha</s> in the waters; you released him, scattered, with your powers—your former deeds do not grow old.' || 5 || Thus.

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/10-11) prātaḥsavanaṃ cen mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam abhyastamiyād <agnir mā pātu vasubhiḥ purastāt [PS 7.16.1, ;SS 19.17.1]>_iti juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If the morning pressing should extend into the midday pressing, he should offer with 'May <s>Agni</s> protect me with the <s>Vasus</s> from the east.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/12) agnaye svāhā vasubhyaḥ svāhā gāyatryai svāhā |
body.translated_text: '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Vasus</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Gāyatrī</s>!'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/12-14) mādhyaṃdinaṃ cet tṛtīyasavanam abhyastamiyāt <somo mā rudrair dakṣiṇāyā diśaḥ pātu [PS 7.16.3, ;SS 19.17.3]>_iti juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If the midday pressing should extend into the third pressing, he should offer with 'May <s>Soma</s> protect me with the <s>Rudras</s> from the southern direction.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/14-15) somāya svāhā rudrebhyaḥ svāhā triṣṭubhe svāhā |
body.translated_text: '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Soma</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Rudras</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>!'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/15-17) tṛtīyasavanaṃ ced abhyastamiyād <varuṇo mādityaiḥ sūryo mā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pratīcyā diśaḥ pātu [PS 7.16.4-5, ;SS 19.17.4-5]>_iti juhuyāt |
body.translated_text: If the third pressing should extend [past its time], he should offer with 'May <s>Varuṇa</s> with the <s>Ādityas</s>, may <s>Sūrya</s> with heaven and earth protect me from the western direction.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/17-18) varuṇāya svāhādityebhyaḥ svāhā jagatyai svāhā |
body.translated_text: '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Varuṇa</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Ādityas</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Jagatī</s>!'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/18-20) <ā bharataṃ śikṣataṃ vajrabāhū asmān indrāgnī avataṃ śacībhiḥ | ime nu te raśmayaḥ sūryasya yebhiḥ sapitvaṃ pitaro na āsan [.RV 1.109.7]> | indrāgnibhyāṃ svāhā | indrāviṣṇubhyāṃ svāhā |
body.translated_text: 'Bring [offerings], give aid, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> with thunderbolt-arms, help us with your powers; these are your rays, O <s>Sūrya</s>, by which our fathers had companionship.' '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>!'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/21-22) rātriparyāyāś ced abhivichidyerann indrāya svāhā | indrāṇyai svāhā | chandobhyaḥ svāhā |
body.translated_text: If the night-cycles should be interrupted: '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Indra</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Indrāṇī</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to the meters!'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/22-24) ṛtvijāṃ ced duritam upākuryād agnaye rathantarāya svāhā | uṣase svāhā | paṅktaye svāhā | aśvibhyāṃ svāhā | <mā naḥ piparid aśvinā [cf. AVPariś 37.4.2]>_iti |
body.translated_text: If an error should arise among the <s>ṛtvij</s> priests: '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s> with the <s>Rathantara</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Uṣas</s> (Dawn)! <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Paṅkti</s> meter! <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Aśvins</s>!' 'May the <s>Aśvins</s> not harm us.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/24-27) sarvatrānājñāteṣv agnaye svāhā | yajñāya svāhā | brahmaṇe svāhā | viṣṇave svāhā | prajāpataye svāhā | anumataye svāhā | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāheti |
body.translated_text: In all cases where [the cause is] unknown: '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to the sacrifice! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Brahman</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Viṣṇu</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Prajāpati</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Anumati</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni Sviṣṭakṛt</s>!'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/27-28) <trātāram indraṃ [see above]> | <yayor ojasā [see above]>_iti ca |
body.translated_text: '<s>Indra</s> the protector' and 'By whose might'—and [those verses].

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/28) etā viṣṇuvaruṇadevatyāḥ |
body.translated_text: These have <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> as their deities.

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/28) uktāni prāyaścittāni |
body.translated_text: The expiatory rites have been stated.

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/28-30) athaikāgnau yatra puroḍāśā uktā sthālīpākāṃs tatra kuryāt |
body.translated_text: Now, in the single-fire [ritual], where <s>puroḍāśas</s> (rice cakes) have been prescribed, one should prepare <s>sthālīpākas</s> (cooked grain offerings) instead.

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143/30) puroḍāśeṣu japair eva kuryāt |
body.translated_text: In [place of] <s>puroḍāśas</s>, one should perform with <s>japas</s> (recitations) alone.

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:143-144/30-2) sarvatra chedanabhedanāvadāraṇadahaneṣūkhāsu somakalaśamahāvīrayajñabhāṇḍeṣu sarvatra śīrṇe bhinne naṣṭe 'nyaṃ kṛtvā <punar maitv indriyam [see above]> ity ādadīta |
body.translated_text: In all cases of cutting, breaking, splitting, and burning—in ladles, <s>Soma</s>-jars, <s>Mahāvīra</s> vessels, and sacrificial implements—whenever something is broken, split, or lost, having made a new one, he should take it up with 'May my vital power return.'

body.text: (AVPr_6.9:144/2-4) sarvatra <mā no vidan [see above]>_ity abhayair aparājitair juhuyāt | abhayair aparājitair juhuyāt || 9 || ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ |
body.translated_text: In all cases, he should offer with 'May they not find us' [verses]—with [hymns of] fearlessness and invincibility. With [hymns of] fearlessness and invincibility he should offer. || 9 || End of the sixth chapter.

body.text: (144/4-6) atha yatraitat pārthivam āntarikṣaṃ divyaṃ devair asurair yā prayuktaṃ tad adbhutaṃ śamayaty atharvā prabhur adbhutānāṃ |
body.translated_text: Now, wherever this [portent]—earthly, atmospheric, or celestial—is produced by gods or <s>Asuras</s>, that prodigy the <s>Atharvan</s> priest, the master of prodigies, pacifies.

body.text: (144/6-7) so dūrvājyaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye juhoti |
body.translated_text: He, taking <s>dūrvā</s> grass and ghee, offers in the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire.

body.text: (144/7-9) pṛthivyai śrotrāyāntarikṣāya prāṇāya vayobhyo dive cakṣuṣe nakṣatrebhyaḥ sūryāyādhipataye svāhā | iti sūtraprāyaścittis |
body.translated_text: '<s>Svāhā</s> to the earth, to hearing; to the atmosphere, to breath; to the birds, to heaven; to sight, to the stars; to <s>Sūrya</s>, the overlord.' Thus [ends] the expiatory rite of the <s>sūtra</s>.

body.text: (144/9-10) tatra ślokaḥ |
body.translated_text: Here is a verse:

body.text: (144/11-12) prāyaścittānāṃ parimāṇaṃ na yajña upalabhyate | tasmād dṛṣṭaḥ samāso 'tra taṃ nibodhata yājñikāḥ |
body.translated_text: The full measure of expiatory rites in the sacrifice is not found. Therefore, a summary is seen here—learn it, O sacrificers!

body.text: (144/13-14) ity atharvavede vaitānasūtre prāyaścittaprakaraṇam samāptam |
body.translated_text: Thus ends the section on expiatory rites in the <s>Vaitānasūtra</s> of the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.
